chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 318: The Shocked Shadow Monarch! (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Dark Shadow, do you have a death wish?"
Faced with the questioning of these two auras.
The Shadow Monarch did not respond, instead slowly raising the longsword, pointing at the source of those auras.
"Come, I’ll kill you."
Listening to the Shadow Monarch’s indifferent response.
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch displayed its dominance and murderous intent to the fullest.
It doesn’t engage in idle talk with you, nor does it care about any agreements.
If you dare approach, it will kill you!
Even if you are equally a demigod-level powerhouse, it won’t make a difference in killing you.
The two auras were momentarily at a loss for words.
However, no matter how infuriated they were, they dared not truly approach.
The demigod-level aura gradually dissipated.
At this moment.
Everyone already knew that those two demigod-level beings would not be coming over.
The Shadow Monarch chuckled lightly, then once again pounced towards that group of legendary level powerhouses.
Seeing that figure closing in, this group of Beastman Legends and Tree Spirit Legends were scared out of their wits!
"Clan Leader! Save me!"
"His Majesty the Beast King!"
However, their cries went unanswered.
Those two beings seemed to have abandoned them.
At this moment, High Priest Xiao suddenly shouted.
"Follow me to kill!"
With those words, a group of Witch Race powerhouses immediately reacted.
Then, they all rushed forward.
They were not fools; they knew it was impossible to wait for the Shadow Monarch to kill all these legends before going over to rescue grandpa like a gourd kid.
Thus, they all joined the battle.
The chaotic battle began.
Those reinforcements were slain by the Shadow Monarch, four of them, and there were still eight legendary figures on the field.
Counting the number of Witch Race powerhouses, a total of twenty-two legendary powerhouses besieged the Shadow Monarch alone.
In the back.
That group of Shadow Legends and Shadow Demon Venerable seemed to want to rush up and help.
And just at this moment.
Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City moved.
Buzz!
When the terrifying black death ray appeared.
The Shadow Legends, who had already experienced the firepower of the Ten Thousand Stars City once, subconsciously halted their steps.
They scattered and fled in all directions.
But Han Xing paid no heed, continuing to pursue this group of Shadow Legends to kill.
At this moment, a bizarre scene unfolded on the field.
On one side, the Shadow Demon Venerable was pressing down on that group of legends in a fight.
On the other side, Han Xing was controlling the Ten Thousand Stars City, frantically chasing and killing the Shadow Legends.
"Swish!"
The Shadow Monarch swung the longsword, instantly tearing apart the formation of more than twenty legends!
Then, a Witch Race Legend was once again killed on the spot!
Immediately after, another Tree Spirit Legend’s blood splattered on the scene.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing’s side also became ruthless.
He frantically controlled the Ten Thousand Stars City, first using the Spiritual Shock Tower’s mental attack to control the opponent, then directly focusing fire for bombardment!
A combination of moves was executed, and the killing efficiency skyrocketed!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
One after another, Shadow Legends were bombarded to death by him on the spot!
Each time the Shadow Demon Venerable killed a legendary level powerhouse, Han Xing would reciprocate with two more.
Both sides continued to see legendary level powerhouses fall.
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch glanced at Han Xing once again.
He seemed to not care at all about the fate of those Shadow Legends.
Then, he resumed his actions.
As the Shadow Demon Venerable once again slew a Tree Spirit Legend.
And then reached into the Tree Spirit’s body to extract a crystal stone rich with dense life energy.
He then swallowed it directly.
Wu Ling’Er and Xiao exchanged a glance.
She knew that they could not afford to lose any more lives.
If more were to die, the Witch Race would truly face complete annihilation.
Faced with such a powerful enemy, it was truly despairing.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er suddenly flew out of the battlefield.
Seeing this scene, the group of Beastman and Tree Spirit Legends yelled.
"Witch Race Saintess! What are you doing? Are you trying to escape?"
"Damn it! Get back here!"
Wu Ling’Er did not explain, continuing to fly rapidly towards the rear.
The target was the Witch Race Continent, composed of that large expanse of Sky Islands.
No one knew what she intended to do.
Even the Shadow Monarch, thought Wu Ling’Er intended to flee.
In the Shadow Monarch’s plan, the Witch Race Saintess seemed to be a very crucial part.
He abandoned his current opponents, just about to chase after Wu Ling’Er.
And at this moment, High Priest Xiao blocked him.
Then, the two sides clashed again.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er finally reached above the Witch Race Continent.
In the perplexed gazes of a group of legendary level powerhouses.
Wu Ling’Er took a deep breath.
Then, a terrifying divine power surged.
In the next moment
More and more Witch Race people were freed from the control state of the Shadow Monarch.
Everyone looked at each other, seemingly not understanding why the Saintess was over there, releasing them from control.
However, at this moment, Wu Ling’Er shouted loudly.
"All main cities of the Witch Race, heed my command!"
"From this moment, all Witch Race Sky Islands are to be integrated into Lord Han Xing’s territory!"
"Today, the Witch Race will formally become a vassal race of Lord Han Xing!"
Wu Ling’Er’s voice resonated, carried far by the divine power.
Even the Witch Race civilians hiding in underground shelters heard it.
Initially, they were a bit bewildered, then their eyes widened greatly!
To merge all the Witch Race Sky Islands into that human, Han Xing’s, Sky Island!
This was almost equivalent to handing over all accumulated wealth of the Witch Race for thousands of years!
Not just the hundreds of billions of Witch Race people.
Even the Shadow Monarch and that group of Shadow Legends were taken aback.
They were all shocked by Wu Ling’Er’s decision!

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 319: Saint Master Han Xing, Victory in War!
paragraphs: No one expected that Wu Ling’Er would make such a decision.
Directly making the powerful Witch Race a vassal to Han Xing!
Note, it’s to a person, not to some force.
This determination, this boldness, is truly not to be underestimated!
However, even if Wu Ling’Er orders it, the Witch Race isn’t solely her decision to make.
Every Sky Island is governed by those priests.
However, those Witch Race Legends only pondered for a moment before releasing smiles.
Although they didn’t know why Wu Ling’Er suddenly gave such an order.
But they also knew, in the current situation, unless a Demigod Level powerhouse intervenes, the Witch Race has no hope of survival.
And if they want those old fellows to take action, the outcome for the Witch Race wouldn’t be much better.
As Witch Race people, they are inherently proud.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have fought against the Shadow Legion alone for so many years.
They would rather become a vassal of Han Xing than become subordinates to those old fellows!
At least, Han Xing’s series of actions has already gained their approval!
At this moment.
All the Witch Race Legends loudly responded.
"By order of the Saintess, the second Sky Island of the Witch Race relinquishes control, integrating into the territory of the Human Race’s Han Xing!"
"By order of the Saintess, the eighth Sky Island of the Witch Race relinquishes control, integrating into the territory of the Human Race’s Han Xing."
"By order of the Saintess..."
One Legendary Level powerhouse after another gave orders, equivalent to acknowledging Han Xing’s status.
In the next moment.
A series of system prompts suddenly sounded by Han Xing’s ear.
"Second Main City of the Witch Race, Chief Commander: Hezela, applies to merge into your territory, do you agree?"
"Third Main City of the Witch Race, Chief Commander: Kathy, applies to merge into your territory, do you agree?"
"Fifth of the Witch Race..."
"Fourteenth Main City of the Witch Race, Chief Commander Kanter, applies to merge into your territory, do you agree?"
When these dozens of prompts appeared.
Han Xing looked around with some confusion.
Then, he looked at Wu Ling’Er.
At this time.
Wu Ling’Er’s voice came by Han Xing’s ear.
"Brother Han Xing, don’t worry so much, just accept it directly."
"I can tell, the Holy Artifact on your territory seems to be able to enhance the Defense Towers."
"The Shadow Monarch is too strong, only Holy Artifact Level power can deal with him."
"With the Defense Tower support from our Witch Race Main City, you can definitely defeat him!"
At this moment, Han Xing reacted.
As a favored child of the heavens, Wu Ling’Er naturally has vast knowledge and experience.
She quickly saw through the effect of Han Xing’s Holy Artifact.
It can instantly complete a qualitative transformation to all the Defense Towers on the territory.
And now, the powerhouses of the Witch Race are almost wiped out.
What do they have left?
They have the terrifying number of High-tier Defense Towers on the Main City.
And the function of the Sun Crown Stele is to comprehensively enhance all attributes of the Defense Towers on the territory by 100%.
In other words, it doesn’t matter if these Defense Towers were built by Han Xing or not.
As long as they merge into Ten Thousand Stars City, then they all belong to the Defense Towers of Han Xing’s territory.
In other words, they can complete a qualitative transformation instantly!
With such a high number stacked together, it can definitely pose a deadly threat to the Shadow Monarch!
At this moment, everyone present understood.
Including the Shadow Monarch.
He looked at Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City and his figure disappeared once more.
At this moment, the High Priest shouted: "Stop him!"
With the words falling, terrifying red flames once again ignited on the High Priest.
He unexpectedly also displayed the aura of a Demigod Level.
BOOM!
The Shadow Monarch was forced out in the void, looking at the High Priest somewhat unexpectedly.
At the same time.
Other Witch Race powerhouses, one after another, rushed to the side of the Shadow Monarch, trapping him tightly.
PU PU PU!
The Shadow Monarch also seemed to be in a hurry.
He wielded his Great Sword continuously, starting to attack these Legendary Powerhouses frantically.
"Get out of my way!"
The Shadow Monarch issued a low, threatening voice.
However, those Witch Race Legends became fiercer.
Even at the cost of their lives, they will never let the Shadow Monarch interrupt the final fusion step!
The tree spirits and Beastman Legends seemed not to understand what was happening.
But seeing the situation, they also knew they must hold back the Shadow Monarch.
Hence, they joined the battle group one after another, detaining the Shadow Demon Venerable at all costs.
"RUMBLE!"
The area was once again affected drastically, as if the world had changed color.
At this moment, Han Xing.
Turned his head and manipulated Ten Thousand Stars City to rush towards the continent behind.
The Shadow Legends still wanted to come to block, but Han Xing blasted two of them to death again, scaring them to a halt.
Ten Thousand Stars City rapidly retreated.
The merger with the continent became inevitable.
In the next moment.
Under the watchful eyes of tens of billions of Witch Race warriors.
The gigantic Ten Thousand Stars City pierced through layers of mist and flew over.
Then, it suddenly merged together!
At this moment.
The system prompts by Han Xing’s ear began to ring frantically.

"You have incorporated the second main city Sky Island of the Witch Race, territory area expanded, gained territory resources: Tower of Witch Soul*272, Tower of True Sight*50, Witch Pattern Battleship*173, Philosopher’s Stone*17643, main city treasury*1, Ancient Weapon..."

"You have incorporated the third main city Sky Island of the Witch Race, territory area expanded, gained territory resources: Spiritual Energy Cannon Tower*163, Tower of the Sky*473, Philosopher’s Stone 3246, main city treasury*1, Demon Elephant War Chariot..."
"You have incorporated..."

"You have successfully incorporated the eighteenth Sky Island of the Witch Race, gained Tower of True Spirit*373, gained Tower of the Dark Witch*1743, gained Philosopher’s Stone*34265, Shimmering Terra Stone*64398, Shadow Crystal*2.7 billion, main city treasury*1..."
"Congratulations, your territory area has reached the national level!"

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 319: Saint Master Han Xing, Victory in War!
paragraphs: "Because you are the first Survivor to reach national level across the entire server, world influence +732, Legendary Points +100."
"You have gained the full recognition of the Witch Race and obtained a new title, ’Witch Race Saint Master.’
System Announcement: "All Survivors, please note, Survivor Star River has become the ’Witch Race Saint Master,’ and the Human Race is now implicitly merged into Han Xing’s faction."
"The Human Race Destiny Value System is now activated."
"Current Fortune Value: 17300 (Witch Race 16500, Human Race 800)"
"Fortune Value can provide an amplification effect for all units within Han Xing’s faction: Survivor gains experience at an increased speed of 17.3%, and All Attributes increase by 17.3%."
"Please note, Fortune Value can be increased through territorial expansion and force development."
"The higher the Fortune Value, the greater the enhancement received by all."
"If losses are suffered within the faction, Fortune Value will decrease accordingly."
"If the Fortune Value drops to 0, the faction will disband, and all members of the faction will face penalties."
The moment Han Xing successfully merged the Witch Race Continent.
The whole world became silent.
Especially when that system announcement appeared.
Billions of Survivors in the Land of the Abandoned Gods fell into a momentary daze.
Then, the chat channel exploded directly.
"What the hell! Witch Race Saint Master! What kind of title is this?"
"Don’t you understand? Star God has already become the Witch Race Saint Master and has independently established a major power!"
"Now, our Human Race as a vassal has already fully integrated into Star God’s power."
Upon hearing this explanation, billions in the chat channel were in strong shock.
"Oh my god! I remember Zhou Huang mentioned before that the Witch Race had the power to easily wipe out the Human Race?"
"And now, this race has actually been subdued by Star God?"
"It’s terrifying! Although we know Star God always does things beyond our predictions, who thought this time the move would be so big!"
"Merging the Witch Race directly! This is an unparalleled status, even beyond any emperor in ancient times!
What this person said was right, as the Witch Race in both strength and population far exceeds the current Human Race.
And Han Xing becoming the master of the Witch Race, not even the human emperor of today can compare to Han Xing’s status.
Don’t you see that even the Human Race was auto-integrated into Han Xing’s faction?
Survivors discussed again.
"And that Destiny Value System, I didn’t expect the Witch Race’s Fortune Value to be so much more than ours!"
"All at once, it provided us with such a substantial experience gain and attributes enhancement!"
"Yes, looking at it this way, it shows the huge gap between us and the Witch Race!"
"By the way, did you hear the system prompt that we can leave the Star River faction?"
"Heard it, but if we leave, we won’t enjoy the Fortune Value boost, isn’t that foolish?"
"Exactly, exactly!"
There was too much content in this announcement.
The chat channel kept exploding.
Meanwhile.
In the distant Elf Realm, an indistinct existence suddenly focused on the direction of the Witch Race Territory.
Originally, it saw the Witch Race Territory shrouded in Darkness.
Several predictions all indicated that today the Witch Race was destined to perish.
So, this being had not made any moves.
But now, within that Darkness, a beam of Holy Light appeared.
"Helas has just fallen... has the Witch Race produced a new Saint Master?"
"Seeing the intensity of this Fortune, it even surpasses during Helas’s reign."
"When did the Witch Race produce such a character?"
Not only was the existence of the Elf Race puzzled.
Other great races, those Demigod-level powerhouses all sensed it.
They were full of surprise as they looked in the direction of the Witch Race Territory.
Meanwhile.
On Han Xing’s side.
He looked at his own attributes, and a smile suddenly appeared on his lips.
Because his personal panel had undergone some changes.
[Name]: Han Xing·Witch Race Saint Master
[Profession]: Wild Ranger·Hero
[Level]: 50 (Not Advanced)
[Attributes]: Power 10032+10032, agility 12073+12073, Spirit 9816+9816, Constitution 11123+11123.

[Equipment]: Wandering Demon Hide Armor, Bottoms, Long Boots, Cloak, Wrist Guard... Fearless Ring (Orange), Night Necklace (Orange), Space Backpack (Purple*2), Demon-Defying Battle Bow (Red), Mask of the Golden Goddess (Red), Oracle Throne (Red)...
The above are Han Xing’s attributes now.
Compared to a few hours ago, with a Four-dimensional Attributes around eight thousand, it’s more than doubled now!
The reason for such an increase is all due to the title Han Xing had just obtained.
[Title]: Witch Race Saint Master
[Title Effect 1]: All Attributes increased by 100%.
[Title Effect 2]: All friendly faction creatures cannot cause harm to you.
[Title Effect 3]: King’s Suppression (For enemies with an average attribute value below your own, attribute suppression occurs, reducing their attributes by 50%.)
This golden title’s attributes are terrifying to an explosive degree.
The 100% All Attributes increase, added with the extra 17.3% increase from the Destiny Value System, stacked Han Xing’s attributes to this level.
Now, even an Initial-stage Legend, speaking only of Four-dimensional Attributes, would be crushed by Han Xing.
Plus, the third title effect.
All enemies with attributes lower than Han Xing will be forcibly reduced by 50% of their attributes.
Now, Han Xing can truly be said to have Legendary Level combat power.
He could even face off high-tier legends in a one-on-one battle!
This shiny golden name added an ineffable quality to Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing was also thrilled deep down inside!
Yet, now is not the time to be excited.
He hasn’t forgotten, there is still a terrifying enemy right before him.
Shadow Monarch.
The next moment!
With a thought from Han Xing.

"The higher the Fortune Value, the greater the enhancement received by all."
"If losses are suffered within the faction, Fortune Value will decrease accordingly."
"If the Fortune Value drops to 0, the faction will disband, and all members of the faction will face penalties."
The moment Han Xing successfully merged the Witch Race Continent.
The whole world became silent.
Especially when that system announcement appeared.
Billions of Survivors in the Land of the Abandoned Gods fell into a momentary daze.
Then, the chat channel exploded directly.
"What the hell!
Witch Race Saint Master!
What kind of title is this?"
"Don’t you understand?
Star God has already become the Witch Race Saint Master and has independently established a major power!"
"Now, our Human Race as a vassal has already fully integrated into Star God’s power."
Upon hearing this explanation, billions in the chat channel were in strong shock.
"Oh my god!
I remember Zhou Huang mentioned before that the Witch Race had the power to easily wipe out the Human Race?"
"And now, this race has actually been subdued by Star God?"
"It’s terrifying!
Although we know Star God always does things beyond our predictions, who thought this time the move would be so big!"
"Merging the Witch Race directly!
This is an unparalleled status, even beyond any emperor in ancient times!
What this person said was right, as the Witch Race in both strength and population far exceeds the current Human Race.
And Han Xing becoming the master of the Witch Race, not even the human emperor of today can compare to Han Xing’s status.
Don’t you see that even the Human Race was auto-integrated into Han Xing’s faction?
Survivors discussed again.
"And that Destiny Value System, I didn’t expect the Witch Race’s Fortune Value to be so much more than ours!"
"All at once, it provided us with such a substantial experience gain and attributes enhancement!"
"Yes, looking at it this way, it shows the huge gap between us and the Witch Race!"
"By the way, did you hear the system prompt that we can leave the Star River faction?"
"Heard it, but if we leave, we won’t enjoy the Fortune Value boost, isn’t that foolish?"
"Exactly, exactly!"
There was too much content in this announcement.
The chat channel kept exploding.
Meanwhile.
In the distant Elf Realm, an indistinct existence suddenly focused on the direction of the Witch Race Territory.
Originally, it saw the Witch Race Territory shrouded in Darkness.
Several predictions all indicated that today the Witch Race was destined to perish.
So, this being had not made any moves.
But now, within that Darkness, a beam of Holy Light appeared.
"Helas has just fallen... has the Witch Race produced a new Saint Master?"
"Seeing the intensity of this Fortune, it even surpasses during Helas’s reign."
"When did the Witch Race produce such a character?"
Not only was the existence of the Elf Race puzzled.
Other great races, those Demigod-level powerhouses all sensed it.
They were full of surprise as they looked in the direction of the Witch Race Territory.
Meanwhile.
On Han Xing’s side.
He looked at his own attributes, and a smile suddenly appeared on his lips.
Because his personal panel had undergone some changes.
[Name]: Han Xing·Witch Race Saint Master
[Profession]: Wild Ranger·Hero
[Level]: 50 (Not Advanced)
[Attributes]: Power 10032+10032, agility 12073+12073, Spirit 9816+9816, Constitution 11123+11123.
[Equipment]: Wandering Demon Hide Armor, Bottoms, Long Boots, Cloak, Wrist Guard...
Fearless Ring (Orange), Night Necklace (Orange), Space Backpack (Purple*2), Demon-Defying Battle Bow (Red), Mask of the Golden Goddess (Red), Oracle Throne (Red)...
The above are Han Xing’s attributes now.
Compared to a few hours ago, with a Four-dimensional Attributes around eight thousand, it’s more than doubled now!
The reason for such an increase is all due to the title Han Xing had just obtained.
[Title]: Witch Race Saint Master
[Title Effect 1]: All Attributes increased by 100%.
[Title Effect 2]: All friendly faction creatures cannot cause harm to you.
[Title Effect 3]: King’s Suppression (For enemies with an average attribute value below your own, attribute suppression occurs, reducing their attributes by 50%.)
This golden title’s attributes are terrifying to an explosive degree.
The 100% All Attributes increase, added with the extra 17.3% increase from the Destiny Value System, stacked Han Xing’s attributes to this level.
Now, even an Initial-stage Legend, speaking only of Four-dimensional Attributes, would be crushed by Han Xing.
Plus, the third title effect.
All enemies with attributes lower than Han Xing will be forcibly reduced by 50% of their attributes.
Now, Han Xing can truly be said to have Legendary Level combat power.
He could even face off high-tier legends in a one-on-one battle!
This shiny golden name added an ineffable quality to Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing was also thrilled deep down inside!
Yet, now is not the time to be excited.
He hasn’t forgotten, there is still a terrifying enemy right before him.
Shadow Monarch.
The next moment!
With a thought from Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 319: Saint Master Han Xing, Victory in War!
paragraphs: All over the Witch Race Continent, tens of thousands of advanced defense towers were fully activated.
As the foundation of a major clan, these defense towers have consumed nearly thirty percent of the Witch Race’s resources in recent years.
They were naturally terrifying.
At the same time.
The Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele suddenly emitted a rich white light, enveloping the entire Witch Race Continent.
In an instant, the Witch Race Continent became like a Holy Land, sacred and full of threat!
The intensity of the aura it emanated was more than a hundred times stronger than before!
Faced with this terrifying aura.
Even the Shadow Monarch frowned.
At this moment.
Han Xing sat high on the Oracle Throne.
Hundreds of billions of Witch Race people gazed upon that imposing figure.
With the support of the [Witch Race Saint Master] title, Han Xing himself exuded a regal aura.
At this moment, he was more like a true king descending upon the world.
The Shadow Monarch was not the least bit intimidated and simultaneously unleashed a surge of overwhelming demonic qi.
"Buzz!"
Centered around the Shadow Monarch, half the sky was covered by dark weapons.
From this demonic qi, everyone saw endless killing intent and the presence of a sovereign!
It even vaguely suppressed Han Xing’s momentum.
As the leader of the Shadow Legion, occupying a high position for long, the Shadow Monarch’s presence was naturally incomparable to ordinary beings.
The fact that Han Xing, having just acquired the title of Witch Race Saint Master, could rival the opponent was already remarkable!
At this moment.
The auras of the two kings occupied each side of the world.
On one side, darkness enveloped the world with shadow upon shadow.
On the other, Holy Light pierced the sky with an overwhelming regal aura!
Boom!
In the collision, they were unexpectedly evenly matched!
At this time.
The Shadow Demon Venerable slowly extended his right hand.
It seemed he was about to use the same trick again to control the Witch Race civilians, causing Han Xing to suffer a backlash of fate.
However.
Under Han Xing’s aura of fate, the Shadow Demon Venerable’s method surprisingly failed.
On the Witch Race Continent, those civilians remained unharmed.
This time, it was the Shadow Demon Venerable’s turn to be surprised.
He looked at Han Xing in astonishment.
"Just becoming the Witch Race Saint Master, yet possessing such powerful fate."
"But you don’t have the Human Emperor’s Destiny, it’s really strange..."
Han Xing didn’t answer this question, instead, he said calmly.
"Leave.
His voice conveyed an undeniable majesty, as if an emperor was giving an order.
The Shadow Demon Venerable was unmoved.
Instead, he raised his longsword, eager to try.
He seemed very keen on having a direct showdown with Han Xing.
In fact, he did just that.
In the next instant, the Shadow Demon Venerable’s figure disappeared.
Han Xing’s eyes instantly opened wide.
He fixed his gaze on where the Shadow Demon Venerable had vanished.
Demigod-level strength surpassed Han Xing too much!
Even with the support of the Witch Race Saint Master title, Han Xing couldn’t track his movements.
Including the nearby Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest, who were also on high alert, vigilantly watching their surroundings.
But clearly, with the speed and strength of the Shadow Monarch.
When he appeared, it would undoubtedly be a thunderous strike!
And Han Xing was his primary target.
Just then.
Han Xing suddenly took out a golden mask, exuding the aura of a divine spirit!
Then.
The Eye of the Divine effect was directly activated!
At that moment, Han Xing’s aura surged, as if he had reached a higher level, one he had never attained before.
And the world in his eyes also changed.
He could vaguely see a thread above everyone’s head.
A relatively blurry thread.
But when he looked at Wu Ling’Er and others, he found the line above their heads was extremely thick, even
At the same time, Han Xing also saw the Shadow Demon Venerable’s trail.
Even though it might sound slow when described, from the moment the Shadow Demon Venerable disappeared to Han Xing activating the Eye of the Divine effect, less than a second had passed.
And the Shadow Demon Venerable had already appeared less than a hundred kilometers above Han Xing’s head.
This distance, for a powerhouse of his level, could be crossed in an instant.
Seeing the Shadow Demon Venerable’s greatsword about to strike down.
Han Xing’s eyes turned cold.
The tens of thousands of advanced defense towers that had long been charged up all launched their attacks at this moment.
Buzz!
The vast Witch Race Continent erupted with tens of thousands of white beams simultaneously.
Then, directly hit the Shadow Monarch.
In the next moment.
Everyone’s vision turned white.
Their sight forcibly stripped away, even for those legendary powerhouses.
And as a deafening explosion resounded.
The area Han Xing bombarded, spanning dozens of kilometers, was completely covered by firepower!
This was a blow comparable to a space-based weapon!
The entire Witch Race Continent trembled violently.
Even those Shadow Demon Venerables, under the power of this strike, felt so insignificant.
There was no doubt in their minds that if they faced this strike head-on, they would instantly turn to dust and vanish on the spot!
As the commotion gradually subsided.
A silhouette engulfed in thick smoke flew backward several hundred kilometers away.
This silhouette was precisely the Shadow Monarch.
At this point, he had lost his previous majesty.
His entire body was corroded by the intense Holy Light, and the black armor on his body had melted away, revealing a shriveled chest beneath.
Even the mask on his face had shattered by half.
Beneath the mask appeared a visage akin to that of a dried corpse.
Although from the Shadow Monarch’s hands one could tell his appearance might be a bit peculiar.
But seeing it with their own eyes was still somewhat unexpected.
Who would have thought that the dignified Shadow Monarch would look like this?
However, he was unfazed by his appearance being seen by everyone.
Instead, he nodded slightly at Han Xing, as if acknowledging him.
"You already possess the capability to threaten an average demigod-level."
"Indeed, I can’t do anything to you."
"Then today, let’s leave it at that."
With those words, without waiting for Han Xing’s response.
The Shadow Monarch’s silhouette turned.
Taking the remaining thirty or more Shadow Legends, along with those two high-tier Demon Venerables, vanished on the spot.
As they departed.
Those Shadow Legends took a long, deep look at the figure sitting on the throne in the sky.
It was precisely because of his appearance that the Shadow Legion’s assured victory faced unprecedented variables.
Even with the Shadow Monarch’s personal appearance, he was forced to a reversal in dire straits.
This human repeatedly redefined their understanding.
At the same time.
As the Shadow Army retreated.
The black mist covering the sky receded like the tides.
At this moment, all the Witch Race people stared blankly at everything.
Then, erupted in earth-shattering cheers!
"The Shadow Legion is gone, we won!"
"We really won!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 320: Achievement Unlocked: Unparalleled Through Time
paragraphs: "The Shadow Legion has retreated, we’ve won!"
"We’ve really won!!!"
At this moment, all the Witch Race soldiers raised their arms and cheered.
They all set down their weapons and embraced their comrades beside them.
Some even cried tears of excitement.
Before this battle began, they were prepared to die in combat.
But unexpectedly, they survived in the end.
"Praise the great Saint Master Han Xing!"
"Praise Saint Master Han Xing!"
Hundreds of thousands of Witch Race soldiers chanted Han Xing’s name in unison.
Upon receiving the news of victory.
Billions of civilians also emerged one after another from the underground shelters.
They looked up at the figure seated on the throne in the sky, and tears welled up in their eyes.
Today.
They experienced the death of the Saint Master, the fall of the entire Witch Race territory.
And the downfall of priests one by one.
The successive blows had made them lose faith, and they had resolved themselves to die.
Just when they thought the Witch Race was doomed to perish today.
The situation took a miraculous turnaround!
The human who appeared suddenly, like a rising star from another world, created yet another miracle!
Not only did he save everyone.
Now, he has also become their new Saint Master!
The dramatic ups and downs left everyone with mixed emotions.
The Witch Race people will never forget this day.
None of the Witch Race present questioned Han Xing’s place as the Witch Race Saint Master.
After all, they all heard the final conversation.
It was this man who drove back the existence that had brought them nightmares.
The Shadow Monarch!
It was also him who saved the remaining Legendary Powerhouses of the Witch Race.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er led a group of severely injured Witch Clan priests to Han Xing’s side.
Then she knelt on one knee.
"Hail the Saint Master!"
At this moment.
Billions of Witch Race civilians all knelt on one knee, and shouted in unison.
"Hail the Saint Master!!!"
The sound was earth-shattering.
Even the clouds in the sky were directly dispersed.
As the savior of the Witch Race, Han Xing deserved their bow.
Below, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun watched the scene in shock and couldn’t help but click their tongues.
Shen Yun said, "This Witch Race’s formation is truly grand."
"But it also indirectly shows that they’ve completely recognized Brother Xing’s status as the Saint Master."
Cheng Jianyong agreed wholeheartedly from the side: "Yeah, Brother Xing is really something else now."
"Saint Master! It sounds even more terrifying than Human Emperor!"
"In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, there are probably only a few existences higher than Brother Xing’s status, right?"
What Cheng Jianyong said was true.
As the master of a race.
Han Xing’s status now is equivalent to those like the Elf King, the Giant King.
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also looked at Han Xing with faces full of solace.
As his companions.
They have witnessed firsthand over the past year how Han Xing rose step by step to this point.
The Co-leader of the Witch Race!
Even, tens of billions of the Human Race were automatically assigned to Han Xing’s faction.
However, compared to the grandeur of the Witch Race people.
The millions of Human Race survivors on the Witch Race Continent were somewhat at a loss.
At this time, they whispered among themselves, "Oh man... so many people are kneeling, should we kneel too?"
"Uh... we probably don’t need to, right? The Star God never did this either."
They were used to being carefree on Blue Star and didn’t understand the faith of the Witch Race people.
"Huh? If we don’t kneel, will the Star God hold a grudge against us?"
As soon as this person finished speaking, he was tapped on the head, "What nonsense are you talking about? The Star God’s character is well known; why would he hold a grudge over this?"
"Yeah, the Star God hasn’t even looked our way; he doesn’t care about us at all."
The others echoed, "Exactly, don’t go doubting the Star God’s character casually."
The person who got tapped didn’t dare utter another word and quickly shut his mouth.
At this time, a nearby survivor chimed in, "By the way, did you hear the system notification just now?"
"It said that we performed excellently in this battle, and the Witch Race’s friendliness increased by 1000, plus I got an extra hundred points in All Attributes!"
"I heard it too, but I got 2000 friendliness, All Attributes increased by 150 points, and I was rewarded with 5 bottles of High-Level Life Secret Elixir."
"Oh man, you guys got so much? I only got 50!"
"Hahaha! You must have been slacking off in battle earlier; the system rewards based on our number of kills."
"Damn, then I missed out!"
At this time, a survivor interrupted, "Stop talking so much, let’s post these rewards in the chat channel and show off!"
"They surely didn’t expect there would be such benefits for participating in the Witch Race campaign!"
"Exactly, those guys were mocking us earlier, saying we were being used by the Star God, let’s see what they say now!"
At the onset of the war, Han Xing had posted a message in the chat channel telling how the Witch Race experienced drastic changes.
At first, those survivors were confused.
It was only after much inquiry that they learned of the terrifying war that erupted among the Witch Race, and that the enemy was extremely powerful.
At that time, some survivors who hadn’t signed a Lord Contract with Xingyu City felt extremely fortunate.
Fortunately, they hadn’t gone to the Witch Race Territory!
Otherwise, once the war broke out, they wouldn’t be able to escape and would be forced to fight.
And they began to mock in the chat channel.
Saying those who ventured first into the Witch Race Territory were fools, being used by Han Xing as pawns.
Now, they could barely hold onto their lives!
However, now, they could finally proudly tell these people.
Not only did they preserve their lives, but they also reaped substantial benefits from the war!

Not only did they preserve their lives, but they also reaped substantial benefits from the war!

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 320: Achievement Unlocked: Unparalleled Through the Ages! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Following the Star God leads to rewards!
At this moment.
When these survivors shared their reward items in the chat channel.
It immediately sparked a wave of envy and jealousy among many people.
Each one regretted not going to the Witch Race Territory earlier to participate in this war.
And those who initially sneered now all shut their mouths in shame.
Han Xing wasn’t aware of the discussions about him in the chat channel.
Because.
He also received the same system notification.
"Survivor Han Xing, due to your astounding contributions in this battle, you have achieved: Unprecedented Brilliance!"
"Witch Race overall friendliness +10000, current level: Fanatic (Full Level)."
"You have received: Helas’s Sovereignty Necklace (Red)."
"You have received an additional reward: Corona Stele Blueprint 2."
Upon hearing this notification, Han Xing couldn’t help but cry out in surprise!
"Holy crap!"
He was so excited that he almost jumped up, the surprise in his eyes was completely uncontrollable!
This reward was completely beyond his expectations.
Not only did he get a divine-level necklace, but it’s also a precious piece of jewelry!
And in addition, there’s an extra reward, a Corona Stele Blueprint!
Number 2!
This is a Holy Artifact level blueprint!
When he got the first Corona Stele Blueprint, Han Xing knew that this thing came as a set.
Besides number 1, there were other numbered Corona Stele Blueprints.
However, he hadn’t gathered any information about it before,
And now, shortly after building the Corona Stele, he unexpectedly got the second blueprint!
Isn’t this fortune?
But thinking about it, it’s also within reason.
This Witch Race battle was incredibly difficult.
Firstly, so many Shadow Legends, high-tier legends attacked all at once.
Later, even the Shadow Monarch, a demigod level being, appeared.
It could be said that if it wasn’t for Han Xing, even if another demigod level powerhouse had replaced him.
They wouldn’t have been able to save the Witch Race from this seemingly doomed situation.
The difficulty could be imagined.
A divine necklace, a holy artifact blueprint.
This reward truly matches Han Xing’s contribution!
Han Xing couldn’t wait to check the attributes of these two items.
But he noticed, below there were still hundreds of millions of Witch Race people kneeling to him.
Han Xing hurriedly coughed twice and said.
"Everyone, get up, no need to be so formal."
As he spoke, the crowd of Witch Race people said in unison: "Thank you, Saint Master!"
They all stood up from the ground and looked at Han Xing in the sky with almost fanatical eyes.
Han Xing couldn’t bear being stared at by so many people.
Hurriedly waved his hand and said: "In this great war, the Witch Race suffered heavy losses."
"The most urgent task now is to return to the Witch Race territory, seek out all living forces, and not abandon any clansman."
Although Han Xing had merged hundreds of large Sky Islands of the Witch Race continent.
Apart from these, there must still be many populated Sky Islands within the Witch Race territory.
Previously held back by the massive Shadow Legion.
Now that these shadow monsters have retreated, it’s uncertain how many people can survive.
So, Han Xing thought about reclaiming the fallen areas within the Witch Race territory and rescuing the surviving Witch Race people.
But these words moved the Witch Race people below immensely.
They didn’t expect Han Xing to be so concerned about the populace just after becoming the Witch Race Saint Master.
For a moment, they shouted with tears in their eyes.
"Saint Master’s wisdom!"
Han Xing’s mouth twitched.
Seeing the eyes of this group of Witch Race people becoming more and more fanatical when looking at him.
He quietly signaled Wu Ling’Er with his eyes.
Wu Ling’Er immediately understood.
"All Legion Commanders of the Witch Race, listen to orders!"
"Follow the Saint Master’s will."
"Everyone quickly reorganize troops, head to the Witch Race territory, rescue other Witch Race compatriots, reclaim our Sky Islands!"
As soon as Wu Ling’Er finished speaking.
The Witch Race commanders immediately complied.
At the same time.
A large number of Witch Race powerhouses were dispatched, beginning to busy themselves throughout the Witch Race territory and continent.
After the war, there were still many aftermath tasks that they needed to handle and oversee.
At this moment.
There were still a dozen figures left in the sky.
They were the twelve legendary figures of the Witch Race, as well as seven legendary figures who came to support from the Beastman Kingdom and Sky Island Forest.
At this moment, they looked at each other in confusion, staring at Han Xing, as if not knowing what to do.
Han Xing glanced at them and said directly.
"You all, come with me."
Then, Han Xing’s figure flashed and he returned to Ten Thousand Stars City.
The legendary figures also vanished, following Han Xing.
At this moment.
Inside the council hall of the Lord’s Mansion.
Han Xing still sat in the main seat.
Beneath him.
Sitting were Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and several other legendary powerhouses.
Wu Ling’Er and High Priest Xiao were seated beside Han Xing.
They all stared intently at Han Xing,
Han Xing looked at those beastman legends and tree spirit legends,
"Uh... how should I address you all?"
Among them, the beastman legends with exaggerated muscles spoke first: "Beastman Kingdom, Rica."
"Beastman Kingdom, Mokeliez..."
Then, those tree spirit legends also introduced themselves.
"Sky Island Forest, Gurdu."
"Sky Island Forest, Balruwen..."
After hearing the names of these legends, Han Xing nodded in understanding.
But in his heart, he was constantly complaining.
What an idiot I am!
Why did I ask this question?
These beastmen all look the same to me.
Even knowing their names, I can’t differentiate who is who.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 320: Achievement Unlocked: Unparalleled Through Time (Part 3)
paragraphs: This includes those tree spirits as well, who are completely identical.
When the time comes, it’ll be awkward to call the wrong name!
At this moment, Han Xing coughed twice and said: "Fellow powerhouses, though I am a temporary holder of the Witch Race Saint Master position."
"But now, since I am the spokesperson here."
"As the host, I solemnly thank you all on behalf of the entire Witch Race for extending a helping hand."
Han Xing seemed to quickly adapt to his identity as Witch Race Saint Master.
However, this also has something to do with Wu Ling’Er just informing Han Xing of the related situation.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words of gratitude.
One of the beastman legends quickly said: "Saint Master Han Xing, you’re too kind. The Shadow Legion has been haunting the Holy Spirit Realm for long, always a malignant tumor."
"Every living being in the Holy Spirit Realm is eager to eliminate the Shadow Legion!"
"This time, they audaciously killed Lord Helas and even reached their vile hands towards the entire Witch Race!"
"It’s truly infuriating to both humans and gods!"
"Especially that Shadow Monarch, who overlooked the agreement among demigod-level powerhouses in the Holy Spirit Realm and resolutely acted against us!"
"It was indeed lucky to have Saint Master Han Xing; without you, we might have all suffered at the hands of the Shadow Monarch."
Other legends chimed in: "That’s right, that’s right."
"Thanks to Saint Master Han Xing!"
These legendary powerhouses appear to be very adept socially, showing no intent to take credit.
Unlike those portrayed in films or novels, who rely on their power and seniority to act arrogantly.
This did catch me a bit off guard.
However, what Han Xing does not know.
From the recent battle, they have already witnessed how formidable this human race individual is.
Not to mention that his current Saint Master title already places him on equal footing with their leader.
Just judging by the power this human race has just demonstrated is enough to intimidate everyone present!
Even the Shadow Monarch was forced to retreat.
This clearly indicates just how terrifying Han Xing’s recent burst of power was!
Hence, these legends, usually esteemed within their own clans.
In facing Han Xing now, dare not even speak loudly!
Moreover, even without those means, they acknowledge that the strength of this young man is not to be underestimated.
Although only exuding the aura of a Fourth Transformation, from his presence, they actually sensed a deadly threat!
This implies that Han Xing definitely holds the power to kill legends.
The atmosphere in the council hall gradually eased.
Suddenly, Han Xing unexpectedly said: "By the way, regarding the reward this time..."
Upon hearing this, the group of legendary powerhouses immediately exhibited intense expressions.
When Han Xing looked over, none dared to meet his gaze.
Seeing the evasive glances of these legendary powerhouses, Han Xing also chuckled.
"You don’t need to be so formal. I’ve already heard from Xiao."
"This time, you agreed to rescue because the Witch Race promised you a reward."
"Now that the matter has concluded, I definitely won’t break my promise on what was previously committed."
Though, the conditions Xiao agreed to are indeed a bit painful.
As much as one hundred thousand Philosopher’s Stone, plus fifty thousand Shimmering Terra Stone, and two hundred thousand Shadow Divine Stone.
This nearly accounts for a third of the Witch Race’s entire stock.
Moreover, this is not the most critical aspect.
The most critical condition is, besides those stones.
The Witch Race also has to provide two Witch Clan Forbidden Techniques, and fifty pieces of Calamity Divine Gold.
Han Xing doesn’t know what Calamity Divine Gold is.
But from the reaction of these people, it must be material even more precious than Philosopher’s Stone.
Witch Clan Forbidden Techniques, moreover, are one of the Witch Race’s signature skills, usually not shared with outsiders.
Since merging the Witch Race Continent, Han Xing has mentally regarded those resources as his own.
Now having to take them out is also causing pangs of regret.
However, this is understandable.
After all, being able to mobilize twelve legendary powerhouses for support comes at a price, how could it not?
What’s more, this time, indeed they did suffer quite a bit.
Five legends had fallen.
Of the six powerhouses supported by the Beastman Kingdom, half were killed.
This would be a significant loss to any clan.
Even the Fortune Value would diminish considerably.
Han Xing was just about to ask Wu Ling’Er to fetch the items.
Yet, the group of legends quickly gestured to stop.
A tree spirit legend said: "Lord Saint Master, our Clan Leader mentioned there is no need for rewards this time."
"It heard of your feat in repulsing the Shadow Monarch, admires your battle power, and wishes to invite you to visit the Sky Island Forest when you have time."
Beside him, the beastman legend also hurriedly said: "Our King said the same, hoping Saint Master Han Xing could visit the Beastman Kingdom as a guest."
Listening to the harmonious expressions from both sides of the powerhouses, Han Xing squinted his eyes.
He does not believe these fellows simply wish to invite him as a guest.
It’s likely under the guise of this invitation, their true intent is to investigate his background.
This time, what he accomplished was too astonishing.
The Shadow Monarch is clearly not a common legend, even pointing fingers at the two demigods for intimidation, neither dared to make a sound.
However, Han Xing repelled this fellow.
This not only surprised them but also the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
Within the circle of demigod-level powerhouses, curiosity about the new Saint Master of the Witch Race is quite piqued.
Hence, they also want to see how skilled this new Saint Master of the Witch Race truly is.
Seeing Han Xing pondering.
At that moment, a voice suddenly resonated in his ear.
"Saint Master Han Xing, our Clan Leader asked me to deliver you a message."
"This time, it’s not that he didn’t want to act, but truly our Clan Leader has his own troubles."
Upon receiving this transmission, Han Xing lifted his head.
His gaze fell upon a tree spirit in the council hall, towering three meters high, body adorned with countless branches.
Han Xing had seen its true form.
Actually over ten thousand meters tall, a very colossal ancient tree.
At this moment, eyes and nose have actually grown from the trunk of that tree spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 321: Invisible Hand, Han Xing’s Influence!
paragraphs: The Tree Spirit Legend looked at Han Xing with a somewhat eerie smile.
Han Xing slightly nodded, gesturing for him to continue speaking.
The Tree Spirit Legend hurriedly communicated telepathically.
"Saint Master Han Xing, in our Sky Island Forest, a terrifying phenomenon has emerged in recent years!"
"All the plants have lost their life essence overnight, with their bodies rapidly withering."
"Moreover, some plants have undergone various horrific mutations, growing flesh tentacles and bizarre eyeballs!"
"These mutated plants have changed temperament in an instant and began to madly attack our kin."
"Even we Legends find it difficult to resist these curses!"
The Tree Spirit Legend continued to communicate telepathically.
"The entire Sky Island Forest has been plagued by this curse for many years!"
"And not just our Sky Island Forest, the situation in the Beastman Kingdom is even more bizarre than ours!"
"It’s said that even their King has been eroded by this curse..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was a bit surprised.
The Beastman King is clearly a Demigod level existence.
What kind of curse could affect a being of this level?
Han Xing’s gaze turned to those Beastmen.
He noticed a hint of pleading in their eyes.
Han Xing suddenly understood.
It seems that these two groups of legendary powerhouses have already discussed it in private.
This indirectly indicates that what the Tree Spirit Legend said is true.
The situations of the Beastman Kingdom and the Sky Island Forest are quite bleak.
Moreover, this curse sounds somewhat similar to the previous Blood Tide mutations.
"Could it be the handiwork of an Otherworldly Evil God again?" Han Xing thought to himself.
A moment later, he shook his head.
Regardless of whose handiwork it is, it’s not something he can handle.
Han Xing didn’t understand why they were seeking him out for matters regarding the curse.
Han Xing intended to decline tactfully.
The Tree Spirit Legend hurriedly said, "It’s like this, Saint Master Han Xing."
"Over the years of researching this curse, our Clan Leader has already found the source of the curse."
"At first, we all thought it was the means of an Otherworldly Evil God, but in fact, we were wrong."
"The presence spreading the curse is right within our Sky Island Forest!"
"However, the opponent is extremely powerful, and even our Clan Leader is not confident in defeating them."
"And now, the demigod level experts in the Holy Spirit Realm are facing various troubles, just like the Beastman King, everyone is on edge."
"So they can’t make a move easily."
"Now, only you possess the power capable of dealing with a demigod and can move freely in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"Our Clan Leader hopes that you can lend a helping hand and jointly uproot the source of the curse!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly felt a heavy weight in his heart.
Though the Tree Spirit Legend spoke nonchalantly, Han Xing keenly grasped a crucial point.
That is, the current demigods of the Holy Spirit Realm are all encountering troubles and cannot act freely.
The Sky Island Forest is fighting against the curse, and even the Beastman King has been eroded by it.
The other three major clans are also facing unfavorable situations.
The Elf Race is combating the Demon Race and resolving the Dark Elf rebellion.
The Dwarf Race and Giant Race are caught in a civil war.
The Holy Spirit Realm seems to be embroiled in deep turmoil.
Thinking of the enemies of the Witch Race, the Shadow Legion...
Han Xing suddenly took a deep breath!
He seemed to see a pair of hands...
An invisible pair of large hands, manipulating everything from behind!
But due to the lack of crucial information, Han Xing couldn’t deduce whose methods these were!
Seeing Han Xing frowning deeply.
All the legends present naturally knew that someone was communicating telepathically with Han Xing.
Yet since Han Xing remained silent, no one dared to speak.
At this moment, the Tree Spirit Legend suddenly spoke up, "Saint Master Han Xing, our Clan Leader in the Sky Island Forest welcomes your visit at any time."
"The Clan Leader also said, after this is over, he can even open the treasure vault of our Tree Spirit Race for you."
"Whether it’s a Demigod level Life Core or a Divine Artifact level piece of equipment, you’re free to choose!"
This time, the Tree Spirit Legend didn’t communicate telepathically but spoke directly.
Everyone present was taken aback.
Before they could speak.
Beside them, another Beastman Legend stepped forward and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, our King means the same."
"After the matter is settled, we are willing to open the royal treasure vault for you, our Beastman Race also possesses many unique and precious items."
"Such as the Blood of the Barbarian God, the Soul of the King, and Divine Artifacts, among others..."
"These items are coveted even by demigods!"
"We sincerely hope Saint Master Han Xing can lend a helping hand for the sake of this matter!"
Not only did they offer generous terms.
They also used their timely support as a favor chip.
From this, it can be seen how eager they are for Han Xing to come and assist.
Wu Ling’Er and a group of Witch Race Legends, hearing their requests, wanted to speak but hesitated.
But Han Xing didn’t speak, so they dared not say a word.
At this moment, Han Xing was also deep in thought.
This time, the leaders of Sky Island Forest and the Beastman Kingdom invited him to resolve the trouble.
And presented various precious conditions.
Han Xing didn’t know what the so-called ’Demigod level Life Core’ and ’Blood of the Barbarian God’ were.
But even Divine Artifacts were mere add-ons, these items must be extremely valuable.
However—
Han Xing was somewhat aware of his own strength.
With the title of [Witch Race Saint Master] in effect.
Going all out, handling generally Middle-tier Legends and High-tier Legends shouldn’t be a problem.

"Could it be the handiwork of an Otherworldly Evil God again?" Han Xing thought to himself.
A moment later, he shook his head.
Regardless of whose handiwork it is, it’s not something he can handle.
Han Xing didn’t understand why they were seeking him out for matters regarding the curse.
Han Xing intended to decline tactfully.
The Tree Spirit Legend hurriedly said, "It’s like this, Saint Master Han Xing."
"Over the years of researching this curse, our Clan Leader has already found the source of the curse."
"At first, we all thought it was the means of an Otherworldly Evil God, but in fact, we were wrong."
"The presence spreading the curse is right within our Sky Island Forest!"
"However, the opponent is extremely powerful, and even our Clan Leader is not confident in defeating them."
"And now, the demigod level experts in the Holy Spirit Realm are facing various troubles, just like the Beastman King, everyone is on edge."
"So they can’t make a move easily."
"Now, only you possess the power capable of dealing with a demigod and can move freely in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"Our Clan Leader hopes that you can lend a helping hand and jointly uproot the source of the curse!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly felt a heavy weight in his heart.
Though the Tree Spirit Legend spoke nonchalantly, Han Xing keenly grasped a crucial point.
That is, the current demigods of the Holy Spirit Realm are all encountering troubles and cannot act freely.
The Sky Island Forest is fighting against the curse, and even the Beastman King has been eroded by it.
The other three major clans are also facing unfavorable situations.
The Elf Race is combating the Demon Race and resolving the Dark Elf rebellion.
The Dwarf Race and Giant Race are caught in a civil war.
The Holy Spirit Realm seems to be embroiled in deep turmoil.
Thinking of the enemies of the Witch Race, the Shadow Legion...
Han Xing suddenly took a deep breath!
He seemed to see a pair of hands...
An invisible pair of large hands, manipulating everything from behind!
But due to the lack of crucial information, Han Xing couldn’t deduce whose methods these were!
Seeing Han Xing frowning deeply.
All the legends present naturally knew that someone was communicating telepathically with Han Xing.
Yet since Han Xing remained silent, no one dared to speak.
At this moment, the Tree Spirit Legend suddenly spoke up, "Saint Master Han Xing, our Clan Leader in the Sky Island Forest welcomes your visit at any time."
"The Clan Leader also said, after this is over, he can even open the treasure vault of our Tree Spirit Race for you."
"Whether it’s a Demigod level Life Core or a Divine Artifact level piece of equipment, you’re free to choose!"
This time, the Tree Spirit Legend didn’t communicate telepathically but spoke directly.
Everyone present was taken aback.
Before they could speak.
Beside them, another Beastman Legend stepped forward and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, our King means the same."
"After the matter is settled, we are willing to open the royal treasure vault for you, our Beastman Race also possesses many unique and precious items."
"Such as the Blood of the Barbarian God, the Soul of the King, and Divine Artifacts, among others..."
"These items are coveted even by demigods!"
"We sincerely hope Saint Master Han Xing can lend a helping hand for the sake of this matter!"
Not only did they offer generous terms.
They also used their timely support as a favor chip.
From this, it can be seen how eager they are for Han Xing to come and assist.
Wu Ling’Er and a group of Witch Race Legends, hearing their requests, wanted to speak but hesitated.
But Han Xing didn’t speak, so they dared not say a word.
At this moment, Han Xing was also deep in thought.
This time, the leaders of Sky Island Forest and the Beastman Kingdom invited him to resolve the trouble.
And presented various precious conditions.
Han Xing didn’t know what the so-called ’Demigod level Life Core’ and ’Blood of the Barbarian God’ were.
But even Divine Artifacts were mere add-ons, these items must be extremely valuable.
However—
Han Xing was somewhat aware of his own strength.
With the title of [Witch Race Saint Master] in effect.
Going all out, handling generally Middle-tier Legends and High-tier Legends shouldn’t be a problem.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 321: Invisible Hand, Han Xing’s Influence!
paragraphs: However, to deal with a demigod, one can only rely on the power of the entire Witch Race Continent.
And it is impossible for him to carry the entire continent around.
The Divine Artifact is tempting, but one must have the life to claim it.
Besides, now he also doesn’t lack equipment.
However, in front of so many people, Han Xing also did not want to embarrass the other party.
After all, this time, the other party did indeed help them.
Since ancient times, personal debts have been the hardest to repay.
Especially in exchanges between such large clans, they often involve interests.
So, Han Xing smiled faintly and said, "We can talk, we can talk, I will definitely visit your Sky Island Forest when I have time."
"And the Beastman Kingdom as well."
He only said ’when I have time,’ but didn’t specify when exactly,
if he goes after a few years, they can’t really say anything.
When they heard Han Xing agree, this group of Legendary Powerhouses collectively sighed in relief.
Although they also knew that Han Xing was trying to temporarily placate everyone.
But reaching this extent was already enough.
As long as they got Han Xing’s verbal promise, what harm was there in waiting a few more years?
After a few more words were exchanged here and there.
These Legendary Powerhouses wisely prepared to take their leave.
"Saint Master Han Xing, it’s getting late."
"You’ve just been through a fierce battle here and must have a lot to deal with, and we need to report what happened here as soon as possible."
"So, we won’t disturb you any longer."
Han Xing nodded.
The Legends all stood up to leave.
However, just as they reached the doorway of the council hall and were about to leave.
Suddenly—
Han Xing felt several eerie gazes fixated on him!
Their stares bore hostility, as if ready to strike at any moment!
Han Xing instantly became alert.
He quietly mobilized the Defense Towers of the entire Sky Island Continent, ready to unleash a thunderous strike!
At the same time, Han Xing felt deeply puzzled in his heart.
This was inside his own Ten Thousand Stars City.
The Shadow Legion had just been repelled by him, so where had these enemies come from?
Han Xing scanned the entire council hall.
The next moment.
He instantly pinpointed the source of those gazes.
It was precisely those Legends who were preparing to leave!
Behind them, Han Xing saw patches of rotting skin.
Their flesh was bruised and purplish, as if it had ulcerated, oozing pus and blood...
Moreover, amidst these decayed areas, something seemed to be writhing.
The next moment, from beneath the layers of skin, a scarlet eyeball emerged.
Those eyes stared fixedly at Han Xing, seemingly issuing a warning!
Han Xing held his gaze with those eyeballs for a long while.
After a moment.
Han Xing’s lips curled into a peculiar smile.
Interesting, is this a warning to mind my own business?
It seems the matter behind this runs deep...
Not only Han Xing, but obviously other Witch Race Legends also saw this scene.
Yet, none of them spoke.
Only after those Legends had left.
Did someone in the council hall breathe a gentle sigh?
Wu Ling’Er finally spoke: "Saint Master, I suggest you don’t get involved in the curse events of the Sky Island Forest and the Beastman Kingdom."
"The situation might be more complicated than we imagined."
Han Xing looked at Wu Ling’Er, gesturing for her to continue.
Wu Ling’Er said: "This curse showed signs decades ago."
"Back then, they also invited Saint Master Helaas to go along."
"But even then, Saint Master Helaas couldn’t eliminate the curse’s source, and even brought back some injuries."
"At that time, I heard the Saint Master say they seemed to have been heading in the wrong direction..."
"This curse doesn’t come from the Otherworldly Evil God, but from an even more eerie power..."
Hearing these words, Han Xing was stunned.
Because initially, he too speculated it was a curse from an alternate space.
Now it seems, that’s not the case?
So, what’s behind this remains to be seen.
Besides the Otherworldly Evil God, what kind of existence could wield such powerful curse power.
Is it a person or an entity spreading the curse?
Or perhaps, as Wu Ling’Er said.
It’s actually an even more bizarre power?
All these revelations carried an unusual flavor.
Rationality told Han Xing not to get involved lightly.
However, he wasn’t overly concerned either.
Given the animosity and warning from those eyeballs, the entity spreading the curse clearly didn’t want Han Xing to meddle.
This suggests they feared Han Xing to some extent too.
Shaking his head.
Han Xing soon put all these matters out of mind.
However, what he didn’t know was.
Shortly after the group of Legends from the Beastman Kingdom and the Elf Forest left Ten Thousand Stars City.
And as they were about to head to the Witch Race border, returning to their realms.
The body of a Beastman Legend suddenly shivered mid-air.
Without their noticing.
A bizarre eyeball inexplicably detached from the decaying part of that Beastman Legend’s back.
The other Legendary Powerhouses asked, puzzled: "Dashun, what’s wrong with you?"
The Beastman glanced at his back in doubt, and then slowly said: "Nothing."
"I guess I just imagined it."
After hearing this, the other powerhouses didn’t pursue further questions.
And instead, they split into two routes, heading back to their own territories.
At that moment, the eyeball that had detached, streaked through mid-air with strings of pus and blood.
It seemed to have an autonomous ability to move.
After detaching from its host, it quickly landed atop Ten Thousand Stars City.
In front of it, appeared a Witch Race soldier cleaning up the battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - 321: Invisible Hand, Han Xing’s Faction! (3)
paragraphs: The next moment.
The eyeball sped up instantly and suddenly drilled into the soldier’s body.
The soldier trembled all over, suddenly opened his mouth, seemingly wanting to call for help.
However, before he could make a sound, his actions had already stopped.
He stood frozen in place, as if he was cast with an Immovable Spell.
Moments later, a strange smile appeared on the soldier’s iron-blue face.
He glanced towards the area where Ten Thousand Stars City was located, and turned to walk towards the gathering crowd...
At this time in the council hall, only the group of Witch Race Legends and Han Xing remained.
In other words, these were all their own people.
They didn’t need to introduce themselves, Han Xing could know the name and strength of each one.
Moreover, there were even some other attributes.
For example.
Han Xing casually glanced at a Witch Race priest.
[Name]: Ao Guqi
[Level]: LV53 (Initial-stage Legend)
[Attributes]: Power 15073, agility 13482, Spirit 16273, Constitution 17283.
[Divine Power Value]: 832 (Legend exclusive)
[Skills]: Witch Rune Control, Secret Pattern Domain, Forbidden Technique - Eighteen Celestial Swords...
[Equipment]: Haisengge Breastplate (Orange), Inscribed Sword (Orange), Witch’s Heart Ring (Orange)...
[Affiliated Faction]: Han Xing’s Faction.
[Position Held]: Witch Race’s 16th Priest.
[Comprehensive Evaluation]: Excellent (Camp Fortune Value +100.)
This panel information is extremely detailed.
Aside from the opponent’s attributes and strength, even their equipment and skills are clearly displayed.
There are also corresponding faction introductions and fortune value bonuses.
Han Xing glanced at others.
Found that most of these legendary powerhouses could bring 100 points of fortune value to the faction.
And two of the middle-tier legends could add 200 points of fortune value.
Among them, High Priest Xiao and Wu Ling’Er each added 600 points and 500 points of fortune value respectively.
This made Han Xing show a thoughtful expression.
He naturally saw the camp fortune value feature.
The higher the camp’s fortune value, the stronger the overall amplification strength.
Calculating this way, an ordinary legend could at least increase 100 points of fortune value, which is an attribute bonus of 0.1% for the whole camp.
In other words, if there were a thousand legendary powerhouses in their faction, it could directly provide 100% attribute boost and experience acquisition speed.
This effect is almost comparable to the amplification brought by a divine artifact.
Moreover, this isn’t just any divine artifact.
But a boost enjoyed by all Witch Race people and the Human Race.
Over a hundred billion people could enjoy this amplification!
This effect is explosively good!
While a thousand legendary powerhouses might sound like a wild dream.
But Han Xing knows, based on human strength and growth speed.
Surely this goal can be achieved.
And Han Xing looked at himself.
Found he could surprisingly increase the camp’s fortune value by 500 points.
This might be related to his strength and potential.
Plus, considering he is the Witch Race Saint Master, adding this much fortune value is a normal situation.
Then, Han Xing said: "If there’s nothing else, everyone can disperse."
Other Witch Race legends looked at each other in confusion and then glanced at Han Xing in unison.
Han Xing was puzzled: "Why are you all staring at me?"
"Were you guys expecting me to say something?"
The group of Witch Race legends froze instantly.
Uh... shouldn’t you say something?
You’re just made the Witch Race Saint Master!
However, Han Xing rolled his eyes at them and said.
"Okay, go do what you need to do."
"Although I’ve become this Saint Master, I don’t want to meddle in your Witch Race internal affairs much."
"Whatever was, still is."
"In the future, if there are any issues, you can contact Wu Ling’Er directly, she can make decisions on my behalf."
Han Xing finished speaking.
At this moment, that group of Witch Race legends laughed together.
They cupped their hands and said: "Saint Master, wise!"
Before this, these people indeed thought that since Han Xing had just become the Saint Master, he would make bold changes.
As the saying goes, a new ruler brings new ministers.
The current Witch Race is no longer called Witch Race but Han Xing’s faction.
And Han Xing is from the Human Race.
The entire faction’s high-end management is from the Witch Race.
Hence, they thought Han Xing would arrange some Human Race members into the Witch Race’s core management.
It’s called management, but it’s essentially supervision.
These Witch Race legends were already prepared for this.
But in reality, Han Xing doesn’t bother with them at all.
Not to mention the Human Race doesn’t have strong powerhouses to show right now.
Even if there were, Han Xing wouldn’t plan to arrange them into the Witch Race for power struggle.
Just focus on leveling up diligently!
Better to quickly level up to 50.
Then become a legendary powerhouse, which could help Han Xing and the entire camp.
The group of Witch Race legends, with smiling faces, successively took their leave.
They indeed have many things to handle.
When the council hall was left with only Han Xing.
Excitement again shone in his eyes.
"Great, they finally all left."
"Now, no one can disturb me from checking the treasures I just received!"
Yes, Han Xing couldn’t wait to check those two super-awesome rewards he just obtained.
One divine-level necklace and a holy artifact-level blueprint!
With a look of anticipation, Han Xing first checked the attributes of that necklace.
[Helas’ Royal Authority Necklace (Red) lv60, Quality: Divine Artifact, Spirit +2000, Constitution +2000.]

[Attached Effect]: Supreme Magic Amplification (Magic Damage increases by 33%), Advanced Magic Shield (Magic Cube Resistance increases by 18%), Magnifying Glass (Legendary Effect, 33% chance to enlarge skills when attacking), Power of Royal Authority (Divine-level Effect)
[Power of Royal Authority]: Wearing this necklace continually grants the Power of Royal Authority bonus, each enemy killed increases Spirit attribute by 1 (no limit), effect lasts 120 seconds.
Note: Helas’ personal necklace, it’s said to have the blessing effect bestowed by the Witch God personally.
"Awesome!"

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 322: Holy Artifact Stele: No. 2
paragraphs: "Awesome!"
Han Xing immediately gave a thumbs up.
This thing, no doubt it’s Helas’ personal necklace; its attributes are incredibly powerful!
Especially the Legendary Effect and Divine-level Effect at the end, any one of them can provide a Mage with tremendous help!
Although it is Magic System equipment, it doesn’t stop Han Xing from letting Zhang Lianmeng use this necklace.
However, the only pity is that this is Level 60 equipment.
That means, at the very least, they have to wait until they breakthrough the Fifth Transformation and reach the Level Limit for Tier Five to equip it.
Right now, their leveling speed has slowed down significantly.
After advancing to the Fifth Transformation, the experience required will be even more terrifying.
That’s something that won’t happen for a long time.
Han Xing directly put this equipment back behind him.
Then.
With anticipation, he began to check the other reward item.
[Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele Blueprint 2]
The next moment, Han Xing clapped his hands and immediately clicked to learn it.
In the crafting menu, the properties of this blueprint appeared.
[Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele 2]: Special type building.
[Building Effect]: Increases the effect of the Sun Crown Stele again, raising the level cap of buildings.
For each level the Sun Crown Stele increases, all building levels are raised by lv1 (range, rate of fire, attack range, armor, attack power, all increased by 10%).
Note: After successfully building Sun Crown Stele 2, the level cap is raised to Level 20. You can search for more Sun Crown Steles to combine and increase the level cap.
It was just as Han Xing expected.
The function of number 2 is to continue elevating the level of the Sun Crown Stele.
Accordingly, the levels of those Defense Towers can be enhanced again.
Once it’s maxed out, it can go from the original 100% all-around improvement to 200%.
This is another terrifying boost.
By then, Han Xing is confident that a concentrated fire attack could completely annihilate a demigod-level powerhouse!
And not just any demigod.
But someone like the Dark Shadow Monarch, a strong figure among demigods!
However...
According to the materials needed for crafting the first Holy Artifact.
The second Sun Crown Stele Blueprint requires absolutely extraordinary materials.
With an anxious heart, Han Xing checked the crafting interface.

[Materials needed to build Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele 2]: Philosopher’s Stone*50,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*50,000, Shadow Divine Stone*100,000, Rhythm Black Iron*200,000, Calamity Divine Gold*500, Giant Dragon Soul (Demigod)*1.
Seeing the crafting requirements.
Han Xing rolled his eyes.
The materials needed earlier are still normal.
Once the entire Witch Race Continent was merged into his territory.
Han Xing’s assets skyrocketed by tens of thousands of times.
The materials mentioned before seem to be obtainable.
But when it comes to the Calamity Divine Gold, it’s a bit ridiculous.
It requires 500 pieces!
The entire Witch Race’s reserve doesn’t even have a little over a hundred pieces.
This kind of material must be an extremely precious metal.
However, more absurd than the Calamity Divine Gold is the last requirement.
It actually requires a Giant Dragon Soul of Demigod level!
Never mind if the Holy Spirit Realm has a demigod-level Giant Dragon for Han Xing to hunt.
Even if there is.
Han Xing thinks he’s unlikely to be the opponent of such a Giant Dragon.
Although he now has the power to face demigods.
But that’s within the territory of the Witch Race.
Only by gathering the power of an entire continent can he contend with a demigod.
He can’t carry an entire continent around.
At this point, Han Xing could only sigh helplessly.
As expected, crafting any Holy Artifact is not easy.
This matter must be planned carefully over the long term.
However, this does not prevent Han Xing from having other ways to improve.
That is, to exchange for an Advanced Ancient Weapon Blueprint from the Battle Merit Store!
This time, the Shadow Legion mobilized an unknown amount of forces to deal with the Witch Race.
And since Han Xing is now the master of the Witch Race.
NNaturally, he must exercise this authority.
Han Xing’s first command was.
To have the soldiers collect all the Shadow Crystals dropped within the territory.
The officers willingly accepted the orders.
They had no objections to this new Saint Master, quite the contrary, they had a good impression of him.
In no time, within the territory of the Witch Race, tens of billions of elite Witch Race soldiers eagerly collected these materials for Han Xing.
Meanwhile.
Deep within the Path of the Giant Dragon.
A man and a woman, braving the harsh environment, continued to advance.
At this time, the seductive woman’s usual nonchalant demeanor was gone.
With a somewhat serious tone, she said, "Dark Shadow, you disappoint me."
Next to her, the Shadow Monarch remained silent.
After all, he had already explained the situation.
This time, too many unforeseen incidents occurred, way more than he had expected.
He and this woman were merely in a cooperative relationship, not superior and subordinate.
Therefore, the Shadow Monarch saw no need to explain further.
The atmosphere suddenly fell silent.
After a moment.
The alluring woman took the initiative to say, "Dark Shadow, how many years did it take you to ascend from a mere mortal to a demigod?"
The reticent Shadow simply replied with two words, "A thousand years."
The alluring woman nodded slightly, saying, "That’s right, even a being like you took a full thousand years to reach demigod status."
"Previously, I had been keeping an eye on the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"This generation of the Human Race appeared in the Holy Spirit Realm just over a year ago."
"And yet, already one who could challenge demigods has emerged."
"Have you figured out the new Human Emperor’s secret?"
However, the Dark Shadow shook his head and said, "He is not the Human Emperor."
"He does not possess the Human Emperor’s Destiny."
