chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 322: Holy Artifact Stele: Serial Number 2_2
paragraphs: Upon hearing these words, even the alluring woman was taken aback.
Not the Human Emperor?
Then this human is even more terrifying!
The Land of the Abandoned Gods has birthed countless generations of the Human Race, most of whom were wiped out in the first disaster wave.
Occasionally, there emerged figures who rose strongly, even leading their entire race out of the Land of the Abandoned.
These individuals, without exception, were all contemporary Human Emperors.
They possessed extreme talent and fortune, enabling them to rise swiftly.
Yet, this new Witch Race Saint Master, is not a Human Emperor?
The alluring woman seemed to be contemplating.
However, with her experience, she couldn’t find anyone comparable to Han Xing in her mind.
At this moment, a solemn expression flashed in her eyes.
A strong curiosity arose in her heart towards the never-before-seen Witch Race new Saint Master.
The alluring woman extended her warm tongue, licking her lips.
Then, she showed a strange smile.
The Shadow Monarch noticed her expression and asked, "Are you going to make a move against him?"
The alluring woman chuckled lightly, "Make a move? Are you overestimating me?"
"I’m just a weak woman; my real combat strength doesn’t even compare to yours; how could I make a move against him?"
The Shadow Monarch snorted coldly, indifferent to the alluring woman’s words.
He, better than anyone, knew how terrifying this woman was.
Now, she was pretending to be weak in front of him.
At this moment, the alluring woman chuckled again, "Hehe..."
"But, hearing you say so makes me quite curious about this new Saint Master..."
"Given his growth rate, it probably won’t be long before he possesses the power to pose a fatal threat to a demigod."
"It looks like I’ll need to use some methods to control his growth speed."
The Shadow Monarch raised his head, "What do you plan to do?"
The alluring woman was silent for a moment.
"Open the Void Gate and release those Void Beasts to devour the whole Witch Race Territory."
"I believe these Void Beasts will give him quite a headache."
"If unlucky, and he encounters the Void Royal Family, then his troubles will be huge!"
"Hehe~
The Shadow Monarch’s expression turned severe.
"Void Gate, Royal Family..."
After the battle.
The entire Witch Race territory entered a busy state.
Everywhere was repairing post-war damages.
Counting the wounded, comforting the populace.
Time flew by, and a week had passed.
At this time, Han Xing was standing on the peak of a mountain outside Ten Thousand Stars City.
In front of him was a Long-armed Fierce Ape, constantly performing backflips.
"Ooh! Ooh!"
The Long-armed Fierce Ape lifted its arms high, performing a brilliant backflip with complete skill.
Sometimes, it also did high-difficulty acrobatic moves, then ran to Han Xing for commendation.
At this moment, Han Xing would smile and toss a Spirit Core into its mouth.
The Long-armed Fierce Ape jumped up, precisely catching it.
Just like a horse-hoofed monkey after being tamed.
Since being forced by Han Xing to sign the Lord Contract.
It obediently stayed in a piece of woodland, rarely showing signs of activity.
It seemed to deliberately diminish its presence, wanting Han Xing to forget its existence.
However, it was unaware that it had already caught Han Xing’s attention.
When subduing this Long-armed Fierce Ape, Han Xing noticed its loyalty was strangely low.
It could actually break through the system’s forced loyalty limit of 80 points, reaching 45.
Initially, Han Xing didn’t pay much attention.
But especially in recent times, Han Xing noticed its loyalty was continuously declining.
So, Han Xing immediately came over, wanting to explore the secrets of this Long-armed Fierce Ape.
Before him appeared the panel attributes of the ape.
[Long-armed Fierce Ape: Four-star Leader-level Creatures]
[Level]: 45.
[Attributes]: Power 4372, Agility 3892, Spirit 3763, Constitution 4012.
[Loyalty]: 36 (approaching rebellion)
When the Long-armed Fierce Ape saw Han Xing coming, it immediately showed an obsequious demeanor, even proactively offering a few wild fruits.
However, looking at the panel with the bright red annotation [approaching rebellion].
Han Xing just laughed.
This guy has secrets!
So, Han Xing patiently continued acting along with this Long-armed Fierce Ape.
He pretended to be unaware of its intent to rebel.
Running over every day, he trained it with discipline.
Sometimes, letting the Long-armed Ape hold a piece of Rhythm Black Iron, running a marathon.
Other times, making it jump into a lava pool for a hot bath.
Now, Han Xing began having it learn various high-difficulty acrobatics.
It was truly the Iron Monkey Triathlon.
However, this Long-armed Fierce Ape was peculiar.
No matter what orders Han Xing gave it, it executed them unwaveringly.
After completion, it enthusiastically sought praise from Han Xing.
If Han Xing hadn’t seen its loyalty drop by two more points.
He would have thought the ape was that loyal.
Before Han Xing could think further.
In the sky, two massive shadows suddenly descended upon this small hill.
They were two Big-beaked Birds.
As Han Xing’s level rose to 50, the level of these Big-beaked Birds also increased.
Now, their size exploded yet again, boasting a body length of twenty meters, truly giant behemoths!
At this moment, two figures jumped down from the Big-beaked Birds.
It was Cheng Jianyong, dressed in a skeleton suit, and Shen Yun wrapped like a piece of Black Iron.
At this moment, they glanced at Han Xing, then at the Long-armed Fierce Ape performing backflips beside him.

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - 322: Holy Artifact Stele: No. 2_3
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong cheerfully said, "Brother Xing, here to play with this monkey again?"
Han Xing shrugged, "Yeah, there’s nothing much to do lately, and with the Great Demon Monarch causing trouble in the Abyssal Rift, I’ve come to find this monkey."
Despite being called a monkey, the Long-armed Fierce Ape didn’t get angry; instead, it squeezed out a flattering smile while looking at them.
Shen Yun also said with interest, "This Long-armed Fierce Ape is indeed interesting; its intelligence is much higher than that of ordinary beast monsters."
"Do you think there’s some kind of secret behind this guy?"
Upon hearing Shen Yun’s words, the Long-armed Fierce Ape’s expression suddenly froze.
It seemed surprised that its attempt to appear friendly had somehow drawn extra attention.
The Long-armed Fierce Ape cautiously lifted its head, nervously glancing at Han Xing.
But Han Xing casually said, "What intelligence—it’s just a monkey."
"It’s just something to pass the time with when bored."
These words made the Long-armed Fierce Ape sigh in relief.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun didn’t pay any mind.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong seemed to remember something urgent, quickly saying, "Oh right, Brother Xing, we found what you asked us to look for!"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, "Found it? Where is it?"
He appeared very excited.
Cheng Jianyong immediately replied, "At the Witch Race Border, on a gigantic Sky Island!"
"It appears to be an island that floated in from the outside not long ago, guarded by an extremely powerful creature."
"Xiaoyunzi and I tested its strength, which matches exactly what Brother Xing needed."
"Level 52, Dominator-level creature!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing instantly got excited.
Because, a week ago, he had just reached level 50 full level and was ready to advance.
However, the mission required him to solo challenge a five-star Dominator-level creature.
He couldn’t have any assistance from teammates.
So, Han Xing had been searching for the right target all along.
During this period, without any expeditions to the Abyssal Rift, team members had nothing to do and also helped in finding one for Han Xing.
Efforts weren’t wasted; they actually found it!
Han Xing couldn’t wait to say, "Let’s go! Take me to that Sky Island!"
"Today, I shall breakthrough into legend! Complete advancement!"
"Alright!"
The two readily agreed.
Then, each jumped onto a Big-beaked Bird.
Cheng Jianyong made a gesture inviting Han Xing, "Brother Xing, hop on!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing also leapt onto the Big-beaked Bird’s back.
In the next moment.
The Big-beaked Bird flapped its wings in place.
Whoosh—
Whoosh—
The gust of wind almost toppled over the Long-armed Fierce Ape.
But it dared not make any move.
Only when Han Xing and the others disappeared into the sky did the Long-armed Fierce Ape breathe a heavy sigh of relief.
A moment later, the Long-armed Fierce Ape’s eyes flickered with an expression of struggle.
It looked at the distant sky and then at Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City.
It seemed to be planning an escape.
However.
What it didn’t know was.
Ever since Han Xing merged with the Witch Race Continent, the thousands of Towers of True Sight had been monitoring every corner of the continent.
Including its every move.
As soon as it showed any signs of escape.
What awaited was the concentrated attack from hundreds of Towers of Witch Soul!
By then, even if it indeed had some kind of secret.
Han Xing wouldn’t hesitate to destroy it on the spot.
Before that happens, the Long-armed Fierce Ape could only hope it wouldn’t have such thoughts.
The two Big-beaked Birds carried the three people.
Freely soaring through the skies over the Witch Race Continent.
Occasionally, they could spot other Big-beaked Birds.
As a flying unit in Han Xing’s territory.
Their large size and excellent combat prowess amazed the Witch Race soldiers and the human Survivors below.
Especially when they saw Han Xing and the others riding the Big-beaked Birds soaring through the sky, they were even more envious.
Many human Survivors were trying to capture some wild creatures.
Then use the Lord Contract Scroll to make it their mount.
However much they captured from the wild in the Sky Island.
They found it still couldn’t compare to the majesty of the Big-beaked Bird.
Currently, many Survivors were jointly petitioning to obtain one or two Big-beaked Birds from Han Xing as flying mounts.
This matter, Han Xing hasn’t responded to yet, planning to address it later.
Soon.
The two Big-beaked Birds carried the three, flying back to the Lord’s Mansion in Ten Thousand Stars City.
Below.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang had already been waiting here upon receiving news.
Looking at the two graceful figures below.
Han Xing summoned the [Oracle Throne], his figure flashed, appearing before them.
Then, Han Xing smiled and said, "Let’s go, after resting for a week, it’s time to get moving."
The two girls nodded simultaneously.
"Mm-hmm."
In the next moment.
Han Xing took out a small square block one meter in length and width from his backpack.
It was a core territory.
With a single-handed gesture.
Next moment—
The ground in a ten thousand kilometer radius began to tremble violently.
Rumble!
The Witch Race civilians living on the continent were greatly surprised.
Those unaware of the situation might have thought some change occurred.
However, when they saw that the ancient Towers of Witch Soul and True Spirit Towers in the main city were all rising from the ground.
And moving towards the same place.
A strong sense of shock appeared in their eyes!
This was Han Xing’s handiwork!
This time, he was going to visit the Witch Race Border.
Concerned about potential trouble along the way.
He mobilized a thousand High-level Defense Towers from the entire Witch Race Continent!
As mentioned before, bringing a whole continent to fight might seem exaggerated.
But he with the power to relocate most High-level Defense Towers from the Witch Race Continent.
After all, Han Xing was now the master here, everything here already belonged to him.
He could mobilize however many Defense Towers he wanted.
Then.
Several figures of Witch Race Legends suddenly appeared in the distance.
They looked at Han Xing with full curiosity.

Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang had already been waiting here upon receiving news.
Looking at the two graceful figures below.
Han Xing summoned the [Oracle Throne], his figure flashed, appearing before them.
Then, Han Xing smiled and said, "Let’s go, after resting for a week, it’s time to get moving."
The two girls nodded simultaneously.
"Mm-hmm."
In the next moment.
Han Xing took out a small square block one meter in length and width from his backpack.
It was a core territory.
With a single-handed gesture.
Next moment—
The ground in a ten thousand kilometer radius began to tremble violently.
Rumble!
The Witch Race civilians living on the continent were greatly surprised.
Those unaware of the situation might have thought some change occurred.
However, when they saw that the ancient Towers of Witch Soul and True Spirit Towers in the main city were all rising from the ground.
And moving towards the same place.
A strong sense of shock appeared in their eyes!
This was Han Xing’s handiwork!
This time, he was going to visit the Witch Race Border.
Concerned about potential trouble along the way.
He mobilized a thousand High-level Defense Towers from the entire Witch Race Continent!
As mentioned before, bringing a whole continent to fight might seem exaggerated.
But he with the power to relocate most High-level Defense Towers from the Witch Race Continent.
After all, Han Xing was now the master here, everything here already belonged to him.
He could mobilize however many Defense Towers he wanted.
Then.
Several figures of Witch Race Legends suddenly appeared in the distance.
They looked at Han Xing with full curiosity.

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - 323: Legendary Advancement Unlocked!
paragraphs: These Witch Race Legends seem to have been attracted by the commotion here, following those high-tier defense towers over.
When they saw that all this was the handiwork of Han Xing, they felt incredibly surprised.
At this moment, a Witch Race Legend couldn’t help but ask, "Um... Saint Master, what are you doing?"
He wasn’t questioning Han Xing’s actions.
He was simply curious.
Han Xing glanced at him and said, "Can’t you understand?"
"I’m going out for a trip, afraid of unexpected situations on the road, taking some defense towers along."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s answer.
This group of Witch Race Legends couldn’t help but twitch their lips.
After all, such a thing has never happened before.
This new Witch Race Saint Master’s imagination and creativity are truly extraordinary.
A bit overly cautious too...
With his power, in the entire Witch Race Territory, he could be called invincible.
Yet he still needs to bring so many defense towers before daring to go out.
However, since it was Han Xing’s decision, the group of Witch Race Legends didn’t say much.
One by one, they cupped their fists in farewell.
A moment later.
An independent, floating island appeared in front of Han Xing once again.
The area wasn’t large, roughly two to three square kilometers.
But on it, there were a full thousand advanced defense towers!
The firepower on it could even instantly kill a high-tier Legend!
Even if encountering a Demigod, it could exert a strong deterrent force!
Enough firepower also brought a strong sense of security to Han Xing’s heart.
He nodded in satisfaction.
Then, Han Xing led everyone to jump onto the Sky Island.
And then, directly headed towards the destination.
After a dozen hours.
Han Xing’s Sky Island crossed hundreds of thousands of kilometers, arriving at the other side of the Witch Race Territory.
This is another border defense line of the Witch Race.
According to those Witch Race Legends.
Passing through this border defense line, what appears is not a new area.
But a vast expanse of space turbulence.
This space turbulence covers a wide range, and it expands every year.
However, it’s said that there are some powerful creatures inside.
One might find some unexpected treasures inside as well.
The previous Witch Race Saint Master Helas also went in to explore.
However, relying on his Half-Body Level strength, he didn’t reach the end of this space turbulence.
However, High Priest Xiao would also occasionally go inside to explore.
His Void Demon Stones were found from this space turbulence.
"Void Demon Stones..."
"I still lack quite a lot of these things."
"To transfer all of humanity’s billions of survivors here, it’s a massive project."
"Many high-level teleportation arrays need to be built."
"If there’s time, ensuring safety, we could explore over there."
Han Xing pondered for a moment and then shook his head.
This time.
They didn’t come to explore the space turbulence.
Han Xing’s target is a large nearby Sky Island.
As long as he takes out the Five-star Dominator Level creature on it, he can complete the system’s challenge mission.
Then, begin moving towards the next step in the legend.
Quickly, a large Witch Race Sky Island appeared in front of Han Xing.
Heavily guarded on it.
Among them is a Legendary Powerhouse stationed here long-term, specifically to guard against the Void’s expansion.
Han Xing has seen this Legendary Powerhouse.
His name is Otto, and he is not a Priest of the Witch Race, but a Legion Commander.
Since the last war ended, Otto quickly led the troops to settle here at the border.
Han Xing glanced at the heavily guarded Witch Race Sky Island and directly controlled the Sky Island to fly over.
The Witch Race soldiers below, upon knowing this piece of Sky Island belonged to Saint Master Han Xing.
Each of them stepped out of their residence, and with admiring gazes, watched Han Xing and the others depart.
Including that Legendary Powerhouse Otto, with respect shining in his eyes.
Regarding what Han Xing came here to do.
These Witch Race soldiers didn’t ask too much.
Continuing for about half an hour.
Three thousand kilometers from the border defense line.
From afar, Han Xing could even see a large dark area ahead.
There were various terrifying celestial phenomena on it.
That should be the so-called Void area.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said, "Brother Xing, we’re almost at the destination."
"The Sky Island we discovered is just ahead."
Han Xing nodded.
Looking along the direction Cheng Jianyong pointed.
Indeed, he saw a rather large.
At least a thousand square kilometers of giant cloud.
Faintly, there were bursts of purple lightning and red fire above.
Its powerful aura is enough to make ordinary Fifth Transformation beings feel strong oppression.
Han Xing looked at Cheng Jianyong beside him, "Have you investigated what monster it is inside?"
Cheng Jianyong replied, "We have investigated, Brother Xing. Seems to be a monster called the ’Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast.’"
"Divine Beast?"
The name surprised Han Xing.
Cheng Jianyong nodded, "Yes."
"Xiaoyunzi and I are not a match for this guy. We just glimpsed its name and level, then quickly fled."
"So we didn’t see what skills it has."
After speaking, Cheng Jianyong embarrassedly scratched his head.
Han Xing nodded and said, "It’s okay, your decision was correct."
"If you can’t beat it, run quickly. There’s nothing shameful about it."
"Preserving your life is the most important."
Han Xing summoned the Oracle Throne.
Then, standing on it, he said, "I’m going over. If you see anything unexpected, remember to come and rescue me."

chapters.title: Chapter 465 - 323: Legendary Advancement Unlocked!
paragraphs: The four of them listened and laughed together.
"Alright, Brother Xing, go ahead without worry."
Then, Han Xing stood on the Oracle Throne, approaching the massive cloud.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"This is a cloud sky island drifting from a far distance. It seems a divine spirit once descended here, and an ancient, divine creature has long inhabited this place... Would you like to enter?"
Hearing this prompt, Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
A divine spirit descended...
Are they the divine spirits from the Age of Ten Thousand Gods?
When it comes to this era, Han Xing feels a faint vigilance.
However, he was not particularly nervous.
As they had already interacted with the will of one of the divine spirits, they understood.
These divine spirits do not come to the Holy Spirit Realm easily.
Not only would they pay certain costs, but they would also be obstructed by certain existences.
Thus, he clicked yes.
The next moment.
The cloud dissipated.
In front of him appeared an extremely ancient complex of buildings.
These structures were like towering stone pillars, weathered by time.
These stone pillars had already collapsed one by one.
Turning into a ruin.
At the center of the ruins, Han Xing saw a strange creature.
This creature had a body that was thousands of meters long.
Half of its body was made of purple thunder crystal stone.
The other half was burning with fierce flames.
Its appearance was like a lizard with four corners.
From this creature, Han Xing sensed an aura that only legends possess.
[Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast: Five-Star Dominator]
[Level]: 52
[Attributes]: Power 15032, Agility 14271, Spirit 16764, Constitution 15872.
[Divine Power Value]: 671.
[Skills]: Thunder Crystal Flame Body, Elemental Fusion, Dual Domain, Ultimate Skill - Thunderfire Purgatory!

Note: The Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast was originally a legendary divine beast, but due to certain reasons, its divine power started to deplete, gradually falling from the legendary level, but its strength is still formidable.
Seeing the note above, Han Xing realized.
"Interesting, this monster actually fell from the legendary level.
"No wonder, its attributes are almost on par with those five-star legendary monsters!"
Looking at the surrounding ruins similar to a divine hall.
Han Xing faintly sensed.
This divine beast is likely also related to the group of divine spirits from the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
Meanwhile.
This lizard-like dual-attribute divine beast also noticed Han Xing.
Its two distinctively styled eyes instantly locked onto the enemy.
The next moment, it surprisingly spoke in human tongue.
"Insignificant... Human race, you must not desecrate... The holy land of descent..."
Its figure disappeared from its original spot.
It directly pounced towards Han Xing!
Its aggressive burst speed even created a giant pit where it stood!
From the attributes of this monster, it’s clear.
This is a creature with both high agility and spirit.
In other words, it excels in both close combat and magic attacks.
However, to Han Xing.
There’s no difference.
Because, his [Witch Race Saint Master] title has an effect.
’For any creature with average attributes below his, reduce their attribute values by 30%.’
The next moment.
The thunderfire...
No, the lizard monster’s form was suddenly forced out.
Because it clearly felt its attributes significantly drop.
The sudden loss of power.
Instilled a hint of fear in the eyes of this lizard monster.
However, what terrified it more was yet to come!
As its attributes decreased.
The momentum of this human increased at a terrifying rate!
Han Xing just slightly activated a few equipment effects.
Then slowly drew the longbow.
This lizard divine beast, as if struck by lightning!
As if it lost its flying ability, plummeting to the ground.
It looked at this human full of terror.
However, Han Xing’s heart remained unshaken.
Not to mention this lizard divine beast, which is merely at the dominator level.
Even if it were a true legend, Han Xing wouldn’t be afraid.
As early as two or three months ago, he already had the prowess to slay legends.
Just Han Xing’s momentum alone.
This lizard divine beast couldn’t withstand it.
At this moment.
It collapsed on the ground, fear evident in its gaze.
"Don’t... don’t kill me..."
This lizard monster spoke in human tongue again.
"I am the divine beast left in the Holy Spirit Realm by the God of Calamity, you... you cannot kill me!"
This guy seemed to want to use its backer to intimidate Han Xing.
However, had Han Xing not experienced the Divine Hall of Light incident.
He might have been frightened by it.
But now, Han Xing already knew.
That group of so-called divine spirits can’t come to the Holy Spirit Realm at all.
The last time the God of Light’s will descended, it was repelled by this world.
Therefore.
Han Xing’s arrow shot directly.
This lizard divine beast’s eyes filled with intense fear.
It seemed impossible that even with exposing the divine spirit behind it, it couldn’t intimidate the opponent.
Watching the arrow attack.
It fled in panic.
However.
Han Xing’s arrows couldn’t even be dodged by high-tier legends.
How could a dominator evade Han Xing’s arrow?
The next moment.
A strong sonic boom erupted.
"Puff!"
A vase-sized blood hole appeared on the back of the Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast.
Even after penetrating its body, the arrow’s momentum didn’t wane.
It bored a kilometer-deep hole through this sky island from top to bottom!
That lizard divine beast’s mouth slightly opened, as if utterly shocked by the strength Han Xing displayed!
It even nearly forgot its own injuries!

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - 323: Legendary Advancement Unlocked!
paragraphs: If that arrow had struck my head or heart just now, I might have been killed instantly, right?
However, what it doesn’t know is that this was just Han Xing’s ordinary attack.
Every arrow he shoots now has the power to seriously injure a Tier Five Legend!
The next moment.
The second arrow arrived.
This time, it accurately pierced through the heart of the Lizard Divine Beast.
Its massive body twitched on the ground and then collapsed with a loud thud.
At the same time.
A notification sounded in Han Xing’s ear.
"Successfully killed Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast, Five-Star Dominator, gained Experience Value 0, automatically absorbed the divine power from the foe, All Attributes +120."
"Obtained Divine Power Source Fire *3..."
"Trial task completed, obtained item reward: Legendary Emblem."
Looking at the sparkling emblem in his backpack, Han Xing couldn’t hide the smile on his face!
Finally completed!
Next, all he needs to do is absorb a large amount of Divine Power Source Fire to attempt a breakthrough to Legend.
Although, the system notification also mentioned that there’s a chance of failure in breaking through to Legend.
However, Han Xing remembered that the more Divine Power Source Fire he absorbed, the higher the success rate of breaking through!
And this kind of item, the Divine Power Source Fire.
Through the previous war.
He had already collected over a thousand pieces.
Presumably, it would definitely be enough for him to break through to Legend.
Han Xing was eager to attempt the breakthrough.
But before that.
He needs to collect the materials from the Lizard Divine Beast’s body.
And this massive Sky Island needs to be merged first.
Han Xing walked up to the Lizard Divine Beast’s corpse and directly clicked decompose.
"Decomposition successful, obtained Thunderfire Elemental Crystal *1732, obtained Thunder Eye *1, obtained Flame Eye *1, obtained Divine Oracle Scripture *6..."
Han Xing’s pupils contracted instantly.
"Holy crap!"
He didn’t know the functions of the first few materials.
But he was very clear about the Divine Oracle Scripture.
It was the last material needed to create the Oracle Throne.
This time, he unexpectedly got 6 of them in one go.
This was completely enough for him to create another Oracle Throne.
Even if he didn’t need it himself, giving it to team members would be a great boost!
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
He hadn’t expected to gain a surprise harvest from this battle.
Meanwhile.
Cheng Jianyong and his team saw that Han Xing had resolved the battle on his side and began swiftly maneuvering the Sky Island, filled with Advanced Defense Towers, to get closer.
While they were approaching, Han Xing took the opportunity to check the other three materials dropped from the monster.
[Thunderfire Elemental Crystal]: Special material, can extract the power of Thunder and Fire Elements from the crystal to enhance corresponding Elemental Magic Damage.
[Thunder Eye]: A divine beast eye containing extremely strong Power of Thunder, can be embedded in weapons or equipment to increase Thunder Attribute resistance and damage.
[Flame Eye]: Same effect as above.
After seeing the attributes of these three materials.
Han Xing lackadaisically stored them in his backpack.
At this time.
His teammates had already maneuvered the Sky Island over.
Seeing Han Xing’s expression, they knew.
Han Xing had succeeded.
"Congratulations, Brother Xing," Shen Yun was the first to say.
Cheng Jianyong also said excitedly, "Brother Xing is about to break through to Legend, he will be the first Legendary Level among the human survivors!"
Han Xing waved his hand dismissively and said, "Don’t have too high hopes, there’s a probability of failure, don’t forget."
The next moment.
Han Xing took out the Legendary Emblem.
At this point, the system prompt appeared.
"Do you want to use the Legendary Emblem to start the advancement?"
"Please note, if advancement fails, there will be a penalty of Level -5, but you can increase the chance of success by absorbing a large amount of Divine Power Source Fire."
This penalty was also within Han Xing’s expectations.
When he first obtained the ’Divine Power Source Fire’ item, Han Xing had already seen the relevant introduction.
So, Han Xing directly clicked yes.
The next moment——
The area within a thousand miles suddenly stirred with a gentle breeze.
Han Xing distinctly felt a powerful energy emerge from within himself.
This energy was gentle yet carried a hint of drawing the sword.
Instantly, it flooded through his entire body!
The next moment.
The wind and clouds shifted!
"Boom!"
Suddenly, a bolt of lightning fell from the sky!
In an instant, a fierce wind arose, with flashes of lightning and thunder roaring!
It was as if the entire world was in rage.
"Boom!"
"Boom-boom!
Deep rumbles of thunder roared incessantly, with dark clouds looming.
It was as if day had suddenly turned to night.
The Fourth Transformation to Legend.
Is the first step for a mortal towards the road of the Divine Spirit.
This world seemed unwilling to allow mortals to wield such a power, feeling furious.
However, at this moment, Han Xing ignored all the chaos in the outside world.
Inspired by the changes within his body.
As the power continued to move through his body.
Han Xing felt his physical qualities rapidly enhancing.
In just a few seconds, he broke through his limits!
A powerful sensation burst forth from within him!
Buzz!
Surrounding Han Xing, winds seemed to unleash a storm.
Scattering debris and toppling stone columns all around!
This scene left the four people in awe.
One must know, these stone columns weighed thousands of pounds!
And yet Han Xing, just by accidentally unleashing his aura, was able to stir them.
If he were to actually make a move, how terrifying would he be?
Despite Han Xing’s incredible strength now.
He felt like.
His transformation had only just begun!
He savored the sensation of growing stronger, feeling exhilarated!
But just then.
Han Xing suddenly opened his eyes.
His expression froze.
Because, he suddenly felt the power coursing through his body vanish.
As though it had been fully assimilated.
The sensation of increasing strength came to an abrupt stop.
At that moment, he realized.
It was time to absorb Divine Power Source Fire.
So.
Han Xing directly took out 10 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire from his backpack.
His body automatically absorbed all the source fires!
The next moment.
An overwhelmingly powerful force surged forth once more!

Its massive body twitched on the ground and then collapsed with a loud thud.
At the same time.
A notification sounded in Han Xing’s ear.
"Successfully killed Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast, Five-Star Dominator, gained Experience Value 0, automatically absorbed the divine power from the foe, All Attributes +120."
"Obtained Divine Power Source Fire *3..."
"Trial task completed, obtained item reward: Legendary Emblem."
Looking at the sparkling emblem in his backpack, Han Xing couldn’t hide the smile on his face!
Finally completed!
Next, all he needs to do is absorb a large amount of Divine Power Source Fire to attempt a breakthrough to Legend.
Although, the system notification also mentioned that there’s a chance of failure in breaking through to Legend.
However, Han Xing remembered that the more Divine Power Source Fire he absorbed, the higher the success rate of breaking through!
And this kind of item, the Divine Power Source Fire.
Through the previous war.
He had already collected over a thousand pieces.
Presumably, it would definitely be enough for him to break through to Legend.
Han Xing was eager to attempt the breakthrough.
But before that.
He needs to collect the materials from the Lizard Divine Beast’s body.
And this massive Sky Island needs to be merged first.
Han Xing walked up to the Lizard Divine Beast’s corpse and directly clicked decompose.
"Decomposition successful, obtained Thunderfire Elemental Crystal *1732, obtained Thunder Eye *1, obtained Flame Eye *1, obtained Divine Oracle Scripture *6..."
Han Xing’s pupils contracted instantly.
"Holy crap!"
He didn’t know the functions of the first few materials.
But he was very clear about the Divine Oracle Scripture.
It was the last material needed to create the Oracle Throne.
This time, he unexpectedly got 6 of them in one go.
This was completely enough for him to create another Oracle Throne.
Even if he didn’t need it himself, giving it to team members would be a great boost!
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
He hadn’t expected to gain a surprise harvest from this battle.
Meanwhile.
Cheng Jianyong and his team saw that Han Xing had resolved the battle on his side and began swiftly maneuvering the Sky Island, filled with Advanced Defense Towers, to get closer.
While they were approaching, Han Xing took the opportunity to check the other three materials dropped from the monster.
[Thunderfire Elemental Crystal]: Special material, can extract the power of Thunder and Fire Elements from the crystal to enhance corresponding Elemental Magic Damage.
[Thunder Eye]: A divine beast eye containing extremely strong Power of Thunder, can be embedded in weapons or equipment to increase Thunder Attribute resistance and damage.
[Flame Eye]: Same effect as above.
After seeing the attributes of these three materials.
Han Xing lackadaisically stored them in his backpack.
At this time.
His teammates had already maneuvered the Sky Island over.
Seeing Han Xing’s expression, they knew.
Han Xing had succeeded.
"Congratulations, Brother Xing," Shen Yun was the first to say.
Cheng Jianyong also said excitedly, "Brother Xing is about to break through to Legend, he will be the first Legendary Level among the human survivors!"
Han Xing waved his hand dismissively and said, "Don’t have too high hopes, there’s a probability of failure, don’t forget."
The next moment.
Han Xing took out the Legendary Emblem.
At this point, the system prompt appeared.
"Do you want to use the Legendary Emblem to start the advancement?"
"Please note, if advancement fails, there will be a penalty of Level -5, but you can increase the chance of success by absorbing a large amount of Divine Power Source Fire."
This penalty was also within Han Xing’s expectations.
When he first obtained the ’Divine Power Source Fire’ item, Han Xing had already seen the relevant introduction.
So, Han Xing directly clicked yes.
The next moment——
The area within a thousand miles suddenly stirred with a gentle breeze.
Han Xing distinctly felt a powerful energy emerge from within himself.
This energy was gentle yet carried a hint of drawing the sword.
Instantly, it flooded through his entire body!
The next moment.
The wind and clouds shifted!
"Boom!"
Suddenly, a bolt of lightning fell from the sky!
In an instant, a fierce wind arose, with flashes of lightning and thunder roaring!
It was as if the entire world was in rage.
"Boom!"
"Boom-boom!
Deep rumbles of thunder roared incessantly, with dark clouds looming.
It was as if day had suddenly turned to night.
The Fourth Transformation to Legend.
Is the first step for a mortal towards the road of the Divine Spirit.
This world seemed unwilling to allow mortals to wield such a power, feeling furious.
However, at this moment, Han Xing ignored all the chaos in the outside world.
Inspired by the changes within his body.
As the power continued to move through his body.
Han Xing felt his physical qualities rapidly enhancing.
In just a few seconds, he broke through his limits!
A powerful sensation burst forth from within him!
Buzz!
Surrounding Han Xing, winds seemed to unleash a storm.
Scattering debris and toppling stone columns all around!
This scene left the four people in awe.
One must know, these stone columns weighed thousands of pounds!
And yet Han Xing, just by accidentally unleashing his aura, was able to stir them.
If he were to actually make a move, how terrifying would he be?
Despite Han Xing’s incredible strength now.
He felt like.
His transformation had only just begun!
He savored the sensation of growing stronger, feeling exhilarated!
But just then.
Han Xing suddenly opened his eyes.
His expression froze.
Because, he suddenly felt the power coursing through his body vanish.
As though it had been fully assimilated.
The sensation of increasing strength came to an abrupt stop.
At that moment, he realized.
It was time to absorb Divine Power Source Fire.
So.
Han Xing directly took out 10 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire from his backpack.
His body automatically absorbed all the source fires!
The next moment.
An overwhelmingly powerful force surged forth once more!

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - 324: Server-wide Announcement - Breaking Through to Legend!
paragraphs: Han Xing absorbed all 10 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire.
A powerful force emerged.
It even surpassed the power that was previously within Han Xing’s body.
This took Han Xing by surprise.
He didn’t expect that the power provided by the 10 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire would be so immense!
However, upon reflection, it made sense.
After all.
Taking down that Five-star Dominator Level Divine Beast had only given 3 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire.
When he slew those Shadow Legends, it only granted 5 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire.
What he was absorbing now was nearly equivalent to the divine power from two Legends!
"With this much Divine Power Source Fire, it should be enough for me to advance, right?"
Han Xing thought silently.
However, to his surprise.
The power provided by these 10 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire barely circulated within his body before it vanished again.
Han Xing was once again stunned.
Such a large amount of divine power had been completely absorbed by him in just a few seconds?
The intense feeling of emptiness within his body surged once more.
In desperation.
Han Xing hurriedly took out another 10 clumps of Divine Power Source Fire and absorbed them.
The formidable divine power surged forth again!
However, this time, the rate at which the divine power was digested was even faster!
Han Xing frantically continued to devour vast amounts of Divine Power Source Fire.
Beside him, four people were intently watching Han Xing’s actions, puzzled.
Although they didn’t understand what he was doing.
They could sense that Han Xing’s aura was growing at a terrifying speed!
As Han Xing continued to devour the Divine Power Source Fire.
The clouds in the sky grew even heavier.
Thunder rumbled, and the howling wind intensified.
It seemed as if they all wanted Han Xing to fail in his breakthrough.
At that moment.
A bright flash of lightning suddenly shot out from the sky.
In the blink of an eye, it struck toward the area where Han Xing stood!
Crack!
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s pupils contracted; they instinctively wanted to rush over to help Han Xing!
However, before they could reach him.
They suddenly saw that the lightning only struck near Han Xing.
It did not actually hit him.
Everyone let out a sigh of relief.
And they could not help but break out in a cold sweat for Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing naturally sensed the signs from the outside world.
When the lightning struck, it almost made him instinctively pull out his weapon.
Doing so would mean interrupting his evolutionary progress toward a Legend.
Thus.
Han Xing dismissed all chaotic thoughts from his mind.
He focused all his attention on the breakthrough ahead of him.
As he absorbed clump after clump of Divine Power Source Fire.
Up until the 200th clump!
Han Xing’s momentum seemed to completely undergo some form of transformation.
At that moment.
The cloud-filled sky suddenly shot out a ray of dawn light.
That light fell just right on Han Xing.
Bathing him in a holy glow.
A divine aura, mixed with a hint of dominance, emerged from within him!
In the next instant.
Han Xing’s figure vanished from the spot in an instant.
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others hadn’t even seen how he moved!
In the sky, a familiar aura suddenly appeared.
Everyone looked up and was surprised to find out.
There was a figure appearing in mid-air.
It was Han Xing!
However, he wasn’t using the Oracle Throne at this moment.
Instead, he stood in the void with his flesh body!
This is the ability to fly!
At the same time, a thoughtful expression flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
"I see... so this is Legendary Level power?"
"The release and control of divine power at will..."
"Even using divine power to lift oneself to fly in the air."
In the next moment——
Han Xing suddenly clenched both of his fists!
Buzz!
The terrifying divine power roared!
The wild winds, the pouring thunder in the nearby sky.
At this moment, came to an abrupt halt!
As if forcibly suppressed by Han Xing!
This scene.
Everyone felt it was familiar.
Back when Wu Ling’Er led them out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods, she had demonstrated this once.
Now, Han Xing had this ability as well.
Everyone felt a sense of relief.
At the same time!
A supremely powerful aura erupted from Han Xing’s body, shooting up instantly to the sky.
Boom——
As if announcing something.
The thick clouds that blanketed the sky were dispersed in an instant!
Everyone gazed at that figure, like a king.
The powerful momentum was fully revealed!
Meanwhile.
An announcement rang in everyone’s ears.

System Announcement: "All survivors, please note that Survivor Han Xing has completely advanced through the Fifth Transformation, becoming the first Legendary Powerhouse among the Blue Star People, a milestone in the Human Race: The Path of Legends is now unlocked."
"Let us congratulate this powerhouse on making great contributions to the rise of the Human Race!"
The moment they heard the announcement.
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others all had joyful smiles on their faces.
They knew that Han Xing would definitely succeed!
Compared to the relief and expectation of Shen Yun and the others, the other survivors were completely bewildered.
They all asked in the chat channel, puzzled.
"Did I just... hear something?"
"Did the system announcement say that Star God broke through to Legend?"
Although the system announcement was very clear.
Their eyes were still filled with disbelief.
This matter was simply too unbelievable.
"It should be, right?"
"After all, billions of us heard it, it should be true..."
The chat channel was immediately filled with the sound of people gasping!
"Damn! This is terrifying!"
"Legend! Isn’t that a level you can only reach above level 50?"
"I’m just at level 35, my god! How far ahead is Star God?"
"Incredible! I can only say, not worthy of the Star God!"

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - 324: Server-wide Announcement, Legend Breakthrough!_2
paragraphs: "I’ve just become the Witch Tribe Holy Lord, and now I’ve directly broken through to become a Legendary Level Powerhouse. This is constantly refreshing my understanding!"
"Yeah, but the Star God’s breakthrough is also good for us. We humans finally have a Legendary Level Powerhouse to present!"
The remaining 3 billion Survivors worldwide all understand the fear of the Legend.
During the Blood Tide, the appearance of that Legendary Level Evil God Commander almost wiped out humanity!
Moreover, as they gradually understand the power structure of this world.
They realize even more the importance of a Legendary Level Powerhouse to a race!
A race without a Legend exists in the Holy Spirit Realm only to be manipulated by others.
They don’t even have basic survival rights, not to mention any speech rights.
And now, humanity has finally birthed its first Legendary Level Powerhouse!
This is incredibly significant!
Before these billions of Survivors could recover from the shock, the second system prompt appeared.
"Attention all Survivors, due to your camp leader reaching the Legendary Realm and completing a crucial breakthrough, the Camp Fortune Value +5000."
At this moment.
The Survivors exclaimed again.
"Wow! A one-time increase of 5000 Fortune points!"
"Truly terrifying, the Camp Fortune Value originally boosted our All Attributes by 17.3%, and now it’s increased by a big margin again!"
"Yeah, the Star God really lives up to his name. Following him, even doing nothing, brings unexpected surprises!"
Fortune points equate to a 5% boost. It may not seem like much, but remember it’s for everyone!
Furthermore, the stronger the being, the more important this boost is.
Even a 1% increase is a substantial boost for them.
Especially for those Legendary Level Powerhouses.
At this moment.
In the Witch Race Territory, everyone felt their power suddenly lifted!
Those recovering from injuries or cultivating, opened their eyes.
They stared at their bodies in surprise.
Mumbling, "Since the death of the Saint Master, the Witch Race suffered a Fate Backlash, and our power decreased significantly.
"Now, suddenly it seems to have recovered?"
"Is it Saint Master Han Xing?"
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er also exclaimed joyfully.
"It must be Brother Xing who’s broken through again!"
"That’s great!"
Wu Ling’Er clenched her fists excitedly.
In another corner of the Witch Race Territory, High Priest Xiao had been in a low mood ever since hearing of Rosanna’s death.
Now, suddenly feeling part of his missing power return.
The dispirited expression was revitalized.
"Saint Master..."
Xiao murmured, eyes naturally recalling that man’s figure.
"If I remember correctly, when I saw him months ago, he had just completed the Fourth Transformation."
"In just a few months, he’s broken through to Legend."
"This new Saint Master... really can scare people to death!"
Xiao understood better than anyone what it meant to go from Fourth Transformation to Legend in half a year.
This Human Race has limitless prospects!
At this moment, Han Xing.
Also heard these two system prompts.
However, differently.
Han Xing had a third system prompt in his ear.
"Congratulations, you’ve successfully completed the profession advancement, All Attributes increase by 200%, and gained the Special Ability, Divine Power Control!"
"Since you are the first Survivor to break through to the Legendary Level, world influence +764, and gained 100 Legendary Points."
An impressive boost!
Han Xing glanced at his current attributes.
[Name]: Han Xing · Witch Tribe Holy Lord
[Profession]: Wild Ranger · Legend
[Attributes]: Power 24372+24372, Agility 29219+29219, Spirit 21448+21448, Constitution 25369+25369.
Note: The 200% attribute increase during advancement only applies to Survivor Basic Attributes and does not apply to Equipment Added Attributes.
[Divine Power Value]: 1074 (Function 1: Can externalize Divine Power Value to activate the Legendary Domain, each Divine Power Value = 1000 Defense Value.)
(Function 2: Can be added to all attacks to increase attack, each Divine Power Value provides an additional 100 points of True Damage.)
Regardless of others, just looking at Han Xing’s current Four-dimensional Attributes is already frighteningly powerful!
During his Fourth Transformation, his Basic Attributes were close to touching the Legendary Level threshold.
Now after advancing to Legend, directly breaking through 20,000!
Nearing Middle-tier Legend!
Plus, with the title [Witch Tribe Holy Lord] bonus, Han Xing’s attributes have been raised to the height of an average Middle-tier Legendary Limit.
Almost reaching the High-tier Legendary boundary.
At this moment, Han Xing vaguely feels.
He himself, without relying on any teammate’s help, can even face the high-tier Legend like the Shadow Demon Venerable head-on.
He might not even need to use a few trump cards to win the battle!
His strong power gave Han Xing immense confidence.
At this time, a black figure appeared in his eyes.
Han Xing softly murmured, "I wonder, in my full explosive state, if I can hurt that guy?"
Of course, he’s referring to the Shadow Monarch.
Ever since experiencing its near-terrifying power, Han Xing has always considered him as his imaginary enemy.
If he has the power to deal with the Shadow Monarch, then Han Xing truly has few rivals in the entire Holy Spirit Realm!
Han Xing believes that day is not far off.
Because he has a precious treasure in his hands.
It’s the [Nature Godhead] that the Wild Ranger left behind for him.
With this Godhead, Han Xing’s key item on the path to Demi-God no longer needs to be searched hard.
Han Xing excitedly said, "I’ve just broken through Legend and I’m already this fierce."

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 324: Server-wide Announcement - Breaking Through to Legend!_3
paragraphs: "When I break through to demigod, won’t that mean if a god blocks me, I’ll kill the god? If a Buddha blocks me, I’ll kill the Buddha?"
With an excited heart, Han Xing continued to check the changes on the panel.
Aside from the enhancements in attributes,
there was now an additional attribute called [Divine Power Value].
And this was the essential difference between legendary and those below legendary.
[Divine Power Value] has two main functions.
The first function is to open the exclusive field of legendary powerhouses.
This field can help block damage.
It’s equivalent to a moving energy shield.
However, the defense value of this shield is somewhat outrageous.
point of divine power equals 1000 points of defense.
With Han Xing’s current attributes, that’s equivalent to over a million defense!
It could be said.
After Han Xing opens his field, he can just stand there and let monsters below tier five hit him.
The opponents might have to hit for a long time to break through the defense.
And by that time, Han Xing’s divine power might have already recovered!
No wonder it was always said before.
For a legendary powerhouse, below legendary is invincible, with no chance of being defeated!
Now, Han Xing truly understood this aspect.
If not for his overly monstrous attack power, he might not have been able to achieve the feat of killing a legend by surpassing levels.
In addition to being able to add a field,
the second function of divine power is also very powerful.
That is to add true damage.
True damage is unaffected by defense attributes.
In other words, fields are useless to them.
And this is the reason why only a legend can deal with another legend.
Excitement appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
However, the special functions of divine power don’t stop there!
As mentioned before, flying is also very simple in principle.
It’s just a matter of releasing the field, enveloping oneself, and then manipulating at will to fly freely.
There’s also releasing divine power to monitor all nearby scenarios.
It’s akin to having a God’s Perspective.
The monitoring range, Han Xing roughly estimated, is about divine power value times 100 meters.
In other words,
with Han Xing’s current attributes, he can monitor an area about eleven kilometers in radius centered on himself.
"Interesting..."
Han Xing smiled and said, "As expected, breaking through to legend is an entirely different realm."
"This divine power value is truly magical, almost omnipotent."
Moreover, Han Xing also discovered that as soon as he broke through, his divine power value was much higher than those of the Witch Race legends!
This also signifies that Han Xing can crush ordinary legendary creatures solely with his divine power value.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly remembered.
There was another system prompt just now.
That was Legendary Points +100.
Han Xing pondered, "I remember when I drew the first legendary skill, it cost me 10 legendary points, and drawing the second required 50."
"It’s been so long, I wonder how many legendary points I’ve accumulated."
He opened the panel to take a look.
The next moment, excitement shone in Han Xing’s eyes!
[Legendary Points]: 272.
Nearly 300 legendary points!
You never know until you look, and when you see, you’re startled!
Most of these legendary points were accumulated from this Witch Race campaign.
After repelling the Shadow Monarch, added over a hundred points.
This time breaking through to legend added another 100 points.
Combined with all sorts of previous small accomplishments, thus reached this number.
Han Xing excitedly said, "With so many legendary points, it should be enough for me to draw one or two legendary skills, right?"
Undoubtedly.
Any legendary skill brings tremendous improvement.
The first legendary skill he drew—Broken Moon—has helped Han Xing immensely until now!
And this time.
There’s a high probability Han Xing can directly draw two new legendary skills!
Which will greatly enhance his strength once again!
Thinking of this.
He clicked on draw directly!
The system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to spend 50 legendary points to draw a Wild Ranger exclusive skill?]
Han Xing clicked yes without hesitation.
The next moment—
A beam of white light suddenly shot down from the sky, landing abruptly on Han Xing!
At the same time, Han Xing felt a surge of memories in his mind.
Various fragments kept flashing before him.
As if, a hunter holding a longbow, accompanied by a bear spirit, was demonstrating a move to Han Xing.
A system prompt rang in his ears.
[Draw successful: Acquired Wild Ranger exclusive skill: Gangtu’s Spirit.]
At this moment, a puzzled expression flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
"What is Gangtu’s Spirit?"
Quickly, Han Xing saw the description of this skill.
[Gangtu’s Spirit]: Legendary skill, summons the soul of Bear God Gangtu to assist in battle.
Bear God Gangtu is a legendary creature with attributes 150% of Survivor’s baseline (not subject to special bonuses).
Gangtu’s Spirit exists for 600 seconds, skill cooldown: 2 hours.
After reading the skill description, Han Xing’s confusion instantly dissipated!
This turned out to be a summoning series legendary skill!
Moreover, what’s being summoned is actually a legendary creature, the Bear God Gangtu!
Any legendary creature is extremely terrifying.
Especially, a being with the title of ’God’.
"Impressive!"
Han Xing said excitedly, "150% attribute inheritance, even though it’s not affected by my title, it’s still exceedingly formidable!"
You must know, Han Xing’s basic attributes now are multiplied beyond those of the same level legendary creatures.
This bear spirit is definitely frighteningly powerful!
Moreover, the bear spirit has a ten-minute duration and a cooldown of just 2 hours.
This indicates that this legendary skill can entirely be used as a routine skill.
"Great, great, great! Encountering danger in the future, just send the bear spirit to scout ahead."
"After all, it’s just a spiritual body, even if it dies, it can be resummoned."
Han Xing was quite satisfied.
At this time.
Han Xing glanced at his remaining legendary points.
There were still 222 points left.
It seemed like he could draw another skill.
Han Xing tried clicking draw.
The system prompt appeared again.
"Would you like to spend 100 legendary points to draw a Wild Ranger exclusive skill?"
"Yes."

there was now an additional attribute called [Divine Power Value].

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - 325: Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill and Void Turmoil
paragraphs: The next moment.
A white light appeared in the sky once again!
Moreover, this time, it was even more intense than before!
Han Xing instinctively looked up.
In the sky, deep within the cloud layer.
He seemed to see a ruined temple.
Inside that temple, there were dozens of humanoid statues.
Next to those statues, there were one or two animals accompanying them.
Some were bears, some were wolves, and some were even dragons.
But they all had one thing in common.
That is, they all held a longbow either on their backs or in their hands.
This was enough to indicate their profession.
Hunters.
These statues should be the Wild Rangers from different generations.
Han Xing searched through the memories in his mind and the words the Wild Rangers had mentioned to him before.
He roughly inferred that this building was the Divine Hall of the Venerable.
However, the so-called Divine Hall of the Venerable did not look glamorous at all?
In fact, it appeared extremely dilapidated.
At this moment.
Han Xing saw inside the temple.
A hunter accompanied by a giant dragon slowly turned his head to look at Han Xing.
The next moment.
A beam of white light shot from his hand.
And then directly entered Han Xing’s body.
A mass of memories appeared in Han Xing’s mind once again!
"Successfully learned the Wild Ranger exclusive skill: Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill!"
[Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill]: Legendary Level skill, learning this skill will change the survivor’s attack form.
All attacks carry the Dragon Soul Burst effect (controllable), and burst damage does not decay, equivalent to one’s own attack.
Causes 40% extra damage to Dragon Race creatures.
"Burst effect?"
Han Xing was momentarily stunned, "Does this mean that every arrow I shoot is going to be an area attack from now on?"
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted.
"Holy crap!"
He exclaimed out loud.
As a hunter, Han Xing knows better than anyone what the advantages and disadvantages of this profession are.
The advantage is extremely fast attack speed and very strong pinpoint strike ability.
Also, it’s a long-range profession with extremely strong survival capabilities.
But the hunter also has a very obvious weakness.
That is, its capability to clear monsters is not good.
Even if Han Xing has both the skills [Fallen Star Arrow Rain] and [Blast Flame Arrow].
He still can’t match Zhang Lianmeng when dealing with groups of monsters.
Yet, this archery skill directly turns all of Han Xing’s attacks into burst effects, and the damage doesn’t decay either.
It’s equivalent to every arrow causing area damage!
This directly compensates for the hunter’s biggest shortcoming!
Combined with Han Xing’s terrifying strength, it will also lead to a qualitative change.
"This archery skill is really awesome!"
"The burst damage is even more pronounced against large-sized creatures."
"No wonder it’s called the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill!"
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
The two skills drawn this time are both incredibly powerful.
Han Xing took a look.
To draw the fourth Legendary skill, he needs 200 Legendary Points.
Han Xing is still far short of that.
But the harvest this time is already substantial enough.
At this time, Han Xing descended from the sky.
Everyone looked at him with a joyful expression.
"Congratulations, Brother Xing!" Shen Yun was the first to congratulate him.
"Congratulations."
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang said softly.
Han Xing nodded.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong eagerly asked, "Brother Xing, how does it feel to break through to Legend? Do you feel invincible already?"
Han Xing chuckled and said, "What are you thinking, invincible."
"In this world, there are plenty of beings stronger than me."
"Even if I become a demigod, I wouldn’t dare to claim invincibility."
Cheng Jianyong laughed a few times awkwardly.
At this time, Han Xing continued, "However, the advancement from breaking through to Legend is indeed terrifying."
"Far more than any advancement from the First to the Fourth Transformation!"
Hearing this, a smile reappeared on Cheng Jianyong’s face.
Han Xing continued.
"Right now, all of you are not far from your needed experience, so next, we’ll roam around within the Witch Race Territory."
"Let’s strive to bring all of you to Legend within a month!"
Upon hearing this, an expression of joy appeared on everyone’s face!
Without a doubt.
The advancement from breaking through to Legend is massive.
If they all reach this level, their strength will undergo a qualitative change.
Just as everyone was preparing to return to the Witch Race Territory to explore some ownerless Sky Islands.
Suddenly—
Han Xing felt a strange sensation from behind.
In the distant void turbulence.
A cluster of extremely chaotic energy was constantly surging towards the Witch Race Territory.
Buzz!
A strong wave of energy emanated,
And the five of them turned around simultaneously.
The next second, they witnessed a shocking scene!
In the distant territory, tens of thousands of miles of the region suddenly showed countless cracks, as if glass was about to shatter.
Crack!
Crack!
With the clear sound of shattering.
A section of space declared its rupture.
The already vast void turbulence area extended a few more steps towards the Witch Race Territory.
Moreover, the speed at which the space shattered was extremely fast!
In just a dozen seconds, it expanded over a hundred kilometers!
Han Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Holy crap, is this the Void Devouring phenomenon?"
"Isn’t this speed terrifying?"
"At this rate, it won’t take half a month."
"I’m afraid the entire Witch Race Territory will be devoured and become a void turbulence!"
The others nodded in agreement.
Just as Han Xing and the others were considering inspecting that void turbulence,
From the distant border defenses, an immensely powerful aura suddenly erupted!
At the same time, an urgent voice transmission sounded in Han Xing’s ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 325: Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill and Void Turmoil
paragraphs: "Saint Master, the Void turbulence is in chaos, please retreat quickly, do not approach!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing stopped in his tracks.
He looked back with some confusion.
A blue sun was rapidly flying towards Han Xing.
Soon, that aura appeared in front of everyone.
It was the Legendary Level powerhouse of the Witch Race guarding this place, Otto!
At this moment.
This middle-aged man with Witch Clan secret pattern on his face and a resolute look, quickly approached Han Xing.
He bowed to Han Xing, then respectfully said.
"Otto, greetings to the Saint Master!"
Han Xing waved his hand, "No need to be so formal."
"Tell me, what’s the situation with this Void turbulence?"
"Why can’t I get close?"
Otto quickly explained: "It’s like this, Saint Master, these areas of the Void often contain a terrifying number of Void beasts."
"These Void beasts feed on space, and are usually scattered."
"But once the number of gathered Void beasts becomes too large, the power of space is insufficient for them to devour, causing a Void chaos."
"That swarm of Void beasts would begin to frantically invade the Holy Spirit Realm, devouring more space."
"The stronger an aura is, the more it stimulates the Void beasts inside to turmoil, gathering them all to the place where the aura is emanating."
"This would cause the devouring speed of the Void turbulence to accelerate!"
After hearing Otto’s explanation, Han Xing roughly understood what the so-called Void chaos was.
It didn’t sound too complicated after all.
It’s nothing more than a group of space-eating monsters gathering together.
When the gathered number is too large, space power is insufficient for them to devour.
In a state of hunger, this swarm of Void beasts would rush into the real world, thus causing a Void chaos.
Han Xing nodded and asked: "How strong are these Void beasts?"
Otto thought for a while and said: "They vary in strength, most Void beasts are similar in strength to that group of Shadow Fangs."
"However, they have a special ability, their survival capability is extremely remarkable, making them much harder to kill than the Shadow Fangs."
"Among them, there may also be swarms of Fifth Transformation Void beasts appearing.
"Although these Void beasts rarely have Legendary Level strength, among them, the Fifth Transformation Lords and Dominators are quite numerous!"
"Moreover, the stronger the Void beasts, the more astonishing their survival ability."
"Fifth Transformation Lord Level Void beasts even require a Legendary Level to slay them."
"And against a Fifth Transformation Dominator, even a legend cannot hold them back."
At this point, Otto added, "Of course, these Dominator Level Void beasts cannot do anything to us Legendary Powerhouses either."
After listening to Otto’s explanation.
Han Xing had a vague understanding of the Void beasts in his heart.
Even a Legendary Level powerhouse personally taking action could not detain the Dominators.
This shows that the survival ability of these Void beasts is truly formidable.
Plus their numbers.
No wonder Otto felt this swarm of Void beasts was troublesome.
Han Xing nodded, continuing to say: "I understand, take me to have a look."
Otto was momentarily stunned.
"Uh... Saint Master, you just broke through, and your aura is incomparably strong."
"If you go over now, it will cause further chaos in the Void."
"It’s possible that it might attract a lot of Fifth Transformation Dominator Level Void beasts."
"Even though you are very strong, this swarm of Void beasts is extremely difficult to deal with."
"Handling it may be a bit troublesome at that time..."
Otto gently persuaded Han Xing.
However, Han Xing smiled and said: "How troublesome could it be?"
"No matter how strong the survival ability of a Void beast is, it has a physical form, right?"
Otto nodded blankly.
Han Xing said: "Then it won’t be a problem."
"As long as it’s a thing with a form, it means it can be killed."
"Lead the way."
Han Xing’s tone carried an unyielding determination.
As soon as he finished speaking.
Han Xing manipulated the large Sky Island under his feet to approach the Void turbulence.
Otto quickly regained his composure and followed closely.
At this moment.
A large Sky Island covered with various advanced defense towers was approaching the Void turbulence.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt an extremely terrifying wind coming from around.
Whoosh—
Whoosh—
The Void turbulence came with an extremely strong tearing sensation.
His Sky Island was still thousands of kilometers away.
He felt the ground beneath his feet trembling, even vaguely showing signs of breaking apart.
At this moment, Otto explained: "Saint Master, this is the spatial disruption effect that accompanies the Void turbulence, it’s not easy to handle."
"Usually we use various long-range firepower to suppress these Void beasts."
"Of course, we as Legendary Level Powerhouses can naturally handle this level of disruption."
"You just need to externalize your divine power."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he externalized his divine power, directly enveloping the entire Sky Island.
The next moment.
The chaotic air currents seemed to vanish in an instant.
The entire Sky Island became incredibly stable.
The spatial disruption effect that came with the Void turbulence could no longer affect this Sky Island.
Next to him.
Otto looked at Han Xing with utter amazement.
Perhaps Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun couldn’t sense it.
But as a Legendary Level powerhouse, he could feel it more intensely at this moment,
The intensity of divine power released by Han Xing was a whole lot stronger than his own!
Over half an hour ago, Otto had seen Han Xing.
At that time, there was no divine power emanating from him, he was just a Fourth Transformation Level powerhouse.
And in such a short time.
This young Saint Master not only broke through to a Legend.
But as soon as he broke through, he possessed such vast divine power.
In his heart, Otto once again refreshed his understanding!

Han Xing’s tone carried an unyielding determination.
As soon as he finished speaking.
Han Xing manipulated the large Sky Island under his feet to approach the Void turbulence.
Otto quickly regained his composure and followed closely.
At this moment.
A large Sky Island covered with various advanced defense towers was approaching the Void turbulence.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt an extremely terrifying wind coming from around.
Whoosh—
Whoosh—
The Void turbulence came with an extremely strong tearing sensation.
His Sky Island was still thousands of kilometers away.
He felt the ground beneath his feet trembling, even vaguely showing signs of breaking apart.
At this moment, Otto explained: "Saint Master, this is the spatial disruption effect that accompanies the Void turbulence, it’s not easy to handle."
"Usually we use various long-range firepower to suppress these Void beasts."
"Of course, we as Legendary Level Powerhouses can naturally handle this level of disruption."
"You just need to externalize your divine power."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he externalized his divine power, directly enveloping the entire Sky Island.
The next moment.
The chaotic air currents seemed to vanish in an instant.
The entire Sky Island became incredibly stable.
The spatial disruption effect that came with the Void turbulence could no longer affect this Sky Island.
Next to him.
Otto looked at Han Xing with utter amazement.
Perhaps Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun couldn’t sense it.
But as a Legendary Level powerhouse, he could feel it more intensely at this moment,
The intensity of divine power released by Han Xing was a whole lot stronger than his own!
Over half an hour ago, Otto had seen Han Xing.
At that time, there was no divine power emanating from him, he was just a Fourth Transformation Level powerhouse.
And in such a short time.
This young Saint Master not only broke through to a Legend.
But as soon as he broke through, he possessed such vast divine power.
In his heart, Otto once again refreshed his understanding!

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - 325: Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill and Void Turmoil
paragraphs: At this moment.
They had already approached the edge of the Void Turbulence.
The group squinted their eyes, staring into the distance.
They saw.
In the vast, chaotic, pitch-black space, there were clusters of shifting black shadows.
Those shadows were extremely pure, even though the surrounding space was also pitch black.
But one could easily see their presence at a glance.
They appeared like black holes.
Moving, they devoured everything around them.
And in the process of devouring, they constantly changed forms.
Sometimes becoming a cube, sometimes a triangle, and occasionally morphing into beast-shaped creatures.
Han Xing looked questioningly at Otto beside him.
Otto understood, and quickly explained, "Lord Saint Master, it’s like this."
"These low-level Void Beasts usually don’t have a fixed form; they shape-shift according to what they devour."
"If you see some Void Beasts with fixed forms, you need to be careful."
"These Void Beasts typically possess Tier Five power, which is quite terrifying!"
Han Xing nodded.
He checked the attributes of one of the Void Beasts.
[Void Beast: Three-Star Ordinary Creature]
[Level]: Level 37
[Attributes]: Power 1031, agility 1140, Spirit 1242, Constitution 1007.
[Void Energy Points]: 103

[Skills]: Body of Nothingness (25% chance to avoid this attack when taking damage), Void Devouring (deals an additional 25% damage to all worldly creatures), Rapid Growth (Void Beasts can grow stronger by devouring everything in the world; the higher the level of the devoured items, the faster the growth rate.)
[Void Beast: Four-Star Elite Creature]
Han Xing squinted his eyes.
The attributes of these monsters reminded him of his other companion, Coal Ball.
It also had a Body of Nothingness skill.
However, compared to these ordinary monsters,
Coal Ball’s Body of Nothingness was clearly much more powerful.
Not only did it have a 50% evasion chance, but it also could immunize magic damage.
However, even if these Void Beasts had only half the evasion rate of Coal Ball, they were still quite formidable.
After all, this kind of percentage skill is equivalent to a rule-based skill in disguise.
As long as it’s triggered, even if you are a Legend, you cannot kill the opponent instantly.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt that Coal Ball in the pet space was becoming a bit restless.
It seemed to want to come out.
Han Xing said with interest, "Oh? Is Coal Ball sensing the aura of its kin and wants to come out?"
Speaking of which, Han Xing indeed hadn’t let Coal Ball appear much lately.
On one hand, it was because Coal Ball’s growth attributes were too extreme.
As Han Xing’s strength increased rapidly, the enemies he faced became more terrifying.
Coal Ball, being a fragile close-range fighter, made Han Xing hesitant to let it fight those guys.
On the other hand, it was because of Coal Ball’s shy nature; it didn’t like to be active when there were too many people.
Usually, it stayed in the pet space.
Thinking of this, Han Xing decided to satisfy the little guy and let it out directly.
In the next moment.
In front of everyone, appeared a giant wolf entirely in black, four to five meters tall.
Raising its head, it looked at the crowd with majestic dignity.
Its glossy black fur appeared incredibly smooth.
At this moment.
When Coal Ball met Han Xing’s gaze, it instantly became incredibly excited.
Happily pouncing by Han Xing’s side, it jumped up like a wolf-dog.
Han Xing smiled, stroking Coal Ball’s head.
Coal Ball made a satisfied purring sound.
The group watched this man and wolf, smiles appearing on their faces.
At this time, Otto beside him exclaimed in surprise, "Lord Saint Master... is the one beside you a Void Creature?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, it’s my companion, named Coal Ball."
Hearing this, Otto was even more amazed.
"My gosh! It’s really a Void Creature!"
"Lord Saint Master, do you know its origin?"
Han Xing shook his head.
As he grew stronger, he gradually felt Coal Ball’s origin was remarkable.
After all, many monsters with Void attributes existed, like the Void Beasts before them.
But special Void Creatures like Coal Ball were rare.
At this time, Coal Ball was beside Han Xing, bouncing around as it watched the Void Beasts.
Han Xing, who initially intended to make a move, suddenly hesitated.
Well... would attacking its kin in front of Coal Ball be a bit inappropriate?
As Han Xing pondered whether to put Coal Ball back into the pet space.
He suddenly saw.
A pure black light appeared on Coal Ball’s body.
Moments later, the black light flashed.
Coal Ball actually charged towards those Void Beasts.
At this moment, the crowd instinctively wanted to rush up to help.
Han Xing stopped them.
Cheng Jianyong halted his attack, saying with interest, "Is Little Coal Ball so excited to see its kin that it wants to catch up?"
Although Cheng Jianyong’s words had a joking tone.
This possibility did exist.
But just then, Coal Ball made an astonishing move before everyone.
As it approached those Void Beasts, it suddenly opened its wolf mouth.
Ferociously biting towards a Third-Turn Elite Level Void Beast.
"Roar!"
With a low roar.
This Void Beast was bitten to death by Coal Ball on the spot, its black aura entirely devoured by Coal Ball.
This scene left everyone stunned.
They seemed unable to comprehend why Coal Ball suddenly did that.
However, Han Xing noticed that Coal Ball’s body had an imperceptible change.
His heart slightly stirred.
Han Xing checked Coal Ball’s panel attributes, finding some differences.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Juvenile)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV46]
[Attributes: Power 3032, agility 5782, Spirit 3104, Constitution 2984]
[Affinity: 100]
[Satiety: 80 (Good)]
[Growth: S+ (Can increase pet growth through Potential Value, each increase requires 10,000 Potential Value, current remaining Potential Value: 8764)]
