chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 326: Void Riot and Coal Ball’s Transformation
paragraphs: Coal Ball’s attribute panel is still as extremely agile as ever.
However, compared to before, there seem to be some different changes.
Yet, for a moment, Han Xing didn’t know what had happened.
It wasn’t until Coal Ball mingled within the Void Beast swarm and stealthily devoured a few Void Beasts again.
Han Xing finally understood what this change was.
[Attributes: Power 3041, Agility 5785, Spirit 3110, Constitution 2987]
Coal Ball’s attributes have increased!
At the same time, Han Xing glanced at the notification tab, where a large section of kill information appeared.
"Your pet ’Coal Ball’ killed a common Void Beast, successfully absorbed Power of the Void, Power +3, Spirit +2, Potential Value +1..."
"Your pet ’Coal Ball’ killed a common Void Beast, successfully absorbed Power of the Void, Constitution +3, Agility +3, Potential Value +1..."
"Your pet..."
A series of more than a dozen kill messages.
Completely stunned Han Xing.
"Holy crap!"
He didn’t expect Coal Ball to have such characteristics.
By killing these Void Beasts, it absorbs the Power of the Void from them, thereby increasing its attribute values.
And not only that, in addition to the attribute value increase, Han Xing also saw that each Void Beast provided Coal Ball with a point of potential value!
This thing is just too perverse!
Coal Ball’s current potential value has already reached over eight thousand points.
This was a number Han Xing accumulated by feeding it for nearly a year.
Yet now, at Coal Ball’s current speed.
It only needs to kill more than a thousand Void Beasts to directly reach ten thousand points, evolving towards SS-level.
And the number of Void Beasts here is clearly much more than that!
Tens of thousands, even millions!
If Coal Ball continues, it might even reach SSS-level in one go!
Thinking of this, Han Xing became even more excited.
Watching Coal Ball mingling in the midst of the Void Beasts, occasionally striking to devour the Power of the Void from them.
This sneaky look made everyone simultaneously look at Han Xing.
Han Xing was taken aback, "What the hell, why are you guys looking at me like that?"
"I usually don’t sneak around like this."
Hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang both let out a burst of laughter.
Seeing Han Xing looking over, they quickly covered their mouths.
At this moment, Han Xing was completely speechless.
Damn it.
Am I really like this usually?
When I, Han Xing, fight, it’s always fair and square, okay?
However, after Coal Ball killed more than a dozen Void Beasts, it seemed to have caught the attention of these peculiar creatures.
They discovered that this fellow with the same Power of the Void was actually massacring its own kind.
For a moment, this group of Void Beasts became extremely furious.
At that moment.
Han Xing saw at least tens of thousands of black shadows rushing towards Coal Ball.
Among them were several black shadows that looked like leopards, yet also like tigers.
Previously, Otto had warned.
These corporeal Void Beasts often had the strength of a Fifth Transformation Lord or even Dominator Level.
With Coal Ball’s current attributes of 46, there was absolutely no way it could be a match!
At this moment, Han Xing hurriedly shouted, "Coal Ball, come back quickly!"
Hearing Han Xing’s voice, Coal Ball executed his command immediately.
And just then.
The silhouettes of several Fifth Transformation Void Beasts already appeared behind Coal Ball!
At this moment, Coal Ball also knew that it might not have time to escape back.
It suddenly halted, digging its claws into the Void, assuming a fighting stance.
"Roar!"
Coal Ball let out a low, threatening growl.
However, that group of Void Beasts already saw through Coal Ball’s reality.
In an instant, they all charged towards Coal Ball.
At this critical moment.
Han Xing suddenly grasped the [Demon-Defying Battle Bow].
Squeak!
As the sound of the bowstring being drawn rang out.
Whoosh!
An arrow burst forth abruptly!
This was just a normal attack from Han Xing.
Yet what was different was that everyone saw the arrow trailing a stream of golden light.
From which faint dragon roars emanated!
In the next moment.
The arrow struck one of the Void Beasts that looked like an elephant.
Then came a deafening explosive sound!
"Boom!"
This Void Beast, clearly with Fifth Transformation strength, exploded instantly!
The terrifying blast area even involved several nearby Void Beasts.
Before the Void Beast herd could react.
More arrows were already coming.
Each arrow hit those Void Beasts chasing Coal Ball with precise accuracy.
Then caused a cataclysmic explosion!
"Boom!"
"Boom boom boom!"
The Void Beast swarm was bombarded in succession.
Everyone stood there dumbfounded, watching this scene.
"Brother Xing, is this a new skill?" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask.
Han Xing shook his head, "No, just a normal attack."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was momentarily stunned and then took a deep breath.
"Holy crap! Even normal attacks are this fierce!"
"Any random arrow is as powerful as Sister Lian Meng’s Large Fireball!"
"You’re not a Wild Ranger; you’re a Wild Immortal!"
Cheng Jianyong’s tone was extremely exaggerated.
This time, Han Xing did not deny.
Because even he didn’t expect the power and range of the blasts to be this exaggerated!
If this continues, he really might transform into a Nuclear Bomb Arrow Immortal!
Taking advantage of this gap, Coal Ball quickly returned to Han Xing’s side.
At this point, Han Xing noticed that the Void Beasts he killed did not increase Coal Ball’s attributes.
Han Xing pondered, "Does it have to be Void Beasts killed by Coal Ball itself to increase attributes and potential value?"
This somewhat surprised Han Xing.
But after thinking about it, it makes sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 326: Void Riot and Coal Ball’s Transformation (Part 2)
paragraphs: If every Void Beast slain by Han Xing could enhance the attributes of the Coal Ball.
At his current efficiency, he could eliminate at least several million Void Beasts in one day.
By then, the attributes of the Coal Ball would reach an unimaginable level of terror!
Although there is this restriction.
However, it must be said, these Void Beasts are a rare opportunity for the Coal Ball.
Han Xing decides that when there’s a chance in the future, he will specifically take the Coal Ball to hunt Void Beasts for a few days.
However, now is not the time.
Han Xing’s recent few arrows seemed to have caused the entire void to riot completely.
Countless Void Beasts turned their gaze towards Han Xing.
The next moment.
Han Xing saw a vast swarm of Void Beasts charging towards them.
The number was over a million!
Such a large-scale riot further aggravated the Void Turbulence.
Thousands of kilometers of space ahead appeared dense with cracks once again.
Otto hurriedly said, "Lord Saint Master, please retreat to the border defenses now, lest you get caught in the crossfire!"
"I’ll lead the soldiers to handle the Void Riot here!"
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No need."
"Since we’re here, let’s just solve all the Void Beasts here as well."
Otto was stunned.
The next moment.
Han Xing waved a hand.
Across the entire Sky Island.
Over five hundred Towers of Death Light, over three hundred Towers of Witch Soul, plus more than a hundred True Spirit Towers burst with dazzling energy light.
Then.
Thousands of energy beams suddenly burst forth.
"Buzz!"
Energy beams shot into the vast area of Void Turbulence, completely covering it.
Including those million rioting Void Beasts, who were also engulfed by the Defense Towers’ attack.
"Boom!"
With the appearance of a blinding white light.
When the terrifying disturbance subsided.
The formation of over a million Void Beasts was instantly dismantled.
At least sixty percent of the Void Beasts were vaporized by these energy beams.
Facing the attack of the Defense Towers, it was almost certain death upon contact.
Even the Fifth-Turn Void Beasts were no exception!
The only reason these Void Beasts were still alive was because they triggered the Body of Nothingness’s 25% dodge chance.
If they didn’t have this skill.
Not a single one of these million Void Beasts would have survived!
After all, a thousand Defense Towers are enough firepower to instantly kill a High-tier Legend.
The remaining Void Beasts suddenly halted, looking somewhat terrified at the few humans opposite.
They, too, seemed to be intimidated by the Defense Towers’ attack.
However, the next moment.
In the void, more Void Beasts appeared, gathering together, preparing to launch a second wave of assault!
As mentioned before.
The number of Void Beasts is incredibly vast.
Every Void Riot represents at least tens of millions of Void Beasts attempting to surge into the real world.
They need to consume more Power of Space.
Facing the onslaught of the Void Beasts.
Han Xing remained unfazed.
Because, the cooldown on the thousands of Defense Towers on his territory had ended.
This was naturally the effect brought by the Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele.
Although Han Xing’s current Sky Island didn’t have a Sun Crown Stele.
But he also discovered.
No matter how far apart.
His Defense Towers would still receive the amplification of the Sun Crown Stele.
Han Xing didn’t know the principles behind this.
However, since it’s a Holy Artifact.
The presence of some unimaginable Mighty Power is natural.
Moreover, this also provided Han Xing with a lot of convenience.
The next moment.
The thousands of Defense Towers were once again enveloped in a holy white light.
That was the amplification effect of the Sun Crown Stele.
"Buzz!"
Thousands of thick beams burst forth!
The million-strong army of Void Beasts, painstakingly organized, was once again blasted to pieces by Han Xing!
This group of hungry Void Beasts appeared fearless of death.
They had just been blasted away by Han Xing.
Only to have more Void Beasts emerge from the depths of Space Turbulence.
However, awaiting them.
Were still beams of deathly Destruction.
Some Void Beasts were lucky enough to temporarily escape disaster using the Body of Nothingness.
But clearly, their luck wouldn’t last indefinitely.
As more and more Void Beasts were blasted away by Han Xing.
An excited look appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Because, after a few minutes.
He had already blasted away nearly twenty million Void Beasts.
And these Void Beasts, though they didn’t yield experience.
But don’t forget.
On Han Xing’s territory, there was a special building.
[Abyss Technology: Demon Furnace]
This device could automatically collect the souls of all creatures slain by Han Xing.
The souls of Void Beasts were naturally included.
Moreover, Han Xing also discovered that the soul value provided by these Void Beasts was more than that of ordinary creatures!
Even a random Third-Turn Void Beast could add ten soul points!
A Fourth-Turn Void Beast could even have 20 points!
Plus those Elites, Leaders, Lords...
Over twenty million Void Beasts provided Han Xing with 320 million souls directly!
If they were refined into Soul Crystals.
That would be equivalent to a 300-point All Attributes increase; even absorbing it as Divine Power could give Han Xing a 3-point Divine Power boost!
Han Xing excitedly said, "It’s said that the number of Void Beasts in the Void Turbulence is infinite."
"Let me see how many of you there really are!"
This time, Han Xing began to take the initiative.
Directly controlling the Defense Towers to attack in batches.
Achieving incessant bombardment.
"Rumble!"
That area of Void Turbulence came under Han Xing’s continuous firepower saturation.
Millions more Void Beasts fell victim to Han Xing.
The Void Beasts’ impact seemed to have hit a slump.

sentences.text: If every Void Beast slain by Han Xing could enhance the attributes of the Coal Ball.
At his current efficiency, he could eliminate at least several million Void Beasts in one day.
By then, the attributes of the Coal Ball would reach an unimaginable level of terror!
Although there is this restriction.
However, it must be said, these Void Beasts are a rare opportunity for the Coal Ball.
Han Xing decides that when there’s a chance in the future, he will specifically take the Coal Ball to hunt Void Beasts for a few days.
However, now is not the time.
Han Xing’s recent few arrows seemed to have caused the entire void to riot completely.
Countless Void Beasts turned their gaze towards Han Xing.
The next moment.
Han Xing saw a vast swarm of Void Beasts charging towards them.
The number was over a million!
Such a large-scale riot further aggravated the Void Turbulence.
Thousands of kilometers of space ahead appeared dense with cracks once again.
Otto hurriedly said, "Lord Saint Master, please retreat to the border defenses now, lest you get caught in the crossfire!"
"I’ll lead the soldiers to handle the Void Riot here!"
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No need."
"Since we’re here, let’s just solve all the Void Beasts here as well."
Otto was stunned.
The next moment.
Han Xing waved a hand.
Across the entire Sky Island.
Over five hundred Towers of Death Light, over three hundred Towers of Witch Soul, plus more than a hundred True Spirit Towers burst with dazzling energy light.
Then.
Thousands of energy beams suddenly burst forth.
"Buzz!"
Energy beams shot into the vast area of Void Turbulence, completely covering it.
Including those million rioting Void Beasts, who were also engulfed by the Defense Towers’ attack.
"Boom!"
With the appearance of a blinding white light.
When the terrifying disturbance subsided.
The formation of over a million Void Beasts was instantly dismantled.
At least sixty percent of the Void Beasts were vaporized by these energy beams.
Facing the attack of the Defense Towers, it was almost certain death upon contact.
Even the Fifth-Turn Void Beasts were no exception!
The only reason these Void Beasts were still alive was because they triggered the Body of Nothingness’s 25% dodge chance.
If they didn’t have this skill.
Not a single one of these million Void Beasts would have survived!
After all, a thousand Defense Towers are enough firepower to instantly kill a High-tier Legend.
The remaining Void Beasts suddenly halted, looking somewhat terrified at the few humans opposite.
They, too, seemed to be intimidated by the Defense Towers’ attack.
However, the next moment.
In the void, more Void Beasts appeared, gathering together, preparing to launch a second wave of assault!
As mentioned before.
The number of Void Beasts is incredibly vast.
Every Void Riot represents at least tens of millions of Void Beasts attempting to surge into the real world.
They need to consume more Power of Space.
Facing the onslaught of the Void Beasts.
Han Xing remained unfazed.
Because, the cooldown on the thousands of Defense Towers on his territory had ended.
This was naturally the effect brought by the Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele.
Although Han Xing’s current Sky Island didn’t have a Sun Crown Stele.
But he also discovered.
No matter how far apart.
His Defense Towers would still receive the amplification of the Sun Crown Stele.
Han Xing didn’t know the principles behind this.
However, since it’s a Holy Artifact.
The presence of some unimaginable Mighty Power is natural.
Moreover, this also provided Han Xing with a lot of convenience.
The next moment.
The thousands of Defense Towers were once again enveloped in a holy white light.
That was the amplification effect of the Sun Crown Stele.
"Buzz!"
Thousands of thick beams burst forth!
The million-strong army of Void Beasts, painstakingly organized, was once again blasted to pieces by Han Xing!
This group of hungry Void Beasts appeared fearless of death.
They had just been blasted away by Han Xing.
Only to have more Void Beasts emerge from the depths of Space Turbulence.
However, awaiting them.
Were still beams of deathly Destruction.
Some Void Beasts were lucky enough to temporarily escape disaster using the Body of Nothingness.
But clearly, their luck wouldn’t last indefinitely.
As more and more Void Beasts were blasted away by Han Xing.
An excited look appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Because, after a few minutes.
He had already blasted away nearly twenty million Void Beasts.
And these Void Beasts, though they didn’t yield experience.
But don’t forget.
On Han Xing’s territory, there was a special building.
[Abyss Technology: Demon Furnace]
This device could automatically collect the souls of all creatures slain by Han Xing.
The souls of Void Beasts were naturally included.
Moreover, Han Xing also discovered that the soul value provided by these Void Beasts was more than that of ordinary creatures!
Even a random Third-Turn Void Beast could add ten soul points!
A Fourth-Turn Void Beast could even have 20 points!
Plus those Elites, Leaders, Lords...
Over twenty million Void Beasts provided Han Xing with 320 million souls directly!
If they were refined into Soul Crystals.
That would be equivalent to a 300-point All Attributes increase; even absorbing it as Divine Power could give Han Xing a 3-point Divine Power boost!
Han Xing excitedly said, "It’s said that the number of Void Beasts in the Void Turbulence is infinite."
"Let me see how many of you there really are!"
This time, Han Xing began to take the initiative.
Directly controlling the Defense Towers to attack in batches.
Achieving incessant bombardment.
"Rumble!"
That area of Void Turbulence came under Han Xing’s continuous firepower saturation.
Millions more Void Beasts fell victim to Han Xing.
The Void Beasts’ impact seemed to have hit a slump.

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 326: Void Uprising and Coal Ball’s Transformation (3)
paragraphs: Despite this, Han Xing saw deeper in the Void, there were more black shadows of Void Beasts.
However, they didn’t dare to come closer.
Are you kidding?
The number of Void Beasts is indeed terrifying.
But who the hell wants to become cannon fodder for no reason?
Didn’t you see that several million Void Beasts had been blasted to smithereens?
They even saw one or two Void Beasts with apparent Fifth-Turn Dominator Level strength.
All turned to dust under the bombardment of those Defense Towers.
The firepower of those humans is too terrifying.
No matter your strength.
As soon as you go there, you won’t make a sound.
At this moment, Han Xing also felt that this group of Void Beasts seemed unwilling to continue bothering him.
They began retreating one by one.
The chaotic void gradually fell into silence.
Han Xing couldn’t help but shake his head in disappointment.
Because he hadn’t killed to his heart’s content yet.
The number of souls stored in the Demon Furnace had just broken through 500 million and could only refine 5 Soul Crystals.
At this moment,
Otto was standing aside, staring blankly at Han Xing.
This Void riot,
was no less massive than any he had encountered before, perhaps even more so.
It even included more than two Void Beasts of Fifth-Turn Dominator Level strength.
Under normal circumstances, even Otto, against two Dominator Level Void Beasts, could only fight to a draw.
The other Void Beasts could only be handled by soldiers and those battleships.
Sometimes, if not careful, soldiers would suffer significant losses.
However, this new Saint Master,
without even moving a step, directly blasted most of these millions of Void Beasts.
Even forcing them to retreat voluntarily.
The powerful firepower was evident without a doubt.
At this moment,
Han Xing noticed that in the area he bombarded, many floating items appeared.
They looked like mirror fragments.
Among them, he even saw one or two purple stones.
Han Xing asked, "Otto, what are those?
Otto, as if just coming back to his senses, hurriedly said, "Back to Saint Master, these are the Space Fragments swallowed by those Void Beasts."
"After they died, the Space Fragments that they didn’t have time to digest fell out again."
"Collecting these Space Fragments can repair the areas devoured by the Void Beasts."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was a bit surprised.
"Does every Void Beast drop these Space Fragments?"
Otto shook his head, "Not exactly."
"I mentioned to the Saint Master before, Void Beasts are creatures that feed on the Power of Space."
"They devour the space of the present world and, after digesting the Power of Space within, become exponentially stronger."
"At the same time, they can use this Power of Space to spawn more Void Beasts."
"Their reproduction is extremely fast, like the batch of Void Beasts the Saint Master slew today, which will be replenished within half a month."
"This explains why the number of Void Beasts is so large."
At this point, Otto said with a hint of fear, "Were it not for the difficulty of producing top-tier individuals among the Void Beasts,
the entire Holy Spirit Realm would have long become a residence for the Void Beasts."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing only laughed.
Truly a disaster-ridden Holy Spirit Realm.
It’s like a delectable cake that everyone wants a piece of, taking a bite from it.
Han Xing asked, "So you’re saying these Space Fragments are the undigested Power of Space?"
Otto nodded, "Yes, Saint Master."
Han Xing asked no further questions.
Since he already knew there was no danger with this stuff.
He could boldly come into contact with it.
After touching one of the Space Fragments, the thing automatically moved into Han Xing’s backpack.
A system prompt appeared.
"Obtained Space Fragment*1..."
[Space Fragment]: Special type item, after use, can repair a small piece of broken space.
Han Xing looked puzzled, "A small piece? How big is the space?"
The system note was somewhat ambiguous.
However, not waiting for Han Xing to collect all the Space Fragments on the ground,
the Communication Jade on him suddenly emitted an urgent ringing.
It seemed many people were trying to reach him at once.
All these messages were sent by those Witch Race Legends.
Han Xing frowned slightly.
Since the last meeting, although those Witch Race Legends knew Han Xing’s contact number,
he had told them to go directly to Wu Ling’Er when encountering issues.
Usually, they contacted Han Xing rarely.
But now, so many Witch Race Legends reached out to him at once.
Could it be they encountered some trouble beyond imagination?
Han Xing quickly took out the Communication Jade.
As soon as he opened it, he heard the anxious voices of those Witch Race Legends.
"Saint Master! Something terrible has happened!"
"There’s been a large-scale Void riot across the major borders of the Witch Race!"
"A great number of Void Beasts are invading our Witch Race Territory, devouring our lands!"
"At this rate, it won’t be long before the Witch Race Territory is completely overrun by these Void Creatures!"
Han Xing opened the other messages from the Witch Race Legends, and it was the same.
All the major borders are experiencing Void riots.
Masses of Void Beasts are storming the Witch Race territory.
This made him even more confused.
He had just repelled a massive wave of Void Beasts.
Only to immediately receive news of Void Beast invasions from other Witch Race borders.
Han Xing sensed something unusual in all of this.
Everything seemed a bit too coincidental.
But regardless of the situation,
the immediate priority was to quickly issue commands and dispatch troops to suppress these Void riots.
Before the Void Beasts cause widespread destruction, occupying more areas.
However, before Han Xing could give any commands,
thousands of kilometers away,
another Void Turbulence showed signs of massive space fracturing.
Han Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted.
It was clear, a Void riot was occurring there again!
But he had just suppressed the nearby Void Beasts.
What on earth was happening?

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 327: Faction Mission Activated, All Hands Mobilized
paragraphs: Han Xing was bewildered, utterly confused by the situation in front of him.
However, he quickly made a decision.
The next moment.
Han Xing directly opened the Witch Race communication channel and ordered, "All Legends within the Witch Race territory, and subordinate officers."
"Put down what you’re doing and proceed to the border for support, suppress the Void riot."
"Remember, everyone!"
Han Xing’s tone was somewhat serious.
It seemed he had underestimated the horror of the Void riot.
Although he had just effortlessly resolved a group of Void Beasts with firepower suppression.
But this didn’t mean that other borders had such firepower.
If the outbreak continued at this frequency.
It might really be as those Witch Race Legends said, the Witch Race Territory could turn into a paradise for Void Beasts.
Therefore, Han Xing ordered all soldiers to proceed to the border for support.
And within the Witch Race territory, with Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City present, there was no need to leave anyone behind for defense.
At this time.
Otto was nervously watching Han Xing from the side, seemingly waiting for Han Xing’s instructions.
Han Xing said, "You go too, lead the soldiers to suppress the Void riot here."
Otto gladly accepted the command.
The next moment.
Blue electric sparks burst from his body, and he vanished instantly from the spot.
At this moment, Han Xing manipulated his Divine Power to spread outward.
Enveloping the entire nearby area directly.
Meanwhile.
The space fragments floating mid-air, upon contact with Han Xing’s Divine Power, were directly stored in the backpack.
A system prompt appeared.
"Acquired Space Fragments * 23,040,000, acquired Void Soul Stones * 36..."
Upon hearing the prompt, a hint of surprise emerged in Han Xing’s previously cold pupils.
The twenty million Space Fragments were expected.
But those thirty-odd Void Soul Stones were an unexpected delight!
Including the previous first-time rewards of 200, Han Xing could now construct another twenty-plus High-Level Teleportation Arrays.
This would significantly enhance the speed at which Survivors from the Land of the Abandoned Gods could reach the Witch Race territory,
Moreover, it signaled something important to Han Xing.
Defeating these Void Beasts could procure Void Soul Stones.
Though the drop rate wasn’t high, there were plenty of Void Beasts.
And coincidentally, a large-scale riot of Void Beasts was occurring.
It was foreseeable that Han Xing could collect a multitude of Void Soul Stones next, and mass-produce High-Level Teleportation Arrays!
Thoroughly bring all Survivors over.
Any surplus Void Soul Stones, Han Xing could also use to build Teleportation Arrays in various border regions of the Witch Race.
Survivors could then support all major boundaries through these arrays at any time.
Although, as Han Xing had already verified.
These Teleportation Arrays could only be used by the Survivors of Blue Star.
Nevertheless, even so, the effect was terrifying.
Because the speed at which these Blue Star Survivors grew stronger had already been proven.
Amazingly terrifying.
As more and more Survivors break through the Fourth Transformation, even the Fifth Transformation!
Next.
The Witch Race Territory will become increasingly impregnable!
"It seems it’s time to summon more Survivors to the Witch Race Territory!"
Before Han Xing could put this idea into practice.
A system prompt appeared in everyone’s ears.
System Announcement: "All Survivors, please note, the Witch Race Territory is experiencing Void erosion, with a large number of Void monsters invading."
"Since the Witch Race Territory belongs to Han Xing’s camp territory, a camp mission has been initiated."
"Survivors may collect Space Fragments by defeating Void Beasts, for repairing the space."
"For each Space Fragment collected, you will receive equal Battle Merit rewards after repair, which can be exchanged in the store."
"Every time 100 million Space Fragments are repaired, Camp Fortune Value +1."
Upon hearing this system prompt.
The chat channel exploded once again.
"Brothers, there’s a camp task!"
"Indeed, following Star God, there’s never a shortage of things to do."
"This time, who knows what good stuff we’ll snag again."
Those Survivors not in the Witch Race Territory felt envious.
"Dang, there’s a Battle Merit Store again, I’m so jealous of those guys in the Witch Race Territory."
"When will it be my turn to go to the Witch Race Territory, the Star God’s teleportation arrays have a queue that goes on forever."
"Just wait patiently, as Star God said, he is collecting more materials to create High-Level Teleportation Arrays to let us through, so don’t rush."
Han Xing felt quite surprised after hearing the prompt.
"Camp task, huh?"
"The collected Space Fragments can be automatically submitted to the camp and receive Battle Merit rewards."
Han Xing nodded, "That’s pretty good."
"Not only can you get Battle Merits, but the experience from Void Beasts is also substantial."
"With this, all energetic Blue Star humans will have something to do."
And just then, a different prompt appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[Notice, as the camp leader, for this Void riot, you need to do your utmost to fend off the Void Beasts’ devouring of the real world.]
[At the same time, try to repair as much of the real space as possible.]
[For each 100 million Space Fragments collected and repaired, Camp Fortune Value +1, camp leader Divine Power Value +1.]
Clearly, this was a prompt only Han Xing could hear.
Though still repairing.
But through Han Xing’s hands, it could not only increase the Camp Fortune Value.
It could also enhance his Divine Power Value.
"Does this mean I need to collect a large number of Space Fragments and then repair space?"
Han Xing was quite surprised.
Because in this way, he needed to gather as many Space Fragments as possible from Survivors.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - 327: Faction Mission Activated, All Hands Mobilized
paragraphs: After pondering for a moment, Han Xing formulated a corresponding plan.
At present, although the void beasts are advancing aggressively.
As long as Han Xing deploys the troops and allocates a batch of defense towers for support, he should be able to barely hold on.
When Han Xing gathers more survivors over, the pressure will further be alleviated.
By then, it will be time to implement Han Xing’s plan.
Thinking of this.
Han Xing left two hundred Towers of Death Light with Otto, just in case.
Then, he operated the Sky Island, preparing to return to the Witch Race Continent.
He needed to build more high-level teleportation arrays to gather the survivors.
As Han Xing was hurrying back.
Within the Witch Race’s territory.
A large number of soldiers were ready and waiting.
They had all received orders from above.
Void beasts had invaded the Witch Race border, urgently requiring manpower support.
Although it had only been a week since the last Shadow Legion war.
Now, they had to go into the battle again.
For everyone, it was somewhat unbearable.
However, everyone knew that there was no other choice.
As soldiers, if they were not willing to go to the battlefield, who else could be relied upon to protect the country?
Moreover, in recent decades.
The high-intensity pressure from the Shadow Legion had accustomed the Witch Race soldiers to this pace.
Wars inevitably involve sacrifices.
Yet, there was no resentment among these billions of Witch Race soldiers!
If it weren’t for Saint Master Han Xing.
They would have died a week ago.
Including their loved ones, friends, even their homes, all would have been destroyed by the Shadow Legion.
Now, they could stand here alive, and bid farewell to their families in peace.
It was already an extremely fortunate thing.
At this moment.
A group of Witch Race officers was making wartime announcements.
Because Han Xing had merged a dozen Sky Islands of the Witch Race into a continent.
Above it, the populations mainly gathered in the main cities.
War broadcasts continuously echoed over the cities.
On this day, countless Witch Race civilians stepped out of their residences.
Spontaneously coming to the streets, watching those soldiers about to set off.
Seeing off the group of soldiers.
They knew it was the heroic struggle of these people that preserved the last piece of pure land for them.
At this moment.
A young girl with a clear face and witch patterns on her face tugged at her mother’s sleeve, asking softly.
"Mom... Mom... can I join the army in the future?"
The girl’s mother was slightly stunned, "Oh, my little Jasmine, why would you think like that?"
"The army is too dangerous, and you’re just a girl!"
This little girl named Jasmine timidly said, "I... I want to help Saint Master Han Xing too."
"I heard from Chong Chong that his brother is in the army and sees Saint Master Han Xing every day. He’s... he’s so impressive!"
The girl’s mother heard this, and the previously firm refusal in her heart softened instantly.
Now, Han Xing’s reputation in the Witch Race had been exalted to the highest point.
In the hearts of these Witch Race civilians, there was already a tendency to deify.
A moment later, she stroked the young girl’s head and said.
"Xiao Jasmine, if you want to join the army, Mom won’t oppose it."
"But you must know that what Saint Master Han Xing needs are soldiers who can fight for him."
"You’re still too weak to help Saint Master Han Xing."
Upon hearing this, the young girl quickly asked, "Mom, what should I do then?"
The woman pretended to think, "Hmm..."
"At the very least, you must be able to condense witch patterns and become a witch envoy to join the army."
The young girl’s clear eyes suddenly lit up,
"Mom, after becoming a witch envoy, can I see Lord Han Xing every day?"
Upon hearing this, the Witch Race woman laughed gently.
"Xiao Jasmine, Chong Chong is lying to you. His brother is just an ordinary soldier with no opportunity to see Lord Han Xing."
"Look at Officer Canya, commanding over a million soldiers, yet still can’t interact with Lord Han Xing daily."
The little girl seemed like a bucket of cold water had been poured over her, her enthusiasm extinguished instantly.
Moments later, she lifted her head again and asked, "Mom, how can I see Saint Master Han Xing every day?"
The Witch Race woman thought, "Hmm... perhaps, only someone at the level of the Saintess could see Saint Master Han Xing every day?"
Although, this was something the Witch Race woman said just to comfort the young girl.
However, hope rekindled in the young girl’s eyes.
She declared firmly, "I will work hard!"
"In the future, I will become as powerful as the Saintess!"
This scene was playing out across various towns on the Witch Race Continent.
Then.
Under the warm gaze of the citizens.
Groups of Witch Race soldiers boarded various transport ships, witch pattern battleships, and demon elephant war chariots in an orderly manner.
Then.
The army embarked.
Unwaveringly heading towards the Witch Race border!
While no one was paying attention.
The expressions of a group of Witch Race soldiers were extraordinarily stiff, appearing unusually pale.
Under the command of their captain, this group of Witch Race soldiers boarded the battleship.
As the hatch closed.
An eerie smile simultaneously appeared at the corners of their mouths.
Several hours later.
In Ten Thousand Stars City.
Over ten million survivors stood blankly beside an open space near the Lord’s Mansion.
They were initially supposed to join the Witch Race army in the campaign.
But they received temporary instructions from Han Xing to come to Ten Thousand Stars City and wait, as he had some announcements to make.
Although they didn’t know what Han Xing intended to do.
These survivors followed his instructions nonetheless.

At present, although the void beasts are advancing aggressively.
As long as Han Xing deploys the troops and allocates a batch of defense towers for support, he should be able to barely hold on.
When Han Xing gathers more survivors over, the pressure will further be alleviated.
By then, it will be time to implement Han Xing’s plan.
Thinking of this.
Han Xing left two hundred Towers of Death Light with Otto, just in case.
Then, he operated the Sky Island, preparing to return to the Witch Race Continent.
He needed to build more high-level teleportation arrays to gather the survivors.

Within the Witch Race’s territory.
A large number of soldiers were ready and waiting.
They had all received orders from above.
Void beasts had invaded the Witch Race border, urgently requiring manpower support.
Although it had only been a week since the last Shadow Legion war.
Now, they had to go into the battle again.
For everyone, it was somewhat unbearable.

As soldiers, if they were not willing to go to the battlefield, who else could be relied upon to protect the country?

The high-intensity pressure from the Shadow Legion had accustomed the Witch Race soldiers to this pace.
Wars inevitably involve sacrifices.
Yet, there was no resentment among these billions of Witch Race soldiers!
If it weren’t for Saint Master Han Xing.
They would have died a week ago.
Including their loved ones, friends, even their homes, all would have been destroyed by the Shadow Legion.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - 327: Faction Mission Activated, All Hands Mobilized
paragraphs: Before Han Xing arrived, this group of survivors casually found a place to rest.
Some simply lay down directly on the grass.
While appreciating the buildings around Ten Thousand Stars City, they occasionally whispered to each other.
They didn’t possess the kind of strict discipline found in the Witch Race army, appearing quite casual.
However, Han Xing didn’t really care about these things.
At this moment, the survivors were whispering: "What do you think the Star God wants us to do by staying here this time? Could it be some special mission?"
Other survivors shook their heads and said: "No idea, but who cares, as long as we’re following the Star God, it’ll never be wrong."
"Exactly, following the Star God is the only way to get food!"
"The Shadow Legion’s invasion this time allowed me to earn a lot of battle merit, not only changing into half a set of golden armor but also reaching level forty."
"Where in the Land of the Abandoned Gods would I find such an opportunity?"
"Exactly!"
Other survivors echoed.
Suddenly.
A survivor with a panicked expression walked over.
His face was pale, and he said with a trembling voice: "Brothers, I think I’ve discovered a bit of a secret about the Star God!"
Everyone turned to look upon hearing this.
"What secret?"
Feeling the pressure of being stared at by thousands of eyes, this survivor was overwhelmed.
After a moment, he swallowed and struggled to speak: "I was just curious and wandered around near the Star God’s Ten Thousand Stars City."
"As I wandered, I walked into an underground passage."
"That passage was incredibly dark, deep..."
At the same time.
More survivors turned their attention towards him.
The survivor’s words seemed to successfully pique their curiosity.
However, he suddenly stopped speaking.
Other survivors impatiently urged: "Go on, what was in the passage?"
"Yes, please continue."
The survivor swallowed again and then continued.
"I followed the passage further inside, going very deep, and discovered a vast underground world!"
"In this underground world, thousands upon thousands of goblins are living!"
"They seem to have been living under the Star God’s territory for a long time!"
The crowd: "..."
After hearing this, the others were speechless.
"Damn! Just a bunch of goblins? I thought it was something else."
"Exactly, making a fuss over nothing."
However, the survivor quickly added.
"No, listen to me!"
"It’s not just goblins! After I came out of that passage, I saw a valley shrouded in black smoke!"
"That valley clearly exudes an ominous aura, and inside, there was even a force that filled me with fear!"
"I summoned the courage to get closer and saw a large number of abyssal creatures!"
"There were large numbers of skeleton soldiers, ghosts inside!"
"And even some beings whose mere aura gave me a crushing feeling!"
This time, no one reprimanded him.
Because if what he said was true.
The fact that a human survivor’s territory harbored these undead creatures was indeed very strange.
At this time, the survivor nervously said: "Do you think the Star God’s hidden identity could be that of an undead mage?
"Leading an endless horde of undead creatures!"
"Is that why he’s so powerful?"
His speculation wasn’t baseless.
Being modern people who traversed from Blue Star,
they all knew that an undead mage is an extremely evil and powerful profession.
When coupled with Star River’s strength.
It indeed seemed very possible!
Moreover, if this really were true, it would be big news!
After all, Han Xing could now be considered the leader of the human camp.
If such a person were truly an undead mage, the impact would be significant.
While these survivors were enthusiastically discussing.
A familiar voice suddenly sounded above them.
"No need to guess, those are just the abyssal soldier species I’ve summoned."
Han Xing’s figure suddenly appeared.
The survivors unanimously looked up, focusing on that figure in the sky.
In the next moment, everyone’s expressions turned serious.
Like students caught red-handed whispering about their teacher in class.
Several survivors quickly said: "S...Star God, please don’t misunderstand, we were just chatting..."
Han Xing waved his hand, seemingly unconcerned.
In truth, at his level, there was no need to care about how others talked about him.
Even if he were truly an undead mage.
Under the absolute suppression of his current power, what more could they say?
At this moment, Han Xing said: "Thank you all for waiting."
"I asked you to stay for a reason, to announce a few things."
The survivors quickly dismissed it.
"Not at all, not at all, we haven’t been here long."
Others echoed: "Yes, Star God, you are too polite."
Han Xing smiled.
Then he got straight to the point: "Now, you all probably know that there is a large-scale void beast uprising happening at the Witch Race border."
"I’ll be brief."
Upon hearing this, everyone perked up their ears.
They knew that what Han Xing was about to say was
likely the reason he gathered everyone together.
Han Xing said: "All of you here were the earliest survivors to come to the Witch Race territory."
"Most of you have probably experienced the Shadow Legion invasion battle."
"Though it was extremely dangerous and tough, behind danger often hides more opportunities."
"I think many of you here have benefited from it."
These words gained the recognition of many survivors.
The last Shadow Legion invasion not only increased their level.
But they also acquired a lot of battle merit and exchanged it for many golden treasure chests.
They all nodded in agreement.
At this point, Han Xing continued.
"Now, the void beast uprising, for you, is an opportunity to rise quickly."
"Not only can you gain a lot of experience, but you can also use the dropped space fragments to acquire battle merit."
"If you feel the rewards from the battle merit store aren’t significant for your growth, you can also submit them to the camp."
"As long as the number of submitted space fragments reaches a certain amount."
"You can come to my territory and choose an abyssal soldier species for free as your contract creature!"
Upon hearing this.
All the survivors’ breaths hitched.
Before this, they were already aware of how formidable those soldier species on Han Xing’s territory were.
Not only were their levels exceedingly high, but their attributes were also exceptionally terrifying.
Especially the flying soldier species, the big-beaked bird, which they had coveted for a long time.
At once, a look of desire appeared in their eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 328: Redeeming the Godslaying Cannon and Deploying Troops
paragraphs: Upon hearing Han Xing say that space fragments could be exchanged for those monster troops,
all the survivors present immediately became excited.
After all, who doesn’t have a dream of soaring in the sky?
However, Han Xing was only referring to abyssal soldiers.
In other words, they could only choose from monsters like Skeleton Soldiers, Ghosts, and Demon Eyes.
As for Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs,
These two troops had been with Han Xing for quite some time.
They were loyal and protective of his safety.
For Han Xing to send them away now, he was reluctant.
Therefore, he simply decided to give away that group of abyssal soldiers as a reward.
This, however, brought a sense of disappointment to the survivors’ hearts.
At this moment, a survivor tentatively asked, "Star God, can we also select elite creatures from those abyssal soldiers?"
This was a question that concerned everyone.
The same abyssal monster, an elite monster could handle five or six creatures of the same level.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes."
"However, the stronger the troop, the more space fragments are needed to exchange."
"For instance, a Skeleton Soldier requires you to hand over 5000 space fragments, while a Skeleton Captain requires 20,000, and a leader level requires 50,000."
This number didn’t exceed everyone’s expectations.
On the contrary, it seemed a bit too low.
After all, for them, repairing ten thousand space fragments could only earn them ten thousand battle merits.
At most, they could only exchange for a Golden Treasure Chest.
In comparison,
It was clear that Han Xing’s troops were more tempting and provided greater help!
Beside him, another survivor couldn’t help but ask, "Star God, what about the Big-beaked Bird?"
"Can we choose the Big-beaked Bird as a contracted creature?"
"Even if it requires more space fragments, that’s okay!"
Other survivors chimed in, "Yes, yes!"
"We also want to contract the Big-beaked Bird."
They most yearned for these flying creatures like the Big-beaked Bird.
Han Xing knew their thoughts well.
The reason he deliberately didn’t mention it was to keep them in suspense.
At this point, he nodded and said, "This time, the Big-beaked Bird can also be contracted."
"Just like elite monsters, exchanging 20,000 space fragments allows you to select one Big-beaked Bird as a contracted beast.
Before the group of survivors could get excited, Han Xing added, "Furthermore, besides the Big-beaked Bird, there are stronger creatures like the Chimera."
"By handing over the corresponding space fragments, you may claim them from me."
"If you perform well enough, you might even gain a lord level contracted beast!"
Upon hearing this, the breathing of tens of millions of survivors below halted!
They all knew what a lord level contracted beast represented!
That was a terrifying power that could single-handedly face ten thousand, even a hundred thousand!
Having such a powerful contracted beast made one nearly invincible among survivors!
At this moment, these survivors cheered in unison.
"Long live the Star God!!!"
Seeing the enthusiasm of the crowd,
Han Xing nodded with a smile, "You can spread my words; next, I will gather more survivors to the Witch Race Territory."
"These newcomers will need you to guide them to get familiar quickly."
Hearing these words, everyone smiled knowingly.
Each excitedly said, "No problem, Star God!"
"We’ll ensure that these newcomers adjust within a day!"
This statement caused everyone to respond with meaningful laughter.
After all the survivors left,
The stern and majestic expression on Han Xing’s face faded away.
Then he sighed in relief, "Damn, having to always put on a mysterious front is truly troublesome."
"This suits me much better now."
With a casual smile on his face,
Han Xing went to the plaza near Ten Thousand Stars City.
Preparing to invest a large amount of materials to build more high-level teleportation arrays.
[Will you consume materials... to build a high-level teleportation array?]
"Yes."
Han Xing clicked several times in succession.
Then his figure flashed, appearing on another teleportation array.
At the next moment,
Han Xing once more returned to the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Xingyu City.
Currently near the teleportation array,
a large number of survivors were gathered, waiting to be teleported.
Seeing Han Xing appear, one by one, they beamed with joyous expressions.
However, Han Xing had no time to chat with them now.
After a simple greeting,
he finished setting up the teleportation array and immediately teleported back to the Witch Race Territory.
Witch Race Continent.
Ten Thousand Stars City.
A figure flashed,
appearing in the Lord’s Mansion.
This person was Han Xing.
In front of him stood a graceful figure.
A petite frame, long hair trailing to the ground.
It was none other than Saintess Wu Ling’Er.
However, today Wu Ling’Er seemed somewhat weak.
In the last great battle, Wu Ling’Er had repeatedly used too many forbidden techniques, suffering serious backlash.
If the deceased Witch Race legends hadn’t unanimously transferred their divine power to Wu Ling’Er,
she might have perished from the backlash of forbidden techniques.
Despite this,
Wu Ling’Er had to undergo a week’s recuperation to gradually restore some of her combat strength.
At this moment, seeing Han Xing,
Wu Ling’Er’s face broke into a joyful smile.
"Brother Han Xing!"
The next moment,
she ran up and threw herself into Han Xing’s embrace.
A fragrant breeze embraced him.
Han Xing naturally reached out and held Wu Ling’Er.
Looking at the beauty in his arms,
Han Xing stroked her silky hair and asked, "Ling’Er, how is your recovery?"
Wu Ling’Er lifted her head, eyes hazy, and said, "Mm-hmm! Ling’Er has been recovering well lately and can now fight again!"

With a casual smile on his face,
Han Xing went to the plaza near Ten Thousand Stars City.
Preparing to invest a large amount of materials to build more high-level teleportation arrays.
[Will you consume materials... to build a high-level teleportation array?]
"Yes."
Han Xing clicked several times in succession.
Then his figure flashed, appearing on another teleportation array.
At the next moment,
Han Xing once more returned to the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Xingyu City.
Currently near the teleportation array,
a large number of survivors were gathered, waiting to be teleported.
Seeing Han Xing appear, one by one, they beamed with joyous expressions.
However, Han Xing had no time to chat with them now.
After a simple greeting,
he finished setting up the teleportation array and immediately teleported back to the Witch Race Territory.
Witch Race Continent.
Ten Thousand Stars City.
A figure flashed,
appearing in the Lord’s Mansion.
This person was Han Xing.
In front of him stood a graceful figure.
A petite frame, long hair trailing to the ground.
It was none other than Saintess Wu Ling’Er.
However, today Wu Ling’Er seemed somewhat weak.
In the last great battle, Wu Ling’Er had repeatedly used too many forbidden techniques, suffering serious backlash.
If the deceased Witch Race legends hadn’t unanimously transferred their divine power to Wu Ling’Er,
she might have perished from the backlash of forbidden techniques.
Despite this,
Wu Ling’Er had to undergo a week’s recuperation to gradually restore some of her combat strength.
At this moment, seeing Han Xing,
Wu Ling’Er’s face broke into a joyful smile.
"Brother Han Xing!"
The next moment,
she ran up and threw herself into Han Xing’s embrace.
A fragrant breeze embraced him.
Han Xing naturally reached out and held Wu Ling’Er.
Looking at the beauty in his arms,
Han Xing stroked her silky hair and asked, "Ling’Er, how is your recovery?"
Wu Ling’Er lifted her head, eyes hazy, and said, "Mm-hmm!
Ling’Er has been recovering well lately and can now fight again!"

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 328: Redeeming the Godslaying Cannon and Deploying Troops
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded, "That’s good."
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er seemed to remember something and suddenly said, "Brother Xing, I heard that there’s been a large-scale Void Riot at the Witch Race Border, and the situation is very grave."
"Ling’Er has already recovered well and can enter the battle immediately."
"Brother Xing, don’t feel too pressured."
On hearing this, Han Xing was taken aback.
A moment later, he understood.
In the last great battle,
Wu Ling’Er ordered the entire Witch Race Continent to merge into Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City.
Although Han Xing’s power skyrocketed because of this, repelling strong enemies,
he accordingly took on the responsibility of protecting the entire Witch Race.
However, at that time, there was no other choice.
Now, coincidentally with the Void Beasts invading Witch Race Territory,
this matter wasn’t originally Han Xing’s to deal with.
But now, it’s fallen on his shoulders too.
Han Xing smiled and said, "It’s nothing, just a bunch of ordinary Void Beasts, hardly any Legends are seen, they don’t pose much pressure to me."
"You take a good rest, don’t worry too much."
Wu Ling’Er, hearing this, didn’t continue.
She knew, that Han Xing was willing to accept the merger of Witch Race Continent,
showing he was already prepared.
All she needed to do is silently support him from the shadows, to share his burden.
At this moment, Han Xing continued to ask, "Oh right, the things I asked you to gather last time, how’s it going?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, "Hmm, almost gathered."
"Throughout the Witch Race territory, a total of over 9 billion Shadow Crystals were collected."
"But compared to the number of Shadow Legion monsters we killed, this is just a portion."
"Most of the Shadow Crystals dropped in mid-air."
Saying this, Wu Ling’Er asked worriedly, "Brother Xing, are these Shadow Crystals enough?"
Han Xing’s face lit up with joy, "Enough! Fully enough!"
Right now, he still had over a billion Shadow Crystals in hand.
Added to these collected by Wu Ling’Er.
It’s more than enough to exchange for that High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint!
"Great! That’s really good."
Wu Ling’Er said happily.
"I’ve already asked those officers to transport all these crystals to the Lord’s Mansion warehouse. Brother Xing can directly retrieve them."
"Moreover, about this Void..."
Before Wu Ling’Er could finish her sentence,
her vision suddenly changed dramatically.
The next moment.
Han Xing directly scooped her up, holding her by the legs.
Wu Ling’Er’s face instantly turned a deep shade of red.
"Han... Han Xing, Brother..."
She shrunk in Han Xing’s embrace, seemingly knowing what was about to happen next.
She appeared both shy and somewhat expectant.
Two hours later.
Han Xing walked out of Wu Ling’Er’s sleeping quarters.
The beauty behind him wore a satisfied smile on her face and fell into a deep sleep.
Han Xing didn’t wake her either.
Instead, he walked alone towards the Lord’s Mansion underground warehouse.
Opening the warehouse interface.
Han Xing saw that the Shadow Crystal reserve had reached 11.2 billion.
He was filled with joy.
"Very good, with this, not only can I exchange for that Ancient Weapon Blueprint, but also a few extra Sun Treasure Chests!"
The next moment, Han Xing eagerly clicked to exchange.
[Would you like to spend 10 billion Shadow Crystals to exchange for the High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint: Spiritual Godslaying Cannon?]
"Yes."
[Exchange successful.]
Han Xing only saw a flash of light before him.
A suddenly yellowed blueprint appeared in his backpack.
This blueprint seemed to be made of an unknown material, feeling very delicate and smooth.
It recorded a uniquely styled, massive turret perfectly blending future and fantasy styles!
Han Xing clapped his hands together and immediately clicked to learn the blueprint.
The next moment, the attributes of the Godslaying Cannon appeared before Han Xing.
[Spiritual Godslaying Cannon]: Can shoot a devastating energy beam with armor-shattering effect, reducing armor cap by 25%, lasting one hour.
[Damage Range]: 100*50000 km
[Attack Power]: 500,000.
[Defense Value]: 300,000.
Han Xing’s eyes widened instantly, utterly shocked!
"Oh my..."
"500,000 Attack Power, nearly ten times that of the Tower of Death Light!"
"And it comes with an armor-shattering effect!"
"Plus a 50,000 km super long-distance strike!"
"Terrifying! Truly terrifying!"
"This thing is truly deserving of being a High-tier Ancient Weapon!"
Han Xing couldn’t stop marveling.
Without a doubt, this was the strongest weapon blueprint he’d seen since entering Sky Island Paradise.
Its terrifying Attack Power could potentially defeat ordinary Legendary Powerhouses with a single shot!
Even High-tier Legend.
If one shot doesn’t kill, they definitely can’t withstand a second!
Even a Demigod wouldn’t dare face the Godslaying Cannon’s power head-on!
After all, the phrase ’Godslaying’ already says it all!
Han Xing eagerly checked the crafting materials for this thing.
[Materials needed to build Spiritual Godslaying Cannon]: Philosopher’s Stone*5000, Shimmering Terra Stone*5000, Shadow Divine Stone*10,000, Calamity Divine Gold*10,
"Another money guzzler."
Han Xing’s face turned dark.
These High-tier Ancient Weapons, though immensely powerful,
it’s undeniable that their consumption is also frightfully high.
Even with an entire race supplying him with resources,
it’s still a bit hard to bear.
After all.
Building one Spiritual Godslaying Cannon almost matches the materials needed for half a Sun Crown Stele.
At this time, Han Xing helplessly said, "Based on the current materials of the Witch Race, we can only build 15 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons at most."

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 328: Redeeming the Godslaying Cannon and Deploying Troops
paragraphs: "However, this would mean depleting the Witch Race’s reserves from the past few millennia."
Although the Witch Race now belongs to Han Xing.
However,
he can’t truly arbitrarily dictate the use of precious materials.
After all, the Witch Race needs a large amount of the Philosopher’s Stone to construct various weapons for dealing with wars.
Han Xing contemplated, "These high-level Divine Stones are a significant gap for me."
"I must figure out how to acquire a batch of them."
"I remember Wu Ling’Er mentioned that compared to the Witch Race, those major races have far more terrifying foundations."
"It seems, to realize the idea of mass-producing Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, I have to start with those major races."
Han Xing gazed into the distance, as if he could see the silhouettes of those ancient nations.
However,
to head to those major races,
it means Han Xing would have to leave the Witch Race Territory.
Though his strength has reached the Legendary level, he doesn’t dare claim to be a match for those Demigods.
Moreover, the Witch Race’s territory still faces the threat of the Void Beasts.
So, this notion must temporarily be set aside.
Han Xing cleared his mind and shook his head, saying, "Let’s not think about it too much for now."
"Even if the Witch Race’s material reserves are scant, crafting three to four Spiritual Godslaying Cannons is more than enough."
"By then, I will have a new ace up my sleeve!"
Han Xing thought with confidence.
After all, with an Attack Power of 500,000 from the Godslaying Cannon,
combined with the amplification from the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele, it would be a million Attack!
By then, even a Demigod, if unable to dodge, might be left crippled.
[Would you like to consume materials... and craft a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon?]
"Yes."
[Building in progress... Time remaining: 34 hours 24 minutes...]
Han Xing tapped four times in succession.
The Witch Race Legends are all now hastening to the border battle.
When they return and find that the Witch Race’s treasury material reserves have diminished significantly, they will undoubtedly be astounded!
After all, the materials consumed by four Spiritual Godslaying Cannons,
are equivalent to decades of the Witch Race’s accumulation.
However, if they know it’s Han Xing who used them,
no one would say anything more.
Meanwhile,
after the prompt ended,
near Ten Thousand Stars City,
four smoke columns spanning over tens of thousands of square meters appeared.
"Such a vast area?"
Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
"It seems the size of this Godslaying Cannon is beyond what I imagined!"
After completing these tasks, Han Xing felt a bit more at ease.
Then, he sent a message in the team channel.
Instructing everyone to gather at the Lord’s Mansion.
Half an hour later,
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others were already waiting there.
Han Xing initiated the conversation, "Next, we shall also head to the border to battle."
"Currently, a massive Void Beast riot has erupted, and these monsters provide abundant Experience."
"It’s a great opportunity to help you all reach Level 50."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
During this period, the Abyssal Rift was inaccessible.
For a while, they hadn’t found a suitable place for leveling up.
This Void riot, while a disaster for other races,
is timely for them!
Moreover,
the thought of soon becoming Fifth Transformation Legendary Powerhouses like Han Xing,
made everyone extremely excited!
A Legend provides tremendous aid to an entire race!
Beyond their strength improvement, they are even more eager to catch up with Han Xing.
To offer him more assistance.
The next moment,
Han Xing once again separated a Sky Island from the Witch Race Continent.
Then led everyone to the Witch Race Border.
After several hours of travel,
Han Xing and his team arrived back at the Fourth Border battleground.
The very place where Han Xing previously ascended to Legend.
At this moment,
Witch Race Legend: Otto, was leading a massive number of soldiers, valiantly resisting the numerous and terrifying Void Beast Swarm.
To prevent them from further corroding the space of the Witch Race Territory.
At this moment,
the distant fleet continuously boomed.
"Boom! Boom, boom, boom!"
Artillery shells trailed thick smoke,
striking the beast swarm, causing terrifying explosions!
Yet,
the firepower that could instantly kill an average Fourth Transformation Elite Monster greatly diminished in its effect on this Void Beast Swarm.
One wave after another,
not only triggered the [Body of Nothingness] passive of many Void Beasts,
leaving them unscathed,
other Void Beasts, relying on their formidable Life Force, withstood this barrage.
Now, only the Witch Race Soldiers can stand the front line.
At this moment,
Otto was singlehandedly engaging two Fifth Transformation Dominator Level Void Beasts.
Although Otto was suppressing his opponents unilaterally,
his attacks did not achieve significant effects.
Most damages were dodged by the opponents using their [Advanced Void Body].
If this continues, even after a whole day,
Otto might not be able to deal with these two Void Beasts.
Nearby,
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, and others gained a direct awareness of these Void Beasts’ survivability once again.
"No wonder Otto said these Void Beasts are extremely hard to kill."
"Such a dodge probability is truly abnormal!"
And just as everyone was sighing,
they suddenly saw,
two arrows shooting out rapidly with a golden glow.
And with the speed of lightning,
hit the two Void Beasts simultaneously.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
Two astounding explosions echoed concurrently.
The next instant, the heads of these two Void Beasts were blown to oblivion.

[Successfully killed Fifth Transformation Dominator Level creature: Void Dark Soul, earning 763 million Experience Value, Divine Power from the opponent’s body has been automatically absorbed, Divine Power Value +1...]
[Successfully killed...]
Everyone stared in awe at the scene.
Including Otto, who had his attacks half charged and yet to be launched.
Seeing these two arrows, Otto knew.
It was Han Xing who intervened.
But this power, isn’t it too terrifying?

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 329: Quelling the Void Uprising, Void Ghost Wolf Advances!
paragraphs: Otto’s mind was in chaos.
Why.
Both are legends, and I even advanced many years before him.
Why is the gap so wide?
This is just too discouraging!
However, Han Xing didn’t know what he was thinking.
He shouted directly, "Otto."
Hearing Han Xing’s voice, Otto immediately snapped back to his senses.
A blue light flashed over him, and he appeared directly in front of Han Xing.
"I’m here!"
His tone was extremely respectful.
Clearly, those two arrows that Han Xing just shot completely won him over.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Next, you lead the warriors at the border to support other areas."
"Leave this place to us."
"Return in a week."
According to Han Xing’s estimation.
It would take at least a week.
For everyone to rise to level 50.
However, at this time, Otto looked bewildered and said, "Uh... Saint Master Han Xing."
"You mean, this border battlefield will be handled by just the five of you?"
Han Xing questioned, "Yes, is there a problem?"
Otto just wanted to say they couldn’t hold it.
But then he thought of the strength Han Xing had just demonstrated.
And immediately closed his mouth.
What a joke!
Even though this Saint Master has just broken through to legend, his combat power is beyond comparison!
By himself, he can stop an army of a million!
He cupped his hands and solemnly said, "Subordinate obeys the order!"
The next moment.
Otto’s figure appeared among the army.
Leading the Witch Race troops in an orderly retreat from the battlefield.
Han Xing and the other four quickly took over here.
At this moment.
Facing a sky full of void beasts.
The five were also at full firepower.
"Boom!"
Various large area skills were thrown down as if they were free.
Wave after wave of void beasts was slaughtered in pieces by them.
Experience soared.
Even the void beasts that triggered the passive [Body of Nothingness].
Would quickly be locked and blasted by the Tower of Death Light.
Of course, Han Xing would not allow just the five of them to fight.
Behind them, there were hundreds of advanced defense towers brought along.
Dealing with the battle here was more than enough.
Time flew by, and seven days passed...
During this period.
Across the Witch Race borders.
A total of 142 void riots erupted.
But they were all suppressed by those Witch Race soldiers with a fearless attitude.
Moreover.
With Han Xing sending various forces and defense towers for support.
Those previously daunting void beasts now seemed like they couldn’t make a ripple,
including on the Witch Race Continent, in Ten Thousand Stars City.
Those dozens of teleportation arrays shone with white light every moment.
Millions of survivors arrived at the Witch Race Territory from the Land of the Abandoned Gods every day.
Under the guidance of those ’veterans,’ they quickly integrated into the local environment.
Then they joined the Witch Race battlefield and participated in the fight.
Moreover, upon hearing that this time against the void beasts.
One could exchange space fragments for Big-beaked Birds, or even lord-level monsters.
The survivors went wild!
They rushed to the front lines without fear of danger, afraid of being one step behind.
With the addition of these war maniacs.
The situation at the Witch Race border further eased.
At the same time...
In the depths of the void turbulence.
Five people and a wolf appeared in this endless dark void.
It was Han Xing and his group.
After a week of farming void beasts.
The other four’s levels had all risen to level 50.
At this time, Otto returned promptly to take over the battlefield.
And Han Xing, with his teammates, proactively entered the lair of this void beast swarm.
Namely, the void turbulence.
In the dark void, many powerful void beasts were active.
Along the way.
Han Xing continuously drew his bow and shot arrows.
Under the boost of the ’Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill.’
He transformed into a human bomber.
Everywhere he passed, explosions echoed constantly.
One powerful void beast after another fell under his arrows.
Another seven days later.
They had already penetrated deep into the void turbulence, at least tens of millions of kilometers deep!
Upon reaching here.
Han Xing discovered that the number of void beasts began to decrease sharply.
However, the probability of encountering elite and even leader-level void beasts became higher.
But for Han Xing, as long as they weren’t legends, it made no difference.
Thus.
He confidently released Coal Ball.
Allowing it to fight these void beasts alone.
With Han Xing providing cover.
This little guy once again demonstrated its unmatched combat power in single combat.
Even against same-level leader-level void beasts, it could easily win.
"Awoo!"
In the void turbulence.
Chaos energies ran rampant.
Anything below the fifth transformation.
Would be shredded instantly upon contact with these chaotic energies!
Han Xing, too, could only lead the group deep into the dark void by using divine power to cover the entire Sky Island.
And in such a dangerous environment.
A black giant wolf roamed the dark void with ease.
This giant wolf was naturally Han Xing’s pet Coal Ball.
Perhaps due to its constitution.
Coal Ball wasn’t affected by those chaotic energies here.
If it weren’t for this giant wolf continuously preying on those void beasts.
Those void beasts might indeed have mistaken it for a kin.
Coal Ball’s slaughter naturally provoked a frenzied retaliation from the void beast swarm.
However, this little guy was undaunted.
Engaged in battle with the void beast group in the chaotic void.
"Roar!"
One void beast after another was bitten to death by Coal Ball.
The gigantic wolf paws reached out, making even elite-level void beasts unable to withstand.
When dealing with ordinary-level void beasts, Coal Ball’s slaughter efficiency was extremely high.
Even against leaders, or even lords above leader levels.

sentences.text: Otto’s mind was in chaos.
Why.
Both are legends, and I even advanced many years before him.
Why is the gap so wide?
This is just too discouraging!
However, Han Xing didn’t know what he was thinking.
He shouted directly, "Otto."
Hearing Han Xing’s voice, Otto immediately snapped back to his senses.
A blue light flashed over him, and he appeared directly in front of Han Xing.
"I’m here!"
His tone was extremely respectful.
Clearly, those two arrows that Han Xing just shot completely won him over.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Next, you lead the warriors at the border to support other areas."
"Leave this place to us."
"Return in a week."
According to Han Xing’s estimation.
It would take at least a week.
For everyone to rise to level 50.
However, at this time, Otto looked bewildered and said, "Uh...
Saint Master Han Xing."
"You mean, this border battlefield will be handled by just the five of you?"
Han Xing questioned, "Yes, is there a problem?"
Otto just wanted to say they couldn’t hold it.
But then he thought of the strength Han Xing had just demonstrated.
And immediately closed his mouth.
What a joke!
Even though this Saint Master has just broken through to legend, his combat power is beyond comparison!
By himself, he can stop an army of a million!
He cupped his hands and solemnly said, "Subordinate obeys the order!"
The next moment.
Otto’s figure appeared among the army.
Leading the Witch Race troops in an orderly retreat from the battlefield.
Han Xing and the other four quickly took over here.
At this moment.
Facing a sky full of void beasts.
The five were also at full firepower.
"Boom!"
Various large area skills were thrown down as if they were free.
Wave after wave of void beasts was slaughtered in pieces by them.
Experience soared.
Even the void beasts that triggered the passive [Body of Nothingness].
Would quickly be locked and blasted by the Tower of Death Light.
Of course, Han Xing would not allow just the five of them to fight.
Behind them, there were hundreds of advanced defense towers brought along.
Dealing with the battle here was more than enough.
Time flew by, and seven days passed...
During this period.
Across the Witch Race borders.
A total of 142 void riots erupted.
But they were all suppressed by those Witch Race soldiers with a fearless attitude.
Moreover.
With Han Xing sending various forces and defense towers for support.
Those previously daunting void beasts now seemed like they couldn’t make a ripple,
including on the Witch Race Continent, in Ten Thousand Stars City.
Those dozens of teleportation arrays shone with white light every moment.
Millions of survivors arrived at the Witch Race Territory from the Land of the Abandoned Gods every day.
Under the guidance of those ’veterans,’ they quickly integrated into the local environment.
Then they joined the Witch Race battlefield and participated in the fight.
Moreover, upon hearing that this time against the void beasts.
One could exchange space fragments for Big-beaked Birds, or even lord-level monsters.
The survivors went wild!
They rushed to the front lines without fear of danger, afraid of being one step behind.
With the addition of these war maniacs.
The situation at the Witch Race border further eased.
At the same time...
In the depths of the void turbulence.
Five people and a wolf appeared in this endless dark void.
It was Han Xing and his group.
After a week of farming void beasts.
The other four’s levels had all risen to level 50.
At this time, Otto returned promptly to take over the battlefield.
And Han Xing, with his teammates, proactively entered the lair of this void beast swarm.
Namely, the void turbulence.
In the dark void, many powerful void beasts were active.
Along the way.
Han Xing continuously drew his bow and shot arrows.
Under the boost of the ’Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill.’
He transformed into a human bomber.
Everywhere he passed, explosions echoed constantly.
One powerful void beast after another fell under his arrows.
Another seven days later.
They had already penetrated deep into the void turbulence, at least tens of millions of kilometers deep!
Upon reaching here.
Han Xing discovered that the number of void beasts began to decrease sharply.
However, the probability of encountering elite and even leader-level void beasts became higher.
But for Han Xing, as long as they weren’t legends, it made no difference.
Thus.
He confidently released Coal Ball.
Allowing it to fight these void beasts alone.
With Han Xing providing cover.
This little guy once again demonstrated its unmatched combat power in single combat.
Even against same-level leader-level void beasts, it could easily win.
"Awoo!"
In the void turbulence.
Chaos energies ran rampant.
Anything below the fifth transformation.
Would be shredded instantly upon contact with these chaotic energies!
Han Xing, too, could only lead the group deep into the dark void by using divine power to cover the entire Sky Island.
And in such a dangerous environment.
A black giant wolf roamed the dark void with ease.
This giant wolf was naturally Han Xing’s pet Coal Ball.
Perhaps due to its constitution.
Coal Ball wasn’t affected by those chaotic energies here.
If it weren’t for this giant wolf continuously preying on those void beasts.
Those void beasts might indeed have mistaken it for a kin.

However, this little guy was undaunted.
Engaged in battle with the void beast group in the chaotic void.
"Roar!"
