The gigantic wolf paws reached out, making even elite-level void beasts unable to withstand.
When dealing with ordinary-level void beasts, Coal Ball’s slaughter efficiency was extremely high.
Even against leaders, or even lords above leader levels.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 329: Suppressing the Void Turmoil, Void Ghost Wolf Evolves! (Part 2)
paragraphs: With Han Xing’s help, they soon defeated the opponent.
At this moment, Coal Ball slaughtered all the way, fully displaying the aura of a king.
Two hours later...
Han Xing saw that Coal Ball’s potential value finally broke through ten thousand!
At this point, the system prompt appeared.
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ has reached the potential value limit. Do you wish to evolve?]
"Evolve!"
Han Xing clicked confirm without hesitation.
The next moment.
The black aura on Coal Ball’s body suddenly surged!
As if the entire void was trembling for it.
In Han Xing’s surprised gaze.
The chaotic energy sufficient to instantly kill a fourth-turn lord.
Actually all surged towards Coal Ball.
Moreover, Coal Ball not only didn’t feel any discomfort.
On the contrary, its momentum began to soar rapidly!
In a short time, it broke through from the Elite Level to Leader Level!
And that’s not all.
As Coal Ball roared at the sky.
"Awooo!"
A pressure belonging to Lord Level exploded fiercely from Coal Ball’s body!
At this moment, Coal Ball’s figure expanded tremendously.
From the original four or five meters, it grew to nearly ten meters!
It’s already considered a giant beast.
Simultaneously, several prompts appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Evolution successful. Your pet Coal Ball’s growth has been enhanced. Current level: SS-level.]
[All attributes increased by 50%.]
[Activated new skill: Void Eternal Night!]
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
The increase in Coal Ball’s growth not only dramatically boosted its attributes.
It also activated a new skill.
[Void Eternal Night]
The name alone sounds like it carries a high level of prestige.
With a feeling of anticipation, Han Xing checked Coal Ball’s current attributes.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Fourth-turn Lord Level)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV46]
[Attributes: Power 5023, Agility 9082, Spirit 4854, Constitution 4914]
[Affinity: 100]
[Satiety: 90 (Good)]
[Growth: SS (Can increase pet’s growth through potential value, next level: SS+, required potential value: 100,000)]
[Skills]: Body of Nothingness, Counterattack Spike, Power of the Void, Void Flashes, Void Absorption, Void Frenzy, Dark Eternal Night (Domain Skill)
ps: (Not filler content, just haven’t presented Coal Ball’s panel completely in a while.)
Han Xing noticed.
After evolving to SS growth, not only was there a new skill, but a new evolution level was unlocked.
SS+
Han Xing pondered: "The SS-level Coal Ball now has attributes equivalent to a lord of the same level."
"The SS+ degree Coal Ball should be equivalent to a dominator of the same level."
"Then, a higher level SSS should be legendary creatures!"
This guess might very likely be correct.
After all.
The cultivation methods of the natives of this world are different from Han Xing and the others.
Even for Coal Ball as a pet, the system did not offer an ultimate evolution method.
So, this evolution path should be the most correct one.
Han Xing nodded silently.
Then, he continued to check the new skill Coal Ball just activated.
[Void Eternal Night]: Exclusive domain skill for the Void Royal Family.
[Skill Effect: Centered around the Void Royal Family themselves, forcibly turning the surrounding agility*1 meter space into a void area.
Under the Void Eternal Night state, all skills of the Void Royal Family have their effects doubled (except Body of Nothingness).
Additionally, the Void Frenzy skill enters a no-CD state.
The Void Eternal Night effect lasts 60 seconds, cooldown time 8 hours.]
After reading the introduction of this new skill.
Han Xing revealed a thoughtful expression.
The first two effects can be understood, nothing more than activating a domain, pulling enemies into the void together.
And doubling all skill effects afterward.
This is also easy to understand.
However, the last part of the introduction makes the Void Frenzy skill enter a no-CD state.
This is a bit strange.
It has been so long, Han Xing almost forgot the introduction of this skill.
So, he clicked to view it again.

[Void Frenzy]: The Void Ghost Wolf condenses the power of the void, bursting out 10,080 void line bodies, causing large-scale damage to all enemies within 30 meters that ignores defense. If the void line body successfully hits the target, it applies the Void Domain effect on the target.

In the Void Domain state, the enemy cannot move, and significant life force is lost every second until the opponent dies. (Note: Creatures caught in the Void Domain can forcibly break free with their own power, the break free time is determined by both parties’ attributes and state checks.)

[Void Raid (Passive)]: Creatures caught in the Void Domain will trigger the Void Raid effect, the Void Ghost Wolf continuously absorbs the power of the creatures in the domain, replenishing its own life value. If there are legendary creatures in the domain, their origin power will be absorbed, enhancing the Void Ghost Wolf’s potential value.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to have thought of something, and his pupils contracted instantly.
Damn!
This skill sounds quite complex.
The actual effect is that Coal Ball releases void line bodies, inflicting group damage and control on enemies.
And it’s accompanied by the effect of absorbing origin and life force.
It can be said that it transforms Coal Ball’s damage from single to group.
However, this skill also has a fatal flaw.
That is a 24-hour CD.
But now, as long as it’s within the Void Eternal Night state.
It’s equivalent to Coal Ball being able to cast this skill repeatedly without restriction within 60 seconds!
This is extremely overpowering!
With this skill, Coal Ball’s monster-killing speed will qualitatively change!
And just at this moment.
The commotion from Coal Ball’s breakthrough seemed to have also alarmed more void beasts in the Void Turbulence.
They all rushed toward Coal Ball.
Among them were even two lord-level creatures.
However, this time, Han Xing did not step in to help.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 329: Suppressing the Void Turmoil, Void Ghost Wolf Evolves! (Part 3)
paragraphs: He knew that the attributes of Coal Ball had increased significantly.
Its actual combat power had already far surpassed that of Lords of the same level.
Even ordinary Dominator-level creatures were no match for it!
Coal Ball was more than capable of handling the current situation.
And indeed, that was the case.
In front of everyone.
Coal Ball directly activated the [Void Eternal Night] state.
In an instant.
The originally dark void turbulence, filled with various chaotic energies, suddenly calmed down.
It was as if the entire space had solidified together.
Coal Ball raised its head high and leisurely walked among the Void Beasts.
Wherever it passed, all the Void Beasts stood frozen, their bodies trembling.
Han Xing and the others looked closely.
And found that at some point, these Void Beasts were covered with densely packed threads.
Their bodies were completely pierced through!
Countless Void Beasts seemed to have been drained and withered instantly.
Meanwhile, the aura of Coal Ball was increasing at a terrifying speed.
At this moment, Coal Ball.
Truly resembled a king in the void, as described by the skill.
Wherever it went, all the Void Beasts submitted to it.
Looking at Coal Ball’s majestic appearance.
Cheng Jianyong joked, "Wow, Little Coal Ball is doing well."
"This aura is almost catching up to mine!"
Watching his narcissistic look, Shen Yun couldn’t help but roll her eyes again.
However, it’s undeniable.
Coal Ball is genuinely powerful now!
At this moment, the person most touched was Han Xing.
A year ago, when Coal Ball was just born, it was only the size of his palm.
In the blink of an eye, it had grown to this height.
It was like watching his own son grow up, filling him with emotion.
However, what surprised Han Xing even more was yet to come.
As Coal Ball activated [Void Eternal Night] and went all out.
Wherever it went, all the Void Beasts died.
And Coal Ball’s Potential Value was skyrocketing at a terrifying speed!
In just over ten seconds.
Han Xing saw Coal Ball’s Potential Value increase by over a thousand points!
If it continued at this rate, by the end of 60 seconds.
Coal Ball could increase its Potential Points by at least ten thousand!
Han Xing was extremely excited!
If not for the eight-hour cooldown of the [Void Eternal Night] skill.
It would take only one day.
For Coal Ball to absorb tens of thousands of Potential Points and complete the SS+ evolution!
After the 60 seconds ended.
As expected by Han Xing.
Coal Ball’s Potential Value reached 13,213 points.
After another round eight hours later, it could exceed twenty-five thousand.
That’s about a quarter of the progress.
Which means.
For Coal Ball to complete the SS+ evolution, it would take no more than three days!
Han Xing was extremely excited!
At this rate, it won’t be long.
Even Coal Ball can break through to Legendary Level!
Now, Han Xing already knew.
The origins of this little creature are somewhat astonishing.
The Void Royal Family, just the name sounds impressive.
Moreover, Han Xing had a vague feeling.
After Coal Ball breaks through to Legendary, it will undergo an unimaginable transformation.
Next.
Han Xing continued to protect Coal Ball.
While farming Potential Value, they continued to delve deeper into the void turbulence.
The Sky Island of Han Xing.
Was like a spacecraft wandering in the vast cosmos.
Advancing against various howling energies.
After another few minutes.
Shen Yun suddenly asked, "Brother Xing, are we almost at our destination?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Almost there."
"Otto told me, the deeper into the void turbulence, the greater the chance of encountering those powerful Void Beasts."
"Next, if we encounter a Fifth Transformation Dominator Level Void Beast, I’ll try to create an opportunity for you all to face it alone."
"Let’s strive to all break through to Legendary today!"
Everyone was instantly excited upon hearing this.
Indeed.
The reason they’re delving deep into the void turbulence this time.
Is to find some Fifth-Turned Void Beasts, to complete the challenge tasks.
And then, for the whole team to break through to Legendary!
The Sky Island continued to float.
After advancing for about another half-hour.
A huge shadow suddenly appeared in the chaotic void.
The shadow had a serpentine form, but with three heads.
It spanned over ten thousand meters long!
Such a colossal creature, emanating a strong sense of oppression!
Before Han Xing, the attributes of this monster appeared.
[Void Mad Snake: Five-Star Dominator Level Creature]
[Level]: 53.
[Attributes]: Power 13167, Agility 12574, Spirit 14764, Constitution 11412.
[Divine Power Value]: 323
[Skills]: Advanced Void Body, Curse Touch, Domain of Greed, Ultimate Skill — Three Spirits Descending!
After seeing the attributes of this monster, everyone’s eyes lit up.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Wow, it really is a Dominator Level creature!"
"Now, our challenge task has hope."
Han Xing also nodded.
This Void Mad Snake, compared to the Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast that Han Xing encountered before, was clearly weaker.
Now, Han Xing had discovered a new method to determine the strength of Fifth-Turned Creatures.
That is, to check the opponent’s Divine Power Value.
Certainly, the higher the Divine Power Value, the stronger the strength.
Obviously, while this Void Mad Snake is not as powerful as the Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast.
But it’s also not weak.
However, this perfectly fits
But, there’s only one Dominator Level creature before them.
Which means, they need to decide on just one person to complete the challenge task first.
After some contemplation.
Han Xing looked at Zhang Lianmeng and said, "Lian’Er, you go."
Zhang Lianmeng’s pretty face showed a look of surprise.
She seemed not to expect Han Xing to choose her first.
Han Xing naturally had his reasons.
Zhang Lianmeng, as a Mage, had the second greatest destructive power in the team after him.
Once she becomes Legendary, she would undergo a qualitative transformation.
Moreover.
Among the Witch Race, many Forbidden Techniques are exclusive to Mages.
Only Legendary Level can learn them.
By that time, Zhang Lianmeng reaching the Legendary Mage level would greatly benefit Han Xing and the entire team.
Everyone had no objections.
They all wholeheartedly supported Han Xing’s decision.
At the same time.
The Void Mad Snake also noticed them.
Six deep-set eyes looked over simultaneously.
The massive ten-thousand-meter-long body was like a starry sky behemoth.
Emitting an aura of coldness and bloodlust!
"Ssss!"
The three heads of the Void Mad Snake opened simultaneously, emitting a piercing hiss.
As everyone thought.
This Void Mad Snake was about to charge at them.
But instead, they saw.
Its massive body suddenly twisted and then began crazily escaping into the depths of the void turbulence.
This scene left Han Xing and the others quite stunned.
But soon, Han Xing reacted.
He shouted, "Damn it, this guy’s trying to run away!"
"Let’s chase it!"

Obviously, while this Void Mad Snake is not as powerful as the Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast.
But it’s also not weak.
However, this perfectly fits
But, there’s only one Dominator Level creature before them.
Which means, they need to decide on just one person to complete the challenge task first.
After some contemplation.
Han Xing looked at Zhang Lianmeng and said, "Lian’Er, you go."
Zhang Lianmeng’s pretty face showed a look of surprise.
She seemed not to expect Han Xing to choose her first.
Han Xing naturally had his reasons.
Zhang Lianmeng, as a Mage, had the second greatest destructive power in the team after him.
Once she becomes Legendary, she would undergo a qualitative transformation.
Moreover.
Among the Witch Race, many Forbidden Techniques are exclusive to Mages.
Only Legendary Level can learn them.
By that time, Zhang Lianmeng reaching the Legendary Mage level would greatly benefit Han Xing and the entire team.
Everyone had no objections.
They all wholeheartedly supported Han Xing’s decision.
At the same time.
The Void Mad Snake also noticed them.
Six deep-set eyes looked over simultaneously.
The massive ten-thousand-meter-long body was like a starry sky behemoth.
Emitting an aura of coldness and bloodlust!
"Ssss!"
The three heads of the Void Mad Snake opened simultaneously, emitting a piercing hiss.
As everyone thought.
This Void Mad Snake was about to charge at them.
But instead, they saw.
Its massive body suddenly twisted and then began crazily escaping into the depths of the void turbulence.
This scene left Han Xing and the others quite stunned.
But soon, Han Xing reacted.
He shouted, "Damn it, this guy’s trying to run away!"
"Let’s chase it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - 330: Server-wide Announcement, Consecutive Breakthroughs
paragraphs: "This guy wants to run, let’s chase!"
The words fell.
Han Xing directly controlled his own divine power, bringing the Sky Island beneath his feet to start the rapid pursuit.
The others were quite surprised.
It seemed unexpected that this Void Mad Snake was so fierce.
At this moment, it actually ran away directly!
But thinking about it, it made sense.
Among the five of them.
Everyone had the ability to fight across levels.
Plus, Han Xing was an authentic legendary powerhouse.
The Shadow Mad Snake sensed Han Xing’s presence at the moment and knew it wasn’t his opponent.
So it chose to turn around and flee.
Han Xing controlled the Sky Island and chased after it furiously.
Actually.
With his current power, he had a hundred ways to kill this Void Mad Snake instantly.
He didn’t need to chase laboriously at all.
But there’s no choice.
The challenge task required them to kill alone.
If Han Xing helped, the task would be deemed a failure.
Moreover, Han Xing was also carrying a whole Sky Island, resisting the Void Turbulence while pursuing.
Thus, Han Xing’s advance speed was somewhat hindered.
But, it didn’t stop him from being faster than this Dominator level creature!
In just two or three minutes.
Han Xing closed the distance between himself and the Shadow Mad Snake.
Seeing the huge creature still trying to run.
Han Xing’s eyes focused.
As he released his divine power.
A powerful aura suddenly swept across hundreds of miles!
The Shadow Mad Snake seemed to see something terrifying and came to a halt.
At this moment, Han Xing smiled inwardly.
"Using divine power to intimidate the opponent is indeed effective!"
"However, I only used divine power to stop it and didn’t cause any harm to this guy."
"The system shouldn’t determine the challenge task is invalid, right?"
Han Xing was also helpless.
This Void Mad Snake had incredibly high spiritual intelligence; without using this method.
It couldn’t be stopped at all.
At this moment.
The Void Mad Snake, seeing the aura Han Xing displayed.
Knew that it could not escape today.
The ferocity belonging to the Void Race erupted from within.
"Hiss!"
With a hiss.
In the next moment.
It prepared for a desperate fight.
However.
In the puzzled gaze of the Void Mad Snake.
It saw only a Fourth Transformation human mage step forward.
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng gained temporary flying ability after consuming the Gale Wings Secret Elixir.
Thus.
She could fly in the air without relying on Han Xing’s divine power.
The Void Mad Snake clearly showed disdain in its eyes.
Originally thinking it would be the legendary powerhouse taking action personally.
But these humans dared to underestimate it so much.
They actually only sent a mage who hadn’t reached the Fifth Transformation.
Well, today it would first eliminate this female mage and teach them a lesson!
The words fell.
The Void Mad Snake directly activated the domain skill.
Domain of Greed.
Terrorizing void energy erupted from its body.
Hundreds of kilometers around plunged into dense darkness.
However.
It didn’t expect Zhang Lianmeng to be even more decisive.
As she entered the battle state suddenly.
Zhang Lianmeng activated the special effects of all her equipment.
At this moment.
Her aura underwent a qualitative transformation!
Directly reaching the level of an average legendary powerhouse!
The Shadow Mad Snake was also very surprised at this human mage’s transformation.
But the battle had already begun now.
The Shadow Mad Snake knew what its advantage was.
So, at the first moment, it opened its gaping mouth wide.
Rushing towards Zhang Lianmeng at an incredibly alarming speed!
If it were an average survivor, they might have panicked at this moment.
But.
As someone who always stuck with Han Xing.
Zhang Lianmeng looked frail.
But her combat experience was far richer than anyone could imagine!
She had experienced countless battles both big and small.
She began with a massive Ice Cone Technique straight away.
The terrifying chill instantly froze the Void Mad Snake into a huge ice sculpture.
The charging momentum of the Void Mad Snake came to a halt.
Relying on its terrifying strength, cracks began to appear densely on the ice covering the Void Mad Snake.
It seemed about to break free.
However, Zhang Lianmeng was not panicking at all.
She swung her Magic Staff.
The Leiyun in the sky instantly condensed into form.
And besides the Leiyun, the sky was filled with endless Leiyun.
Zhang Lianmeng actually completed the casting of three magic spells in an instant!
Multi-Casting!
Moreover, as she raised her Magic Staff high.
In the next moment.
Five fireballs the size of locomotive engines fiercely crashed over.
"Boom!"
"Snap!"
A mushroom cloud suddenly rose.
Scorching the massive body of the Void Mad Snake to a crisp, with skin and flesh torn.
Along with various Leiyun and meteorites crashing down.
And the relentless ice cone barrage.
That area completely transformed into an ocean of elements.
The Void Mad Snake was nearly being ravaged one-sidedly, unable to break free at all.
However, it was not over yet.
Zhang Lianmeng directly transformed into a bomber!
All kinds of skills were unleashed onto the Shadow Mad God without restraint.
She even directly used her only Forbidden Curse skill.
Heaven-Burning Fire Rain!
At this moment.
The originally dark void was thoroughly illuminated by the blazing flames.
Countless fireballs fell from the sky.
And each fireball had destructive power no less than that of the Meteor Technique.
This scene directly stunned everyone.
Cheng Jianyong swallowed hard, "Sister Lian Meng... That burst of hers is really kind of scary..."
Beside him, Shen Yun nodded in agreement.
Although, Zhang Lianmeng’s terrifying burst state lasted only for a few seconds.
But it was already completely sufficient.
Half a minute passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 330: Global Server Announcement, Consecutive Breakthroughs
paragraphs: With a loud explosion.
The massive body of the Shadow Mad Snake shattered into pieces before everyone’s eyes.
The towering flames gradually subsided.
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng took a deep breath, seemingly calming her emotions after making her move.
The next moment.
Zhang Lianmeng turned around, revealing an excited smile.
There was also a rosy tint on her face due to exerting too much strength.
She looked at Han Xing and said, as if seeking praise, "Brother Xing, I did it!"
Han Xing also smiled and gave her a thumbs up.
"Amazing!"
Receiving Han Xing’s praise.
Zhang Lianmeng shyly lowered her head.
At this time, Han Xing asked, "Did you get the Legendary Seal?"
This was a concern of Han Xing’s.
He was worried that his initial use of divine power to deter the Void Mad Snake would lead the system to deem it not a solo accomplishment.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng softly said, "Yes, I got it."
Hearing this, Han Xing finally let out a sigh of relief.
"Good, now you can attempt to break through to legendary."
Hearing these words.
Everyone looked expectantly at Zhang Lianmeng.
Although they had already witnessed Han Xing’s legendary breakthrough.
It was quite terrifying!
However, a mage and a hunter are different.
A Legendary Mage can truly be revered as a Magic God.
Facing the eager eyes of everyone, Zhang Lianmeng appeared a bit embarrassed.
Han Xing comforted her at this moment: "It’s okay, just go ahead and break through."
"With me by your side, nothing will happen."
Hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng nodded vigorously.
Then, Han Xing traded her several hundred masses of [Divine Power Source Fire].
This item was the main material needed to break through to legendary, greatly increasing the probability of success.
As Zhang Lianmeng began her breakthrough.
At this moment, the dark void.
In the surrounding area of tens of thousands of miles.
All kinds of turbulent energy surprisingly began to calm down.
Han Xing saw.
The once terrifyingly destructive Void Turbulence.
At this moment, surprisingly began to automatically comb through itself.
Then, it converged into Power of Elements, either red or purple.
Furthermore, they would gather together.
Then surge into Zhang Lianmeng’s body.
This scene, in the eyes of others, might not be much.
However, upon seeing it, Han Xing fell into deep shock.
"These energies in the void, after being separated, actually transform into various elemental powers!"
"I even saw powers of law from other systems among them!"
"Could it be that the various powers we use in battle originate from the void?"
"Or is it that the entire Holy Spirit Realm was born in the void?"
Han Xing couldn’t help being startled by his own conjecture.
Because this involved the ultimate secret of this world!
Han Xing did not continue thinking.
Because he currently did not have more information to verify his guesses.
However, the scene before him still gave Han Xing a different perspective.
Being able to organize chaotic void energy.
To such an extent.
This method almost exceeded Han Xing’s imagination.
Even though Han Xing was now a powerful legend, his perception of the void was still chaotic.
In it, he couldn’t sense any elemental powers at all.
Let alone, strip it down and organize it into various elemental powers.
Apart from the system, Han Xing couldn’t think of anyone in this world who could have such means.
Meanwhile.
Zhang Lianmeng’s breakthrough was also reaching its end.
With a burst of terrifying momentum from her body!
Four different colors of divine power emerged from Zhang Lianmeng’s body.
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng became a Legendary Powerhouse!
At the same time.
Han Xing suddenly heard a prompting voice in his ear.
System Announcement: "Attention all survivors, Survivor Qing Meng has completed the fifth transformation, officially becoming a Legendary Powerhouse."
"Let us congratulate this powerhouse for making great contributions to the rise of the Human Race!"
This announcement sounded in everyone’s ears.
At this moment.
Survivors in battle stopped their actions upon hearing this system prompt.
Meanwhile.
The chat channel once again erupted in heated discussion.
"Qing Meng... This name feels so familiar yet seems just out of reach."
"Yes, I feel it’s familiar too."
"When did our Human Race produce such a powerhouse, breaking through to legendary so quickly!"
Prior to this, Zhang Lianmeng had always been very low-key.
Never easily revealing her power in front of others.
Except for the few times before, when Han Xing helped her climb the leaderboard.
After that, Zhang Lianmeng rarely showed up.
So, this created a situation where survivors felt both unfamiliar and somewhat familiar with Zhang Lianmeng.
However, many still remembered Zhang Lianmeng in the chat channel.
Those survivors exclaimed, "No need to guess, this Qing Meng is a friend of the Star God, having appeared on the leaderboard several times before."
"Rumor has it, she’s one of the Star God’s teammates!"
Hearing this, everyone suddenly realized.
"Wow, turns out she’s a friend of the Star God, no wonder the name felt so familiar!"
"Yes, I was wondering, besides the Star God, who at this stage could break through to legendary so swiftly."
"Since she is a friend of the Star God, it’s expected."
Other survivors echoed this sentiment.
"No wonder he’s the Star God!"
"Not only has he broken through to legendary well ahead of us, but now he’s also bringing his friends to legendary!"
Everyone was envious.
At this moment, compared to them,
Han Xing also heard a different prompt.

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 330: Server-wide Announcement, Consecutive Breakthroughs
paragraphs: [Survivor Han Xing, a new legendary powerhouse has appeared in your camp, increasing camp strength, Fortune Value +100.]
Han Xing’s eyes revealed a trace of joy.
Just as he had predicted before.
A new Legend can add a hundred points of Fortune Value to the camp.
At this rate, reaching a hundred thousand Fortune Value and a 100% attribute boost for everyone is just around the corner!
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng’s gentle voice brought Han Xing’s thoughts back.
"Brother Xing, I just broke through to Legend, and the system rewarded me with 10 Legendary Points, what’s the use of them?"
Hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up again with joy.
Legendary Points can be used to draw Legendary Skills.
And Han Xing had personally verified it.
Each Legendary Skill is beyond imagination in power.
However.
When he broke through, the system rewarded him with a full hundred Legendary Points.
While Zhang Lianmeng could only draw her first Legendary Skill with the 10 points she received.
Han Xing then replied, "They are used to draw Legendary Skills."
"Didn’t you notice that after we completed the Fifth Transformation, we didn’t learn any new skills?"
"These Legendary Points are equivalent to new skills in a disguised form."
Hearing this, not only Zhang Lianmeng, but the others also appeared to be enlightened.
Han Xing continued, "Go ahead and draw; Legendary Skills are really powerful."
"Mm-hmm!" Zhang Lianmeng immediately agreed.
The next moment, she clicked to draw.
Like Han Xing, a white light appeared on Zhang Lianmeng’s body.
Zhang Lianmeng suddenly fell silent for a moment.
Then her small mouth slightly opened.
"Such... such a powerful Legendary Skill!"
Hearing this.
The curiosity in everyone’s eyes grew even stronger.
At this time.
Zhang Lianmeng conveniently posted the skill.
[Legendary Skill — Ice Age]: Gathers all the power of ice elements, causing all enemies within the ’Spirit*10 meters’ area to enter an absolute frozen state.
The frozen targets will suffer an additional 200% ice element damage, and after the skill ends, the ice layer will explode, inflicting 1500% magic damage.
The effect lasts for 5 seconds, with a cooldown of 24 hours.
This skill, compared to Han Xing’s Broken Moon technique, has a similar wondrous influence.
It also features a 5-second strong control and 1500% explosive damage.
The difference is.
This skill deals higher damage and is a group control.
After looking through the attributes of this Legendary Skill.
Everyone felt envious.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Wow, what an overpowered skill!
"When can I draw one too?"
Han Xing chuckled, "Don’t rush, after breaking through to Legend, you should all have a chance."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was instantly exhilarated!
He looked forward even more to the changes after he breaks through to Legend.
Han Xing continued to control the Sky Island beneath him, advancing through the void turbulence, facing various violent elemental forces head-on.
The further they went in.
The chaotic energy inside became increasingly violent.
Reaching this point.
It could even pose a threat to ordinary Fifth Transformation Powerhouses.
However, under the protection of Han Xing’s divine power.
This chaotic energy had no effect on them.
Soon, they spotted a new Dominator Level creature.
[Void Demon Soul: Five-Star Dominator Level]
Similarly, these Dominator Level creatures almost turned and ran at the sight of Han Xing and his group!
Han Xing and the others pursued relentlessly.
Upon catching up, Han Xing used divine power again to intimidate.
They intercepted it.
Then it was time for other teammates to make their appearance.
However.
The second to appear was not Cheng Jianyong.
But rather Su Xiaoyang.
As a hidden profession, the Elf Shooter.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang donned the Divine Artifact Level Elf Crown.
Her whole being exuded a sacred aura.
After her breakthrough.
Her strength became even more formidable.
At this moment.
Su Xiaoyang stood firm amidst the violent void turbulence.
And, as the effects of her equipment activated one by one.
She reached a Legendary Level of prowess.
This moment.
The [Elf Queen’s Holy Crown] atop Su Xiaoyang’s head emitted a dazzling light.
The entire void was illuminated.
And within this glow.
A nimble figure kept changing positions, shooting arrows.
Su Xiaoyang’s combat style was noticeably more agile.
Especially since she had an [Elf Secret Technique — Void Vine] as a control skill.
This Void Demon Soul had virtually no means to retaliate.
A few minutes later.
The battle was declared over.
Su Xiaoyang lightly returned to the Sky Island, smiling as she said, "Done, Brother Han Xing."
Han Xing also gave her a thumbs up.
"Well done, Xiaoyang, you’re great!"
Seeing his teammates being able to handle matters independently without his help.
Han Xing genuinely felt gratified.
However, hearing Han Xing’s praise, Su Xiaoyang’s angelic face quickly turned red.
She was briefly at a loss for words.
"No... it’s nothing..."
Zhang Lianmeng, as Su Xiaoyang’s close friend.
Immediately noticed her embarrassment and quickly held her hand.
Su Xiaoyang felt a bit more at ease.
Han Xing also understood the nature of the young girl and didn’t pay much attention to it.
"Xiaoyang, you should break through to Legend now."
"By the way, Lian’Er, give the extra Divine Power Source Fire to Xiaoyang." Han Xing said, looking at the two girls.
"Alright."
The two girls responded simultaneously.
After completing the [Divine Power Source Fire] transaction.
Su Xiaoyang clicked to break through.
At the same time.
The entire void turbulence began to calm again.
Countless energies flowed into Su Xiaoyang’s body.
When the commotion ended.
Survivors worldwide heard a familiar announcement.
System announcement: "All survivors, please note, Survivor Clever Little Sheep has completed the Fifth Transformation advancement and officially become a Legendary Level powerhouse."
"Let us congratulate this powerhouse for making a great contribution in the rise of the Human Race!"
Chat Channel: "..."
Everyone: "..."
The next moment, an explosion of reactions followed.
"Damn it!"
"Another Legend!"
"This Clever Little Sheep seems to be one of the Star God’s people!"
"This is terrifying!"

sentences.text: [Survivor Han Xing, a new legendary powerhouse has appeared in your camp, increasing camp strength, Fortune Value +100.]
Han Xing’s eyes revealed a trace of joy.
Just as he had predicted before.
A new Legend can add a hundred points of Fortune Value to the camp.
At this rate, reaching a hundred thousand Fortune Value and a 100% attribute boost for everyone is just around the corner!
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng’s gentle voice brought Han Xing’s thoughts back.
"Brother Xing, I just broke through to Legend, and the system rewarded me with 10 Legendary Points, what’s the use of them?"
Hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up again with joy.
Legendary Points can be used to draw Legendary Skills.
And Han Xing had personally verified it.
Each Legendary Skill is beyond imagination in power.
However.
When he broke through, the system rewarded him with a full hundred Legendary Points.
While Zhang Lianmeng could only draw her first Legendary Skill with the 10 points she received.
Han Xing then replied, "They are used to draw Legendary Skills."
"Didn’t you notice that after we completed the Fifth Transformation, we didn’t learn any new skills?"
"These Legendary Points are equivalent to new skills in a disguised form."
Hearing this, not only Zhang Lianmeng, but the others also appeared to be enlightened.
Han Xing continued, "Go ahead and draw; Legendary Skills are really powerful."
"Mm-hmm!" Zhang Lianmeng immediately agreed.
The next moment, she clicked to draw.
Like Han Xing, a white light appeared on Zhang Lianmeng’s body.
Zhang Lianmeng suddenly fell silent for a moment.
Then her small mouth slightly opened.
"Such... such a powerful Legendary Skill!"
Hearing this.
The curiosity in everyone’s eyes grew even stronger.
At this time.
Zhang Lianmeng conveniently posted the skill.
[Legendary Skill — Ice Age]: Gathers all the power of ice elements, causing all enemies within the ’Spirit*10 meters’ area to enter an absolute frozen state.
The frozen targets will suffer an additional 200% ice element damage, and after the skill ends, the ice layer will explode, inflicting 1500% magic damage.
The effect lasts for 5 seconds, with a cooldown of 24 hours.
This skill, compared to Han Xing’s Broken Moon technique, has a similar wondrous influence.
It also features a 5-second strong control and 1500% explosive damage.
The difference is.
This skill deals higher damage and is a group control.
After looking through the attributes of this Legendary Skill.
Everyone felt envious.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Wow, what an overpowered skill!
"When can I draw one too?"
Han Xing chuckled, "Don’t rush, after breaking through to Legend, you should all have a chance."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was instantly exhilarated!
He looked forward even more to the changes after he breaks through to Legend.
Han Xing continued to control the Sky Island beneath him, advancing through the void turbulence, facing various violent elemental forces head-on.
The further they went in.
The chaotic energy inside became increasingly violent.
Reaching this point.
It could even pose a threat to ordinary Fifth Transformation Powerhouses.
However, under the protection of Han Xing’s divine power.
This chaotic energy had no effect on them.
Soon, they spotted a new Dominator Level creature.
[Void Demon Soul: Five-Star Dominator Level]
Similarly, these Dominator Level creatures almost turned and ran at the sight of Han Xing and his group!
Han Xing and the others pursued relentlessly.
Upon catching up, Han Xing used divine power again to intimidate.
They intercepted it.
Then it was time for other teammates to make their appearance.
However.
The second to appear was not Cheng Jianyong.
But rather Su Xiaoyang.
As a hidden profession, the Elf Shooter.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang donned the Divine Artifact Level Elf Crown.
Her whole being exuded a sacred aura.
After her breakthrough.
Her strength became even more formidable.
At this moment.
Su Xiaoyang stood firm amidst the violent void turbulence.
And, as the effects of her equipment activated one by one.
She reached a Legendary Level of prowess.
This moment.
The [Elf Queen’s Holy Crown] atop Su Xiaoyang’s head emitted a dazzling light.
The entire void was illuminated.
And within this glow.
A nimble figure kept changing positions, shooting arrows.
Su Xiaoyang’s combat style was noticeably more agile.
Especially since she had an [Elf Secret Technique — Void Vine] as a control skill.
This Void Demon Soul had virtually no means to retaliate.
A few minutes later.
The battle was declared over.
Su Xiaoyang lightly returned to the Sky Island, smiling as she said, "Done, Brother Han Xing."
Han Xing also gave her a thumbs up.
"Well done, Xiaoyang, you’re great!"
Seeing his teammates being able to handle matters independently without his help.
Han Xing genuinely felt gratified.
However, hearing Han Xing’s praise, Su Xiaoyang’s angelic face quickly turned red.
She was briefly at a loss for words.
"No... it’s nothing..."
Zhang Lianmeng, as Su Xiaoyang’s close friend.
Immediately noticed her embarrassment and quickly held her hand.
Su Xiaoyang felt a bit more at ease.
Han Xing also understood the nature of the young girl and didn’t pay much attention to it.
"Xiaoyang, you should break through to Legend now."
"By the way, Lian’Er, give the extra Divine Power Source Fire to Xiaoyang." Han Xing said, looking at the two girls.
"Alright."
The two girls responded simultaneously.
After completing the [Divine Power Source Fire] transaction.
Su Xiaoyang clicked to break through.
At the same time.
The entire void turbulence began to calm again.
Countless energies flowed into Su Xiaoyang’s body.
When the commotion ended.
Survivors worldwide heard a familiar announcement.
System announcement: "All survivors, please note, Survivor Clever Little Sheep has completed the Fifth Transformation advancement and officially become a Legendary Level powerhouse."
"Let us congratulate this powerhouse for making a great contribution in the rise of the Human Race!"
Chat Channel: "..."
Everyone: "..."
The next moment, an explosion of reactions followed.
"Damn it!"
"Another Legend!"
"This Clever Little Sheep seems to be one of the Star God’s people!"
"This is terrifying!"

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 331: Everyone Ascends to Legend, Divine Demon Swordsmanship!
paragraphs: The survivors were shocked beyond words.
"What on earth is the Star God doing over there? How come there’s another Legend so soon!"
At this moment, another survivor said, "It’s really ridiculous. I heard those Witch Race people say that every Legendary Powerhouse is a one-in-a-million genius."
"But even these geniuses have to be stuck for several years, or even decades, at the last step to break through to Legend!"
"I really don’t know how the Star God does it."
Meanwhile.
Han Xing received another system alert unique to him.
[Camp Fortune Value +100...]
A faint smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Because he felt his attributes increase by dozens of points again.
Although.
Fortune Value can only provide a 0.1% increase.
But Han Xing’s attributes are terrifying!
With the addition of the Saint Master title, the average is almost breaking forty thousand!
At this moment.
Su Xiaoyang softly asked, "Brother Han Xing, I’ve also been rewarded 10 Legendary Points, should I draw now?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Draw. I also want to see what the Elf Shooter’s Legendary Skills are."
"Mm-hmm," Su Xiaoyang responded.
Then, directly began drawing her own Legendary Skills.
A white light descended on her head.
Moments later.
Su Xiaoyang opened her eyes and pasted the newly acquired skill on.
[Legendary Skill - Nature’s Fury]: Converge the Power of Nature to increase skill damage by 100%.
Each hit imprints a layer of nature mark on the target.
After Nature’s Fury state ends, explode all nature marks, dealing cumulative damage to the enemy.
This state lasts for 20 seconds, with a cooldown of 20 hours.
After looking at Su Xiaoyang’s skill, Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
Unlike my and Zhang Lianmeng’s control skills.
It’s a pure damage skill.
However, it doesn’t mean that Su Xiaoyang’s skill isn’t strong.
On the contrary, it’s absurdly strong.
Skill damage increased by one hundred percent.
And after it ends, it also explodes the accumulated damage.
If it can deliver full damage, the damage coefficient might even rival Han Xing’s Ultimate Skill!
Su Xiaoyang was also very satisfied with this skill.
Plus, the attribute boost gained after breaking through to Legend.
At this moment.
Out of five people, three have already completed their transformation of strength.
Now, only Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong are left.
Next.
Han Xing continued to lead everyone deeper into the Void Turbulence.
On the way, also encountered one or two Legendary Void Beasts.
They seem to have a lot more courage than those Dominator Level Void Beasts.
Unexpectedly dared to pounce towards Han Xing.
And Han Xing didn’t indulge them.
Directly used a [Gale·Break].
One arrow.
Instantly hit the Legendary Void Beast.
The next moment.
It triggered an astonishing explosion.
The huge bodies of these Legendary Void Beasts instantly had a big hole shot through them.
If it weren’t for their body size reaching tens of thousands of meters, granting them strong life.
They might have been instantly killed by Han Xing!
However, after taking Han Xing’s arrow.
These Legendary Level Void Beasts, in panic, began to flee desperately.
Han Xing didn’t continue to chase them down.
Because he quickly found a new target.
Another Fifth Transformation Dominator Level Creature.
[Void Spirit: Five-star Dominator Level]
[Level]: 52
[Attributes]: Power 11032, agility 10451, Spirit 15884, Constitution 10412
[Divine Power Value]: 278
This time, it was Shen Yun’s turn to make a move.
As a support profession, Shen Yun’s combat power has never been outstanding.
But due to the system’s requirements.
He must challenge solo to complete the advancement.
He had no choice but to grit his teeth and go.
However, compared to other Dominator Level creatures.
This was already the most suitable opponent for Shen Yun.
Just look at its attributes to know.
This Void Spirit is a kind of low-attack, fragile Void Beast.
And its only special feature is, nearly sixteen thousand Spirit Attribute.
And Shen Yun has a bunch of skills that are immune to Psychic Damage.
So in dealing with this Void Beast, Shen Yun is most skilled.
Besides, even if Shen Yun can’t handle it.
There are still three Legendary Powerhouses nearby to protect him.
It’s impossible to let anything happen to him.
Shen Yun, after drinking the Gale Wings Secret Elixir, quickly began the battle.
It was indeed as everyone had anticipated.
Dealing with such creatures.
Shen Yun coped with them very skillfully.
Originally nervous, Shen Yun immediately relaxed.
This Dominator Level Creature’s various Mental Attacks.
Didn’t affect him at all!
At this moment.
The tension on Shen Yun’s face vanished, and he suddenly burst into laughter.
He raised the Big Hammer and charged forward without hesitation.
"I hammer! I hammer!"
"I’ll hammer you to death! Hahaha!"
The Void Spirit was hammered continuously, its aura fluctuating endlessly.
But soon, it broke free from Shen Yun’s entanglement, reopening the distance to fight again.
Yet it found.
The guy with the hammer in hand soon pounced on it like a parasite.
This battle lasted longer than before.
It fought for several hours.
Even the Void Spirit was already tired from the fight.
But, whenever it tried to run away.
Han Xing would intercept its path in advance.
Then, activate all Defense Towers to lock onto the Void Spirit.
If it dared to run, then Han Xing would unhesitatingly launch an attack, focusing fire to instantly kill it!
The Void Spirit was nearly in tears.
The guy behind, like a stubborn piece of iron, kept hammering it with a hammer.
Just hammering is fine, but the damage is so low.
It’s practically a form of torture!

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - 331: Everyone Ascends to Legend, Divine Demon Swordsmanship! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Now he couldn’t run, he could only endure the scraping damage from this creature.
However.
Han Xing didn’t care what it thought, and continued to lock onto the opponent with the defense tower.
After another half hour.
This Void Spirit was finally smashed to death by Shen Yun with a hammer.
It seemed to have found relief, as a strange smile appeared on its pitch-black face.
At this moment.
Shen Yun, who completed the challenge.
Excitedly ran in front of everyone to boast about his battle achievements.
But obviously.
He was mercilessly ridiculed by Cheng Jianyong.
"Took so long to take down a single Dominator."
"Even with Brother Xing and the others covering for you."
"I think this Dominator wasn’t killed by you, but more like it was exhausted to death!"
Shen Yun rolled his eyes.
However, he didn’t care.
Now, nothing compares to the joy of his impending breakthrough to Legendary!
The next moment.
Shen Yun immediately began to initiate the breakthrough.
At the same time.
The entire Void Turbulence suddenly appeared covered in a pristine Holy Light spanning thousands of miles.
"Boom boom boom!"
The light shimmered.
The originally dark void suddenly became as bright as paradise.
The commotion from Shen Yun’s breakthrough was even more terrifying than that of Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang!
At the same time.
The dense Holy Light began converging onto Shen Yun.
Shen Yun unconsciously floated into the air.
As his aura continued to rise.
Shen Yun slowly spread his arms, a devout expression on his face.
At this moment.
Everyone even saw that three pairs of wings grew from Shen Yun!
Like a descent of a Six-winged Archangel.
A few seconds later.
The commotion subsided.
The familiar full server announcement sounded once again.
System Announcement: "All survivors please note: Survivor Yun Tianming has completed the Fifth Transformation, officially becoming a Legendary Level powerhouse."
"Let us congratulate this powerhouse for making great contributions in the rise of the Human Race!"
The survivors were stunned again.
The name Yun Tianming, they didn’t even need to look, they knew it was one of the Star God’s friends.
Three people breaking through to Legendary in a row.
This made them wonder.
Could it be that what the Witch Race officers told them was false?
That breaking through to Legendary is actually an easy task?
Han Xing wasn’t watching the chat channel, so naturally he didn’t know what others thought.
Shen Yun here, as usual, drew a Legendary Skill.
Then he posted the skill information directly into the group channel.
[Legendary Skill - Great Angel Judgment]: Summons the phantom of the Archangel, forcing all enemies into a state of blindness.
The Archangel phantom continuously releases Holy Light Wings, dealing successive Holy Light bombardments to enemies, each wave’s damage coefficient is Spirit Attribute * 10.
The effect lasts for 15 seconds, skill cooldown: 24 hours.
Shen Yun showed a disappointed expression.
He originally thought the skill he drew this time would be an auxiliary type skill.
However, it seemed to be a group damage skill.
Although the damage coefficient was quite explosive.
Much more terrifying than Zhang Lianmeng’s Forbidden Curse.
But he couldn’t utilize it.
He was in the support position on the team.
In usual battles, Shen Yun didn’t need to take action.
If it were a Legendary Level support skill, it would enhance everyone much more.
"Brother Xing..."
Shen Yun was a bit embarrassed.
Han Xing patted his shoulder and said, "It’s okay, don’t worry about it."
"In the future, gather more Legendary Points, and you can continue to draw other Legendary Skills."
"Moreover, the Legendary Skill you have now is already quite impressive."
"At least if we aren’t around, you’ll have a stronger means of self-protection."
Shen Yun nodded heavily.
Han Xing was right, they couldn’t always stay together.
If Shen Yun encountered an unexpected situation.
With this skill, he could still complete a clearing.
At this moment.
Cheng Jianyong was already impatient!
Now, of the five people in the team, only he hadn’t broken through to Legendary.
As an impatient person, it wasn’t easy for Cheng Jianyong to hold out until he was the last one to break through.
Han Xing also satisfied him.
Directly controlled the Sky Island to search for other Dominator Level creatures’ traces.
Half an hour later.
They finally discovered a Void Beast that looked like a flower.
Everyone’s mouth twitched.
Looking at the darkness of the void.
That gigantic flower was slowly opening and closing.
It’s hard to accept that this thing was actually called a Void Beast.
This trip to the Void Turbulence.
Also let Han Xing see the unique nature of the Void Beast race.
They indeed didn’t have a fixed form, it’s almost impossible to see two Void Beasts exactly alike.
[Void Five-leaf Flower: Five-star Dominator Level creature]
After seeing this monster’s attributes.
No need for Han Xing to say, Cheng Jianyong already charged forward on his own.
"Swish!"
A blue shadow flashed by.
At the moment Cheng Jianyong was wearing the [Thousand Ridge Set], holding the Divine Artifact [Eternal Guardian].
Without even getting close, he posed a significant threat to that Dominator Level creature.
The petals of the Void Five-leaf Flower swiftly opened and closed, as if it intended to swallow Cheng Jianyong whole.
However, at this moment.
Various state effects on Cheng Jianyong activated.
His aura began to soar.
Then, wielding the sword with both hands, he shouted.
"Take this Storm Chaos Dance!"
With those words, Cheng Jianyong’s figure vanished from his original spot.
At the same time.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure appeared simultaneously at eight directions of the huge flower.
"Swish swish swish!"
The sound of rending the air came eight times in succession.
The body of the Void Five-leaf Flower, tens of thousands of meters big.
Miraculously showed eight cracks.

A few minutes later.
The Void Five-leaf Flower had already endured countless slashes from Cheng Jianyong.
The petals on it had completely fallen off.
At this moment.
The injuries it had sustained seemed to exceed its body’s tolerance limit.
Amidst the surprised gazes of everyone, its massive body exploded with a boom!
Cheng Jianyong also completed the challenge task in the process.
After retrieving the Divine Artifact Longsword, Cheng Jianyong returned to the Sky Island.
Then, he directly initiated Legendary Advancement.
In an instant.
The entire void was shrouded in endless sword qi!
Cheng Jianyong raised the Divine Artifact Longsword in his hand high.
And shouted: "Today, I, Cheng Jianyong, will once again become a Land Sword Immortal!"
Countless sword qi converged from his sword tip.
"Whoosh!"
"Whoosh!"
Sword qi intertwined, the world trembled!
When Cheng Jianyong opened his eyes.
In his pupils, there was even an astonishing burst of sword qi!
How mighty!
At the same time.
The server-wide announcement came once again.
Billions of survivors who heard this notification were already numb.
Today, they had already felt waves of shock.
Four consecutive server-wide announcements.
Let them know that the entire Human Race had gained four more Legendary Powerhouses.
Moreover, these powerhouses brought them a 0.4% increase.
In their hearts, besides envy, there was also a sense of shared glory and pride.
At the same time.
Cheng Jianyong also gained 10 Legendary Points.
Because he had examples to follow from the previous individuals.
He also chose to draw directly.
A flash of white light passed by.
Cheng Jianyong’s face showed a look of surprise.
"Holy crap! I got something good!"
"This skill is so freaking strong!"
Hearing this, looks of curiosity appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Before this, the skills drawn by the other three were already incredibly powerful.
But judging from Cheng Jianyong’s reaction.
This new skill seemed even more formidable than theirs?
"What is it?" Shen Yun asked eagerly.
Cheng Jianyong glanced at him with pride, then directly posted the skill information.
[Divine Demon Swordsmanship - Storm Style]: Generates a Sword Array in front, covering an area: agility * 10 meters.
All creatures within the Sword Array have their movement speed reduced by 50% and will suffer slashing damage from the sword qi storm.
Each point of power can generate one sword qi, with a maximum of one million sword qi.
Skill cooldown time: 24 hours.
Upon seeing this skill’s attributes.
Everyone simultaneously swallowed.
No wonder Cheng Jianyong’s reaction was so exaggerated.
It was indeed because the strength of this skill was too overpowered!
According to Cheng Jianyong’s current attributes, with 17694 agility (including equipment bonuses) * 10 meters, it could form a Sword Array with a diameter of ten kilometers.
And with his power nearing twenty thousand.
That is, he could release nearly twenty thousand sword qi!
If it was a small-sized creature, it might still dodge part of the sword qi’s slashing.
But if it was a large-sized creature.
It would completely take the damage from these twenty thousand sword qi.
The damage coefficient, just thinking about it, made people tremble!
If combined with Shen Yun’s two blessings and Sun Skills.
The strength of Cheng Jianyong’s skill would soar another level.
Seeing everyone’s expressions at this moment, Cheng Jianyong laughed proudly.
"How about it, impressive or not?"
"Xiaoyunzi, remember to throw me a few more buffs in the future."
"Watch me perform what it’s like to have a Sword Shatter Void!"
Seeing his smug expression, Shen Yun was speechless.
But in this way.
They were already considered to have all completed the Legendary Advancement.
Everyone had obtained tremendous boosts.
Five Legendary Powerhouses are no joke.
In any tribe, they would be a force to be reckoned with.
Moreover, they were not just ordinary legends.
According to Han Xing’s estimation.
Just with the combat power of these five alone.
They could at least take on fifty Legendary Powerhouses from the Shadow Legion!
And even emerge victorious.
However.
Compared to everyone’s joy.
The legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race were stunned.
Within just over ten hours.
They felt the power within their bodies continuously increasing.
In some inexplicable way, they seemed to sense the emergence of a powerhouse.
But in recent years, no peerless genius had appeared in the entire Witch Race.
And no one was heard to be nearing a breakthrough to Legend.
Moreover, it wasn’t just one.
But successive breakthroughs!
The next moment, they realized.
This was the handiwork of their new Saint Master, Han Xing.
And these newly emerged powerhouses.
Must be the Human Race members beside Saint Master Han Xing!
Because as early as some time ago, they felt that the aura of the few members beside Saint Master Han Xing was already at the typical Fourth Transformation limit.
A breakthrough now was expected.
At this time, a strong sense of shock appeared in the eyes of all Witch Race legends!
If.
Before this, the strength of the Human Race in comparison to the Witch Race was like ants’ insignificance.
Among billions of humans, only Han Xing could be considered a capable powerhouse.
The merger of the Witch Race with the Human Race was a lucky break driven by desperation of near extinction for the Witch Race.
Yet now, even without relying on the Witch Race.
The Human Race had the strength to establish a foothold in this world!
At that moment, the Witch Race legends suddenly recalled a remark once made by the Saintess.
The merger of the Witch Race into the Human Race wasn’t the Human Race reaching beyond their capabilities.
On the contrary, it was them reaching beyond theirs to join the Human Race.
With the presence of that one.
The level to which this race could develop was beyond imagination!

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 332: Opportunity! The Land of Treasure!
paragraphs: Within the void turbulence.
Shen Yun suddenly asked, "Brother Xing, we’ve now all broken through to Legend level, completing this mission’s goal."
"Can we go back now?"
This time, they had ventured several million kilometers into the void turbulence.
The atmosphere inside became increasingly chaotic, and the surrounding scenery was almost identical.
It was simply impossible to sense their direction.
If not for the existence of the system map.
They might have lost themselves in the void turbulence.
Han Xing looked at his backpack.
Apart from all five reaching the Legendary level on this void journey.
There was another gain.
That was the Void Soul Stones.
One or two void soul stones erupted from the bodies of those Lords and Dominator Level void beasts.
Although the quantity was not much.
But in total, there were over a hundred stones.
The harvest was quite good.
Moreover, now the Witch Race’s various borders are helping to collect these soul stones.
The goal of leading out billions of survivors worldwide by Han Xing is soon to be achieved.
At this moment, Han Xing nodded and said, "Well, it’s about time to go back."
After speaking, Han Xing controlled the Sky Island, preparing to turn back.
Then suddenly——
Coal Ball seemed to have sniffed something.
It jumped in front of Han Xing, continuously sniffing with its nose.
Then, it lightly rubbed Han Xing’s arm.
Watching Coal Ball’s strange behavior.
Han Xing asked in confusion, "What’s wrong, Little Coal Ball? Did you discover something?"
Coal Ball looked at Han Xing, gently nodding.
Then, its eyes stared in the deeper direction of the void turbulence.
It seemed something important was attracting it there.
Seeing Coal Ball’s action.
The others showed a look of confusion.
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
Before this.
Han Xing had already noticed Coal Ball’s unusual identity.
Being from the void race, Coal Ball seemed more intelligent.
And the note on the system skills vaguely suggested.
Coal Ball might be a member of the Void Royal Family.
Han Xing wasn’t quite sure what a royal family was.
But such a creature having special methods and talents in the void was reasonable.
Perhaps what Coal Ball discovered was very important to it?
Thinking of this, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, let’s explore deeper into the void."
"Now that we’ve all entered the Legend level, our strength has greatly increased."
"Even if we encounter danger, we can handle it."
Everyone unanimously agreed.
Hearing Han Xing’s consent.
Coal Ball appeared more excited.
Continuously exhaling heat, it rubbed its large head against Han Xing.
Han Xing smiled.
Then, he controlled the Sky Island, entering deeper into the void turbulence.
Under Coal Ball’s guidance.
They braved the violent void energy, continuing forward for about half an hour.
This was already the extreme depths of the void turbulence.
The surroundings were filled with chaotic energy.
These chaotic energies possessed extremely strong lethality.
If a Fourth Transformation powerhouse came in contact, they would almost certainly die.
Even an average Fifth Transformation couldn’t sustain for long.
At this moment, these raging chaotic energies continued to impact Han Xing’s divine power shield.
The Sky Island began to wobble slightly.
Even Han Xing’s divine power shield seemed to struggle to hold.
The team members seeing this.
All followed Han Xing’s example, releasing divine power shielding the Sky Island.
Although Cheng Jianyong and the others had just broken through.
Once they broke through, they had four to five hundred divine power values.
At the Legendary level, they weren’t weaklings.
With the teammates’ divine power joining in.
The previously shaky Sky Island now regained stability.
After advancing for another half hour.
The surrounding chaotic energy became even more violent.
Han Xing’s brows furrowed slightly.
As they ventured deeper, the danger level of the environment skyrocketed.
A single mistake, if caught in the void turbulence, could lead even Legendary powerhouses to perish.
He estimated, even Saint Master Helas never reached this depth.
Han Xing looked ahead.
He found Coal Ball still staring forward.
As if something there was attracting its attention.
Seeing Han Xing glance at it.
Coal Ball gazed back longingly, seemingly hoping Han Xing would continue forward.
Han Xing thought for a moment, then continued controlling the Sky Island deeper into the void.
"Whew—"
Here, the void turbulence’s chaos grew more terrifying!
With each step forward, everyone felt an increasingly intense pressure.
Even the five layers of divine power shields they stacked struggled to hold.
"Brother Xing, things are looking bleak..."
Cheng Jianyong said somewhat nervously, "I feel if we go a bit further, the shields will break."
Hearing this, everyone felt a sense of crisis.
Han Xing’s brows furrowed.
After a moment, he made a decision in his heart.
Advance a little further.
If they still don’t find what Coal Ball discovered,
Then they’ll head back.
Even if hidden treasures exist in the void.
You need to stay alive to claim them.
Han Xing braced himself and advanced about ten more kilometers.
"Boom!"
"Boom Boom Boom!"
The void turbulence here had already formed various solid objects.
Some resembled red lightning, others like purple snowflakes...
Each snowflake carried terrifying lethality that could instantly kill a Fourth Transformation Dominator.
And those lightning strikes, if hit even once.
The entire Sky Island might disintegrate on the spot!
Han Xing and the others could only strive to avoid them.
The elements here were completely chaotic!
Everyone clenched their fists, their hearts in their throats.

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 332: Opportunity! Land of Treasure! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Just as Han Xing was about to retreat.
Everyone suddenly realized in surprise.
The surrounding void turbulence calmed instantly.
As if, from a storm belt, suddenly came to a calm sea surface.
Giving an unreal feeling.
Cheng Jianyong said in confusion, "Huh? The void turbulence has stopped?"
"Could it be that we have reached the end of the void?"
Han Xing looked around at the surroundings.
Darkness was all around.
Clearly, this couldn’t be the end of the void.
Han Xing shook his head.
According to his estimation, the void region is much larger than the Holy Spirit Realm.
At their speed, even walking for decades, they might not reach the end.
Or perhaps, it’s simply endless.
"This area is somewhat special."
"The void turbulence is actually calmed here, as if suppressed by some kind of power."
Han Xing looked at Coal Ball.
It seemed unclear why it brought him to this place.
However.
Coal Ball continued to nuzzle Han Xing gently with its nose.
Signaling him to move forward.
Since there was no danger around.
Han Xing also believed that Coal Ball wouldn’t lead him astray.
So, he said directly, "Keep going."
The Sky Island continued to advance forward.
Without the interference of void turbulence, the advancement speed of the Sky Island was extremely fast.
Almost reaching two or three hundred thousand kilometers per hour.
An hour later.
Shen Yun suddenly pointed ahead in surprise and said, "Brother Xing, there seems to be something ahead."
Hearing this, everyone turned their gaze there.
Only to see in the void ahead, something seemed to appear faintly gray.
As if it were a gray wall covering the sky!
At the moment they saw this gray wall.
Coal Ball appeared extremely excited, constantly sticking its tongue out.
It seemed this was what it had been looking for.
Han Xing frowned and continued to control the Sky Island to move forward.
As they got closer.
They discovered that this wall was becoming even more immense.
Some special patterns also appeared on it.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly had a strange feeling in his heart.
This thing... why does it seem more like a scale of some creature?
To verify this guess in his heart.
Han Xing directly used divine power to activate a God’s Perspective.
At this moment, Han Xing, as if an eye flew out.
As he continuously elevated his view, when he saw the full view of the gray wall.
In an instant, a look of shock appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Even causing him to immediately withdraw from the God’s Perspective.
"Hiss!"
Han Xing took a sharp breath, as if seeing something terrifying.
Seeing Han Xing’s reaction, everyone was startled.
Then, unable to suppress their curiosity, they also used divine power to activate a God’s Perspective.
At this moment, everyone shouted in unison!
"My God..."
"What is that thing?"
A thick shock appeared in everyone’s eyes!
Including Han Xing.
Because, his guess was correct.
That gray wall covering the view was indeed just a scale from some creature.
And its complete form.
Was even hundreds of times larger than the entire Witch Race Continent!
Imagine.
In the endless void.
Seeing a giant beast the size of a star silently floating there.
What a shockingly awe-inspiring scene!
"What kind of monster is this? How can it be so huge!"
Shen Yun exclaimed.
Everyone else made difficult swallowing sounds from their throats.
At this moment.
Han Xing calmed down.
He once again used divine power to carefully observe the full appearance of this colossal beast.
It was a scorpion-like creature, with a long hooked tail.
Dark yellow scales covered its entire body, and the two large pincers were half the size of its body, a terrifying creature!
However.
This giant monster with a terrifying size didn’t make any movements.
Even though Han Xing and the others were now within its attack range.
The creature remained motionless.
As if, it was already dead,
At the same time.
A system prompt was heard by everyone.
[You have discovered a disaster creature: Beast’s corpse, world influence +1007.]
"Beast..."
Han Xing unconsciously spoke out the creature’s identity.
"It actually is this kind of creature!"
He remembered.
Beasts seemed to be among the group of monsters that appeared after the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
During that time, all divine spirits left the Holy Spirit Realm, leaving countless living beings to face this terrifying creature alone.
It was said that with one mouthful, it could be the end of the world.
One breath could bring about a calamity.
The entire Holy Spirit Realm under the threat of these creatures, lived in endless panic.
Underwent four hundred years of complete darkness.
Until the appearance of the Hunter.
Under his leadership.
The beings of the Holy Spirit Realm gradually began to resist.
However, what puzzled Han Xing was,
Wasn’t this creature already extinct?
Shen Yun, who knew a little about the history of the Holy Spirit Realm, exclaimed in surprise: "To actually encounter a Beast here."
"I looked through the Witch Race’s codex."
"It said that Beasts have power comparable to the divine spirits, their formidable flesh bodies enduring countless catastrophes without perishing."
"Even ordinary divine spirits aren’t a match against Beasts."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s pupils slightly contracted.
Divine Spirit...
That is an existence even more terrifying than a demigod.
At the current stage, a demigod is already the pinnacle of combat power in the Holy Spirit Realm.
And now, this creature before them, possesses power even stronger than a divine spirit!
Doesn’t this mean.
This monster alone could sweep away all the experts of the Holy Spirit Realm?

Han Xing directly used divine power to activate a God’s Perspective.
At this moment, Han Xing, as if an eye flew out.
As he continuously elevated his view, when he saw the full view of the gray wall.
In an instant, a look of shock appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Even causing him to immediately withdraw from the God’s Perspective.
"Hiss!"
Han Xing took a sharp breath, as if seeing something terrifying.
Seeing Han Xing’s reaction, everyone was startled.
Then, unable to suppress their curiosity, they also used divine power to activate a God’s Perspective.
At this moment, everyone shouted in unison!
"My God..."
"What is that thing?"
A thick shock appeared in everyone’s eyes!
Including Han Xing.
Because, his guess was correct.
That gray wall covering the view was indeed just a scale from some creature.
And its complete form.
Was even hundreds of times larger than the entire Witch Race Continent!
Imagine.
In the endless void.
Seeing a giant beast the size of a star silently floating there.
What a shockingly awe-inspiring scene!
"What kind of monster is this?
How can it be so huge!"
Shen Yun exclaimed.
Everyone else made difficult swallowing sounds from their throats.
At this moment.
Han Xing calmed down.
He once again used divine power to carefully observe the full appearance of this colossal beast.
It was a scorpion-like creature, with a long hooked tail.
Dark yellow scales covered its entire body, and the two large pincers were half the size of its body, a terrifying creature!
However.
This giant monster with a terrifying size didn’t make any movements.
Even though Han Xing and the others were now within its attack range.
The creature remained motionless.
As if, it was already dead,
At the same time.
A system prompt was heard by everyone.
[You have discovered a disaster creature: Beast’s corpse, world influence +1007.]
"Beast..."
Han Xing unconsciously spoke out the creature’s identity.
"It actually is this kind of creature!"
He remembered.
Beasts seemed to be among the group of monsters that appeared after the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
During that time, all divine spirits left the Holy Spirit Realm, leaving countless living beings to face this terrifying creature alone.
It was said that with one mouthful, it could be the end of the world.
One breath could bring about a calamity.
The entire Holy Spirit Realm under the threat of these creatures, lived in endless panic.
Underwent four hundred years of complete darkness.
Until the appearance of the Hunter.
Under his leadership.
The beings of the Holy Spirit Realm gradually began to resist.
However, what puzzled Han Xing was,
Wasn’t this creature already extinct?
Shen Yun, who knew a little about the history of the Holy Spirit Realm, exclaimed in surprise: "To actually encounter a Beast here."
"I looked through the Witch Race’s codex."
"It said that Beasts have power comparable to the divine spirits, their formidable flesh bodies enduring countless catastrophes without perishing."
"Even ordinary divine spirits aren’t a match against Beasts."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s pupils slightly contracted.
Divine Spirit...
That is an existence even more terrifying than a demigod.
At the current stage, a demigod is already the pinnacle of combat power in the Holy Spirit Realm.
And now, this creature before them, possesses power even stronger than a divine spirit!
Doesn’t this mean.
This monster alone could sweep away all the experts of the Holy Spirit Realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 332: Opportunity! Land of Treasures! (Part 3)
paragraphs: However, considering this guy’s size, having such strength is quite expected.
At this point, Shen Yun continued, "Brother Xing, should we take a look at its corpse?"
"This creature really seems dead..."
Upon hearing this.
Everyone’s eyes lit up, simultaneously turning to Han Xing.
Although this creature, even dead, gave everyone a strong sense of oppression.
But with their Legendary Level strength, they could still hold on.
Moreover, the key thing was, this was an existence comparable to a Divine Spirit!
A complete Divine Spirit corpse, containing unimaginable opportunities!
As modern people, they keenly sensed it.
On this creature, there might be treasures that could enhance them!
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing directly said, "Go!"
"This corpse should be what the Coal Ball is looking for."
"Even if there’s nothing else, just with its Divine Spirit comparable strength, it’s worth our exploration!"
Everyone nodded together.
In the next moment.
Han Xing led the team, gradually approaching the gigantic creature as big as a star.
At this time.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun couldn’t help but clench their fists.
Besides tension, there was a hint of uncontrollable excitement.
Because they were about to contact the world.
A real Divine Spirit Level existence!
As they got closer, the oppressive feeling intensified.
It felt like being targeted by some terrifying creature.
But the group knew that this creature was already dead.
There was little fear in their hearts.
As Sky Island got closer.
Soon.
Han Xing led everyone to find a suitable landing spot.
That was on the creature’s shoulder, on one of the scales.
This guy’s size was exaggerated.
One scale had the area of a Witch Race Continent.
Couldn’t see the end at a glance.
At this moment, even if someone told Han Xing.
A new civilization was born from this creature’s corpse.
He would choose to believe it without hesitation.
However, after observing for a moment, they didn’t find any signs of life.
On top, there were layers of various earthly yellow mountains.
These were high mountains formed by keratin layers on the creature.
These mountains had obvious abundant Life Force.
But for some reason, no life was born.
Not even a single blade of grass.
Everyone felt quite puzzled.
But Han Xing paid no mind.
Continuing to lead them exploring on the creature’s body.
However, this gigantic creature’s size was too large.
Even if their current speed reached two to three hundred thousand kilometers per hour.
Exploring the entire creature’s back.
Would still take a long time.
After ten minutes.
They had already advanced seventy or eighty thousand kilometers.
Appeared to have just reached the back from the creature’s shoulder.
The mountains here were higher.
None under a hundred thousand meters.
Layer upon layer, looking magnificent.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help saying a cold joke, "Is this thing’s keratin so thick, does it never bathe?"
Everyone simultaneously looked at him speechlessly.
Knowing Cheng Jianyong was trying to lighten the mood.
But his joke was still a bit too cold.
Shen Yun mercilessly retorted, "If you’re that bored, you could bite a lighter. If that doesn’t work, biting a few Dark Fire Stones is also an option."
Cheng Jianyong rubbed his head.
Just at that moment.
Han Xing suddenly noticed.
At the foot of a nearby earthly yellow mountain, some shimmering crystals appeared.
"There seems to be something there," Han Xing said.
Upon hearing this, everyone looked over.
And they too discovered the commotion there.
Then.
Han Xing directly controlled Sky Island to advance swiftly.
Sky Island descended in a straight line from the peak.
Upon reaching the foot, everyone jumped off Sky Island, arriving at the spot Han Xing had just noticed.
Everyone saw those glowing things.
The appearance seemed somewhat familiar.
On the ground lay many large stones appearing to be congealed from blood.
At this point, everyone guessed the name of the stone.
[Philosopher’s Stone]
However, compared to the Philosopher’s Stones they obtained before.
The size here was significantly larger by several times.
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Damn, I’m seeing such a huge Philosopher’s Stone for the first time."
"Any piece here could be worth thousands outside, right?"
Everyone nodded together, agreeing with Cheng Jianyong’s statement.
Han Xing said, "I’ll see if I can put them in the backpack."
Under their expectant gazes.
Han Xing walked over.
Then covered them with Divine Power and collected them.
The system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Philosopher’s Stone (Middle) *12, Philosopher’s Stone (Large) *3, Philosopher’s Stone (Extra Large) *2...]
Looking at the notes above.
Han Xing’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
What does large and extra large mean?
However, upon seeing the system remarks, Han Xing instantly halted his thought to complain.
[Philosopher’s Stone (Middle)]: Can be decomposed into Philosopher’s Stone *100.
[Philosopher’s Stone (Large)]: Can be decomposed into Philosopher’s Stone *500.
[Philosopher’s Stone (Extra Large)]: Can be decomposed into Philosopher’s Stone *1000.
"Whoa!"
At this moment, Han Xing’s pupils widened suddenly.
This thing can be decomposed into standard Philosopher’s Stones!
And decomposes into so many at once!
A total of 4700 Philosopher’s Stones!
Even for the entire group.
This is not a small figure.
Almost equivalent to a main city, a year’s earnings!
And Han Xing, like picking up ordinary stones, casually found them by the roadside.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and others also saw the attributes attached by Han Xing.
Exclaiming instantly.
"Whoa! Thousands of Philosopher’s Stones!"
"We’re loaded!"
"Totally worth diving millions of kilometers into the Void Turbulence! Just this find turned into a huge profit!"
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t contain his excitement.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and others, their eyes held messages as if having found treasure.
Shen Yun also said, "Brother Xing, we managed to find Philosopher’s Stones on the creature’s corpse."
"Considering its massive size, could there be more to discover?"
