chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 333: An Astonishing Harvest!
paragraphs: Upon hearing these words, everyone held their breath.
If what Shen Yun said was true.
Then this time, they hadn’t just discovered a corpse.
They had found a mountain of treasure!
A true mountain of treasure!
Given the beast’s enormous size,
If they explored it all, how many Philosopher’s Stones could they harvest?
It’s simply unimaginable!
At this moment.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t get too excited too soon, it’s possible this is just a chance discovery."
"Let’s wait until we find more Philosopher’s Stones before celebrating."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Suppressing their excitement.
Then.
Han Xing controlled the Sky Island to soar rapidly to an altitude of hundreds of thousands of meters.
On the Sky Island.
Everyone released their Divine Power.
Beginning to search more diligently.
Fearing to miss any corner.
As they journeyed several thousand kilometers.
At this time, Shen Yun said in confusion, "Brother Xing, do you have a feeling?"
"Our Divine Power can only explore the surface of this beast’s corpse, we can’t penetrate underground at all."
"It’s as if the ground is isolated by some kind of prohibition."
Han Xing nodded, "It’s the same on my end."
"However, this was expected, after all, this is a genuine Divine Spirit’s corpse,"
"With our level of power, it’s normal not to be able to probe its body internally."
Shen Yun suddenly understood and nodded.
Just then.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly exclaimed, "Brother Xing, I found something!"
He pointed to a certain ochre mountain range below.
Upon hearing this.
Han Xing directly controlled the Sky Island to quickly descend.
Then jumped straight down.
On the halfway point of one of the mountain peaks.
They once again found over a dozen blood-red stones.
They were precisely Philosopher’s Stones.
Not only that.
Next to this pile of Philosopher’s Stones, there were also one or two large glowing stones.
This glowing stone was also familiar to everyone.
It was Shimmering Terra Stone!
However.
On these two giant Terra Stones, there were marks of some creature’s teeth.
As if they were casually bitten as snacks, with pieces splashed out as residue.
Yet.
Even if it was just some residue.
For Han Xing and the others, it was still a huge gain!
Han Xing directly collected them.
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone (Medium) *11, Acquired Philosopher’s Stone (Large) *5, Acquired Shimmering Terra Stone (Extra Large) *2]
[Shimmering Terra Stone (Extra Large)]: Can be decomposed to yield Shimmering Terra Stone *1000
Another 3600 Philosopher’s Stones and 2000 Shimmering Terra Stones were added to the account!
At this moment.
Even with Han Xing’s composure.
He couldn’t help but hold his breath.
The harvest was just too immense!
They had been on the beast’s corpse for less than an hour.
The value of the treasures they harvested had already far exceeded any previous discovery.
Han Xing excitedly said, "Go! Keep searching!"
With those words, everyone jumped back onto the Sky Island.
Then shot straight up into the sky.
At this moment, their hearts were even more excited.
Having stumbled upon two piles of precious stones in succession.
This also proved Shen Yun’s hypothesis.
There must be more Divine Stones on the beast’s corpse.
Based on this ratio.
If they could scrape the entire surface of his corpse.
They could at least collect hundreds of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones and Terrastones!
Maybe even more!
What kind of concept is this?
The Witch Race, with its hundreds of billions of population, over thousands of years of accumulation.
Even after accounting for normal usage and consumption.
Was only this number.
At this moment, everyone only felt.
As if a gigantic mountain of treasure was right in front of them!
Han Xing’s throat moved, and then he said excitedly, "Next, we might be staying here for a while."
"The beast’s size is too large, to explore every corner would take at least a month."
Everyone nodded simultaneously.
Not only did they have no objections, but they were even more enthusiastic.
After all, who wouldn’t love this money-finding experience?
Moreover, what they were finding wasn’t money.
But Philosopher’s Stones!
Next.
Han Xing controlled the Sky Island, leading everyone to roam the beast’s skin surface, searching back and forth.
Not missing a single corner.
Their exploration area was currently focused on the beast’s right shoulder region.
Half a day later.
They finally completed searching this area.
The gains were extraordinarily frightening!
Roughly every hour, a pile of Philosopher’s Stones or Shimmering Terra Stone could be found.
Over the course of a dozen hours.
Han Xing collected a total of over 37,000 Philosopher’s Stones.
And over 24,000 Shimmering Terra Stones!
Mentioning it would terrify those Witch Race Legends to death!
Then.
They pressed on without pause to the beast’s left shoulder region.
The scene here was slightly different from before.
The height of the mountains was significantly lower.
The color was also darker.
As if soaked in blood.
From time to time, Han Xing even discovered one or two giant pits there.
There was a deep void inside.
Even using Divine Power, it couldn’t be probed.
Shen Yun suddenly said coldly, "Why does it feel like this area of the beast has been attacked?"
"Aren’t these pits its wounds?"
Shen Yun’s observation was quite detailed.
After hearing, everyone looked down simultaneously.
Finding that it was indeed as Shen Yun said.
The pits on the beast’s back seemed to be wounds left from an attack.
Han Xing nodded, "It should be."
"Creatures like the beast, ancient and imperishable, almost never die of old age due to exhaustion of life force."
"This beast was likely slain by some entity."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils contracted slightly.
Their understanding of the beast’s might was already profound.
Even some ordinary Divine Spirits were no match for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 333: Astonishing Harvest! (Part 2)
paragraphs: And the one who can slay such creatures must be an existence even more terrifying and formidable than the beast!
They could hardly imagine.
What kind of mighty power such an existence holds.
Even a star-like creature like the beast is not his match.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but say, "Brother Xing is right."
"No matter how strong we become, even if we’ve already surpassed Legend, we must maintain a sense of awe for this world."
"There are so many strong ones, there’s always someone stronger!"
Listening to Cheng Jianyong’s sentiment.
Everyone simultaneously turned their gaze toward him.
Shen Yun said, "You, it’s rare for you to say something sensible."
"I thought you would say that Sword Saint wants to spar with that existence."
Cheng Jianyong rolled his eyes and said, "I’m confident, but not stupid."
"Spar with such an existence? That’s like lighting a lantern in the toilet, looking for shit."
Everyone burst into laughter.
It seems Cheng Jianyong amused them.
Han Xing also laughed and said, "Let’s go, continue exploring."
"Whatever existence killed the beast, it’s been many years."
"It has nothing to do with us."
"Besides, I have a feeling this area might give us unexpected surprises."
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
They once again maintained high expectations.
They also know that such a terrifying existence as the beast.
Must have many unimaginable secrets!
Half an hour later.
The Sky Island began to slowly descend to the ground.
Han Xing seemed to have discovered something again.
He piloted the Sky Island to slowly approach.
However, this time he discovered not the Philosopher’s Stone or the Shimmering Terra Stone.
But a steep, flat peak.
With familiar patterns on it.
As if it was a scale from the beast’s body, broken off and embedded in the back.
It’s over ten thousand meters tall.
Han Xing got closer.
Exploring the texture of this scale.
Besides being a bit rough, he could sense a shocking divine power on it.
In front of him, the properties of this thing appeared.

[Giant Beast Scale (Red)]: A scale imbued with mighty divine power, featuring extremely high magic resistance and armor, it can be used to craft Divine Artifact Equipment or as Divine-level building materials.
[Material Effect]: Armor Value 10,000, magic damage reduced by 60%.
"Wow! Divine-level material!"
Han Xing exclaimed in surprise.
This was the first time he encountered a material of red quality.
It could even be used to make Divine Artifact Equipment or some divine-level constructions!
The eyes of the others were also full of astonishment.
Compared to Divine Stones.
This Giant Beast Scale is obviously more precious.
Even if not used for crafting equipment.
Just holding it in hand, with its armor value up to 10,000.
It instantly outclasses ordinary Divine Artifact Level Shields!
Their gazes were blazing hot.
Indeed, the scraps from the beast’s body.
Were treasures to them!
But, a tricky problem lay before them now.
And that was.
How could they carry out such a massive scale?
Even placing it on the Sky Island.
It almost completely covered the area of the Sky Island.
Even Coal Ball was circling around the massive scale.
Occasionally scratching it with its steel-needle-like wolf claws.
Only the sound of metal clashing was heard.
No white marks appeared on the scale.
This left Coal Ball feeling a bit disinterested.
The people felt at a loss.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing said, "I’ll try to see if I can fit it into the backpack."
Although putting such a massive object into a backpack seemed unrealistic.
But Han Xing had once put a puppet into a backpack during the early days of the game.
So.
He thought he could give it a try.
The next moment.
Han Xing directly released divine power, enveloping the entire massive scale.
With a thought.
Then.
This massive scale suddenly vanished into thin air!
Shen Yun: "..."
Cheng Jianyong: "...
At this moment.
The eyes of the five people and one wolf simultaneously showed a look of surprise!
Because this phenomenon indicated that Han Xing succeeded!
"Wow! You actually got this thing into the backpack, it’s amazing!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Shen Yun also praised, "Truly worthy of a Space Backpack, it can fit so much!"
Han Xing suppressed his excitement.
And checked the item’s introduction.
[Giant Beast Scale (Red)]: Can be directly used to build a certain type of large construction, or it can be decomposed into 100 Giant Beast Scales for crafting equipment.
Sure enough.
This Giant Beast Scale could also be decomposed!
Although it occupied a full hundred slots of Han Xing’s backpack space!
But fortunately, he had two backpacks.
Combined, they had 1600 slots of space.
Usually, Han Xing would reserve more than 1000 slots of empty space.
At this point, Han Xing asked, "How much free space do you have in your backpacks?"
Everyone took a glance and then reported a number.
After hearing, Han Xing nodded.
Like him.
Their Space Backpacks still had plenty of free slots, about 1000 to 1400.
Adding his own.
That’s at least six thousand slots of space.
Enough to carry quite a lot of stuff!
Han Xing became excited.
"Let’s go, continue the search!"
Everyone nodded heavily, then all returned to the Sky Island.
Even though.
With their strength, splitting up to explore would be more efficient.
But this was the depths of Void Turbulence.
And on the back of a Divine-level Creature.
Han Xing worried about any accidents happening, their inability to provide timely rescue.
Even if it takes more time, Han Xing didn’t want to take that risk.
Another dozen hours later.
Everyone almost finished exploring the territory on the left shoulder of the giant beast.
Han Xing briefly tallied up the harvest.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 333: Astonishing Harvest! (Part 3)
paragraphs: So far.
Philosopher’s Stone accumulated 76,400 pieces.
Shimmering Terra Stone accumulated 67,000 pieces.
This number is equivalent to the entire Witch Race going without food or drink for a hundred years!
Even if used to build [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon], it would be enough to build over a dozen.
One can imagine how great Han Xing’s harvest is this time!
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but clench his fist and say, "Good, good, good!"
"If there are enough high-level stones this time, I might even be able to build dozens of Spiritual Godslaying Cannons!"
"By then, even if the Shadow Monarch comes looking for trouble, I could blast him to death in one shot!"
"The Holy Spirit Realm is vast, and I can traverse it as I please!"
Han Xing was extremely excited!
However.
To build a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, a key material is still missing.
That is [Calamity Divine Gold].
Han Xing doesn’t know whether he can find this Divine Gold here.
However, even if he can’t find it, it doesn’t matter.
He is already very satisfied!
Han Xing led the others to explore the final area of the left shoulder region.
And just then.
Coal Ball hopped to the edge of Sky Island again.
Then it sniffed the air around, seemingly very excited.
At this time.
Han Xing stopped his steps.
Because he knew.
Coal Ball’s action might mean that it discovered something.
Speaking of which, discovering such a treasure land this time.
They had to thank Coal Ball’s contribution.
If not for its special sense.
Han Xing and the others would never have found this giant beast’s corpse in the chaotic Void Turbulence.
Even a demigod-level existence could not find it!
At this moment.
Coal Ball continued to sniff persistently.
Everyone silently waited.
Just then.
Coal Ball abruptly opened its ghostly green eyes.
It looked toward a distant mountain peak.
Han Xing walked over and asked, "Little Coal Ball, did you find something?"
"Woo... Woo..."
Coal Ball let out a low sound from its mouth.
It gently nodded toward Han Xing.
Han Xing stroked its massive wolf head.
Then directly controlled the Sky Island to move toward the target Coal Ball found.
Crossing that massive mountain peak.
The scene before their eyes suddenly changed.
The mountains and the ground here.
Changed from the original dark yellow to deep red.
And beneath the mountains, Han Xing discovered a very deep-colored river.
It seemed blood had once flowed through it.
Above it, Han Xing sensed the residual, immense Divine Power.
Even Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun sensed some issues.
"Whoa... This river, such a strong Divine Power fluctuation!"
"Could it be, this river was formed by the blood flowing from the giant beast?"
Cheng Jianyong wondered.
Han Xing did not answer.
He saw that Coal Ball was still staring ahead.
There seemed to be something there attracting it.
"Let’s go, see the river’s end."
Having said this, everyone followed the already dried river further for tens of kilometers.
Finally.
They reached the river’s end.
Here, was a gigantic black pit.
It seemed to be a wound on the beast’s body.
The scales appeared to be covered with dense cracks due to some terrifying attack.
However, the blood had dried up like the previous scene.
At this point.
Han Xing’s eyes suddenly brightened.
"Hmm? Something’s not right!"
"It seems, some blood hasn’t dried yet!"
Upon hearing this, everyone looked over.
At the bottom of the pit.
There was a small cluster of pure blood.
Coal Ball looked extremely excited, repeatedly nudging Han Xing with its head, seemingly eager to come into contact with the blood.
Han Xing directly controlled Sky Island to descend.
The closer they got.
The more they could feel.
The terrifying Divine Power surging in the pit.
It even made them feel their hearts race and their blood boil.
One can imagine.
If the blood in the pit hadn’t dried up by then.
The mere fluctuation of Divine Power would prevent everyone from approaching.
However, now the level is just right.
Soon.
They reached the bottom of the pit.
The Divine Power here was extremely thick, almost tangible.
Everyone headed straight for the last small patch of blood.
Then they saw.
A small pool of bright red blood on the ground, with tiny starlights flowing on it.
The blood of a Divine Beast, even its appearance was so unique.
In front of everyone appeared the attributes of this bunch of blood.
[Giant Beast Blood (Red)]: Blood containing extremely pure Divine Power, can be used as certain alchemy materials or taken directly, resulting in tremendous enhancement.
Note: If consumed by creatures with overly low constitution, there is a risk of exploding to death.
"Seems like this truly is the blood of the beast!"
"Genuine blood of a Divine Beast!" Shen Yun was amazed.
Cheng Jianyong wondered, "This mentioned usage as certain alchemy materials, does it mean it can be used to craft secret elixirs?"
"And what is the great enhancement that it mentions?"
Han Xing also wanted to know the answer to this question.
Thus.
He directly stored the small pool of blood in his backpack.
The system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Giant Beast Blood (Red) *32]
There were only 32 drops.
But that’s not bad either.
Han Xing looked at the others and said, "Who wants to try the effect of this Divine Beast blood first?"
Everyone looked at each other.
Coal Ball appeared very eager at the side, its eyes filled with desire.
But if Han Xing didn’t hand it out directly, Coal Ball wouldn’t dare to overstep its bounds.
At this point, Shen Yun said, "Let me try it, my constitution is good, even if there are unexpected situations, I can handle it."
The system warned of a side effect.
Creatures with too low constitution, upon consumption, might explode and die.
Shen Yun, as a Radiant Knight with Spirit and Body Dual Cultivation, always had a good constitution.
Han Xing nodded, without saying more.
Instead, he first gave him a drop of Divine Blood.
Before everyone’s eyes.
Shen Yun swallowed it directly.
A few seconds later.
Han Xing saw his face turn extremely red!
It was as if some power was rushing through Shen Yun’s body.
Even his head emitted bursts of white mist.
Han Xing frowned, just about to intervene.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 334: Divine Beast Blood, Calamity Divine Gold!
paragraphs: After Shen Yun consumed the Giant Beast Blood, an anomaly appeared on his body.
Han Xing wanted to approach.
However, he saw Shen Yun wave his hand, saying, "Brother Xing, I’m fine, no need to interrupt me."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing stopped his actions.
Everyone watched Shen Yun with a hint of nervousness in their eyes.
A moment later.
The color drained from Shen Yun’s face.
"Phew..."
He exhaled deeply.
Then showed a look of surprise and delight.
Seeing his expression, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Quick, tell us, what effect did it have?"
Shen Yun smiled and said, "It’s very good!"
"This Giant Beast Blood’s effect exceeds my imagination."
"Not only did it increase my Constitution by 500 points, but it also added 100 Divine Power points!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils widened in an instant!
"Wow... is it that strong?" Cheng Jianyong was astonished.
The effect of this Giant Beast Blood was truly terrifying!
points to Constitution needless to say, it’s almost equivalent to the boost of a piece of Orange Equipment, a huge enhancement.
However, even more terrifying was the effect that followed.
Divine Power +100!
It should be known that even Han Xing.
His current Divine Power is only over a thousand points.
And now, one drop of blood can directly increase 100 Divine Power points.
That’s nearly a tenth of an increase!
According to the Demon Furnace which requires collecting a billion Souls to refine a Soul Crystal to increase Han Xing’s Divine Power by 1 point.
That is to say.
It would need to refine a hundred billion Souls to match the boost from this drop of blood!
At this moment.
Everyone felt their breathing quicken.
At this time, Shen Yun supplemented, "However, the system just prompted one thing."
"This Divine Blood, only the first consumption has such an effect."
"Subsequent consumptions will see a significant reduction in attribute gains, and eventually, it might have no effect at all."
Han Xing nodded.
Such a limitation is reasonable.
Otherwise.
With the size of this Giant Beast.
Its blood alone could cultivate countless powerful Legendary and even Demigod level powerhouses, couldn’t it?
Han Xing gave each of the other three a drop of Divine Blood.
Letting them try it first.
Everyone gladly accepted.
And then swallowed it together.
Including Han Xing himself, also swallowed a drop of Giant Beast Blood.
Just like Shen Yun.
Their faces instantly turned crimson red.
Everyone felt an overwhelming power surging through their limbs and bones.
Their physical fitness drastically improved within a short time.
Several seconds later.
A system notification also rang in Han Xing’s ears.
[Successfully consumed ’Giant Beast Blood’, Constitution Attribute +500, Divine Power +100.]
Note: The next consumption will reduce the effect by 50%, and after multiple consumptions, there will be no further enhancement effect.
Seeing the expressions of surprise on the others’ faces.
Han Xing knew.
They also successfully digested the effects of the Giant Beast Blood.
At this moment.
Han Xing turned his gaze to the eagerly watching Coal Ball.
Of course, he hadn’t forgotten this wolf pup and knew that this kind of ’Giant Beast Blood’ was something Coal Ball craved.
Han Xing waited for everyone else to finish consuming before looking at Coal Ball.
Because he had considered Coal Ball’s attributes.
Right now, it’s only at Fourth-Turn Lord Level strength.
No matter how powerful.
Compared to these Legendary Powerhouses, there was still a world of difference.
And the ’Giant Beast Blood’ also came with the risk of body explosion.
Han Xing certainly wanted to try it himself before giving it to Coal Ball.
However, it now seemed the energy impact of ’Giant Beast Blood’ wasn’t as terrifying.
Coal Ball should be able to withstand it.
Thinking of this.
Han Xing directly tossed a drop of Divine Blood in front of Coal Ball.
Coal Ball’s pupils widened, then it opened its huge mouth.
Directly swallowed it down!
"Gulp..."
Along with the sound of swallowing.
Coal Ball directly swallowed this drop of blood into its body.
The next moment, the Power of the Void on Coal Ball suddenly surged dramatically!
Black aura began to spread rapidly.
It seemed to be digesting faster than everyone else.
In just a few seconds.
The energy disturbance on Coal Ball subsided directly.
At this time, Han Xing also saw the system notification.
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ for unknown reasons, activated a portion of the Void Royal Family bloodline within its body, all Attributes +500, Potential Value +10000.]
At this moment.
Han Xing was directly stunned.
Activating the Royal Bloodline!
This blood actually had such an effect!
Moreover.
Compared to them just simply increasing Constitution by 500 points, Coal Ball was obviously more terrifying!
All Attributes directly +500!
Plus, there was an increase of Potential Value +10000 that followed.
At this moment, Han Xing knew.
This Giant Beast Blood for Coal Ball was an extremely precious natural treasure!
Seeing its eager eyes.
Without any hesitation, Han Xing tossed a second drop of blood over.
Coal Ball swallowed it in one gulp again.
Then digested it in a short time.
"Buzz!"
Void Energy spread.
Attributes and Potential Value surged again.
It’s just that, from the previous All Attributes +500, it turned into All Attributes +400.
Han Xing nodded.
This reduction was less than theirs.
Moreover, the follow-up Potential Value +10000 did not shrink.
Han Xing continued to feed.
The third drop, the fourth drop, the fifth drop.
Coal Ball’s attribute increase had become +100.
But the good news is, the Potential Value remained unchanged.
Still one drop of Giant Beast Blood provides 10000 points of Potential Value.
Han Xing knew.
If he continued to feed the Giant Beast Blood.
The enhancement effect for Coal Ball would continue to diminish.
However, seeing Coal Ball’s eager eyes.
Han Xing wasn’t stingy.
Began to feed continuously.
After all, these dozens of drops of blood were discovered by Coal Ball.
Even, the body of the beast itself was found by Coal Ball leading them.

However, it now seemed the energy impact of ’Giant Beast Blood’ wasn’t as terrifying.
Coal Ball should be able to withstand it.
Thinking of this.
Han Xing directly tossed a drop of Divine Blood in front of Coal Ball.
Coal Ball’s pupils widened, then it opened its huge mouth.
Directly swallowed it down!
"Gulp..."
Along with the sound of swallowing.
Coal Ball directly swallowed this drop of blood into its body.
The next moment, the Power of the Void on Coal Ball suddenly surged dramatically!
Black aura began to spread rapidly.
It seemed to be digesting faster than everyone else.
In just a few seconds.
The energy disturbance on Coal Ball subsided directly.
At this time, Han Xing also saw the system notification.
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ for unknown reasons, activated a portion of the Void Royal Family bloodline within its body, all Attributes +500, Potential Value +10000.]
At this moment.
Han Xing was directly stunned.
Activating the Royal Bloodline!
This blood actually had such an effect!
Moreover.
Compared to them just simply increasing Constitution by 500 points, Coal Ball was obviously more terrifying!
All Attributes directly +500!
Plus, there was an increase of Potential Value +10000 that followed.
At this moment, Han Xing knew.
This Giant Beast Blood for Coal Ball was an extremely precious natural treasure!
Seeing its eager eyes.
Without any hesitation, Han Xing tossed a second drop of blood over.
Coal Ball swallowed it in one gulp again.
Then digested it in a short time.
"Buzz!"
Void Energy spread.
Attributes and Potential Value surged again.
It’s just that, from the previous All Attributes +500, it turned into All Attributes +400.
Han Xing nodded.
This reduction was less than theirs.
Moreover, the follow-up Potential Value +10000 did not shrink.
Han Xing continued to feed.
The third drop, the fourth drop, the fifth drop.
Coal Ball’s attribute increase had become +100.
But the good news is, the Potential Value remained unchanged.
Still one drop of Giant Beast Blood provides 10000 points of Potential Value.
Han Xing knew.
If he continued to feed the Giant Beast Blood.
The enhancement effect for Coal Ball would continue to diminish.
However, seeing Coal Ball’s eager eyes.
Han Xing wasn’t stingy.
Began to feed continuously.
After all, these dozens of drops of blood were discovered by Coal Ball.
Even, the body of the beast itself was found by Coal Ball leading them.

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 334: Divine Beast Blood, Calamity Divine Gold!
paragraphs: Even if he used up all the Giant Beast Blood he had, Han Xing wouldn’t feel the slightest bit of heartache.
At the same time.
One after another, over ten drops of blood were fed.
System prompts continually appeared.
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’, due to special reasons, has activated part of the Royal Bloodline, all attributes +100, potential value +10,000.]
[Your pet...]
Later, these ten or so drops of blood only added a hundred points to the attributes.
All the way up to the twentieth drop of blood.
Coal Ball seemed to finally be full.
It opened its mouth and let out a loud burp.
Then it ran to Han Xing and rubbed against him.
Its face showing a satisfied expression.
Coal Ball’s size had already grown from the original five or six meters to seven or eight meters.
Looking at this giant wolf’s size.
Han Xing couldn’t help but check its attributes.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Fourth-Turn Lord Level)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV48]
[Attributes: Power 8132, agility 13278, spirit 8065, constitution 8134]
[Affinity: 100]
[Satiety: 100 (Good)]
[Growth: SS (can increase with potential value, next level: SS+, required potential value: 100,000)]
[Potential Value]: 154,122
Compared to a few days ago.
Coal Ball’s attributes had improved by nearly 50%, a terrifying transformation.
Even Fourth-Turn Dominator Level creatures didn’t have such terrifying attributes.
Without a doubt.
Twenty drops of Giant Beast Blood had provided Coal Ball with enormous enhancement!
Indeed, the potential value alone could allow Coal Ball to complete its next evolution!
Han Xing excitedly said, "150,000 points of potential value, entirely sufficient for Coal Ball to complete its SS+ evolution."
"Then, let’s start now!"
System prompts appeared.
[Would you like to initiate the next stage of evolution for your pet ’Coal Ball’, it will consume 100,000 potential value in this evolution.]
"Yes.
At the same time.
Coal Ball suddenly stood up.
The terrifying Power of the Void began to converge from all sides.
Those red lightning bolts, purple snowflakes.
As if summoned by something.
Rushed quickly towards Coal Ball from afar.
Looking at these Void Turbulence capable of instantly killing Four-Star Dominators or even Legendary Creatures.
Everyone couldn’t help but take a few steps back.
However, Coal Ball was unmoved.
It absorbed all this energy into its body.
The next moment.
Coal Ball’s size again skyrocketed drastically!
Growing from its previous size of seven or eight meters to over ten meters!
"Awoo!"
At this moment, a majestic black giant wolf looked up at the sky.
System prompts appeared.
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ has evolved successfully, all attributes +50%, activating Void Royal Family exclusive skill: Great Calamity!]
[Current growth level: SS+, next stage SSS-level, requires potential value of 1 million.]
Just as Han Xing had anticipated.
The next stage is SSS-level, which is Legendary.
The required potential is terrifying, as much as one million!
Still a long way to go.
At this time, Han Xing noticed a newly activated skill of Coal Ball.
[Great Calamity]: Void Royal Family exclusive skill.
[Skill Effect]: Summon Lightning of Annihilation, Erosion Snowflakes, Withering Gale, Boiling Torrential Rain...forming a disaster zone, inflicting devastating damage on all enemies.
The purer the Void Royal Bloodline, the more terrifying the calamity summoned.
Skill duration: 60 seconds, cooldown time 24 hours.
After reading the skill description.
Han Xing’s gaze intensified.
Above, though no damage coefficient was noted.
They already knew that the so-called Silent Annihilation Lightning, Erosion Snowflakes.
Should be the ones they encountered in the Void Turbulence.
Among them, those red lightning bolts could even pose a threat to Legendary Powerhouses!
If, Coal Ball could summon this fearsome thing.
Relying solely on this move.
It would have a means to deal with Legendaries!
Not to mention, there were also Withering Gale and Boiling Torrential Rain that none of them had seen before!
At this moment, Coal Ball really completed an extremely important transformation.
After inspecting the area.
The left shoulder of the beast was explored by them.
After a few hours of rest.
Han Xing continued to lead everyone to explore the beast’s back...
At the same time.
Outside the Void Turbulence, Witch Race border region.
A group of humans in various strange equipment were engaged in a tug-of-war with the Void Beast swarm.
The expressions of these humans appeared quite excited!
Recently.
More and more Survivors were pouring into the Witch Race Territory, joining the battle.
They even nearly took over part of the battlefield.
Though.
These people lacked discipline and a Commander.
Nonetheless, relying on their numbers and manic tactics.
They managed to barely hold back the Void Beast’s offensive.
Even, temporarily bewildering the Witch Race Soldiers.
With approval from above.
The Witch Race Soldiers collectively went to other Witch Race borders to provide support.
At this moment.
On the battlefield of the seven Witch Race border regions, the situation had gradually stabilized.
Though the frequency of Void Turbulence was still increasing.
They now had Han Xing’s Defense Tower support.
With its powerful firepower.
Whenever Void Beasts showed any signs of disturbance, the Defense Tower would wash them away.
Pitilessly extinguishing them!
The Witch Race officers’ faces showed joy, unable to refrain from praising.
"Saint Master Han Xing, truly the hope of our Witch Race!"
"His presence makes even ordinarily thorny Void Turbulences so simple."
Other Witch Race officers echoed: "Indeed."
"Though Saint Master Han Xing has only held the position for half a month."
"With his help, the Witch Race has not only recovered vitality but also started progressing positively."

paragraphs: "We must praise the great Saint Master Han Xing."
Others echoed in agreement.
"Praise Saint Master Han Xing!"
The conference hall was a scene of harmony.
However, while everyone was not paying attention.
On a certain border battlefield of the Witch Race.
A group of pale-faced Witch Race soldiers had unknowingly gathered together.
They stared blankly ahead.
From beneath their standard armor, strange noises emanated.
Slippery, sticky sounds.
With every movement, pus even oozed from their feet...
Such eerie Witch Race soldiers.
Numbered in the tens of thousands.
At this moment, this group of Witch Race soldiers seemed to have received some summons, simultaneously fixating their gaze into the depths of the void.
Then an eerie smile appeared on their faces.
The next moment.
They all walked into the void together.
And then disappeared...
Simultaneously.
Not only at the Witch Race border.
Within the Witch Race Continent, the number of Witch Race people showing such signs increased.
It was like a terrifying plague, rapidly spreading.
All those infected, without exception, went into hiding.
It seemed as though they were brewing an enormous conspiracy.
That day.
The void chaos escalated further.
Countless Void Beasts surged from the space rifts.
Moreover, the void beasts’ levels clearly increased.
Wu Ling’Er urgently issued orders.
Summoning all the Witch Race legends to mobilize and help soldiers quell the chaos!
Including those legendary figures who were healing their wounds.
The Witch Race, who had just recovered from the Shadow Legion war.
Once again entered a state of war.
On the following day.
Han Xing continued to explore the beast’s back with his team.
On a steep mountain peak.
Han Xing suddenly stopped.
Because.
He found a strange cave halfway up the mountain.
It looked as though it was formed by a meteorite crashing into the mountainside.
However, the cave had only about a two-meter diameter.
To enter, they couldn’t take the Sky Island along.
With a sense of curiosity.
Han Xing and his four companions jumped down from the Sky Island.
Then.
Using divine power to support themselves, they floated mid-air.
Upon entering the pit.
Han Xing distinctly sensed a peculiar aura.
This aura was indescribable.
It was as if a higher-tier power was continually spreading inside.
The pit had very low visibility.
Han Xing pulled out the Dark Fire Stone Torch.
"Fizz..."
Upon lighting it, Han Xing saw the surrounding earth-yellow walls.
Continuing down the pit.
They reached about three to four thousand meters deep, seemingly reaching the pit’s end.
At the end, Han Xing saw a glimmer of light.
Upon closer inspection.
The light was coming from a peculiar piece of metal.
Its surface was pitch black, yet it emitted a colorful, faint glow.
This piece of metal crashed out this pit.
In front of Han Xing appeared the attributes of this metal.
[Calamity Divine Gold (Small)]: An extremely special metal that goes through an apocalyptic disaster, only likely to form just before a world perishes.
Han Xing’s pupils shrank suddenly.
"It’s actually it!"
He was very surprised.
Calamity Divine Gold serves as one of the main materials for the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
Far more precious than the Philosopher’s Stone.
The item’s description already indicated.
This divine gold’s quantity in the entire Holy Spirit Realm must be extremely scant.
After all, it only has a chance to form just before a world is destroyed.
Unexpectedly, they found some here.
This implies there might be other Calamity Divine Gold on the beast’s body!
Han Xing immediately released his divine power, enveloping the divine gold, before storing it in his backpack.
[Obtained Calamity Divine Gold (Small) *1, can be decomposed into Calamity Divine Gold *10.]
Han Xing’s eyes instantly lit up with joy.
"Oh my... it can actually yield 10 pieces of divine gold!"
"It’s even enough material to craft a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon!"
"If we can find a few more divine golds, we’d be rich in no time!
Han Xing was extremely excited.
With that thought, Han Xing and his team started a more detailed exploration on the beast’s back.
Two days later.
They finished exploring the upper half of the beast.
The gains were astonishing.
The most abundant among them were the Philosopher’s Stone and Terrastone.
The quantities of these two materials exceeded 200,000.
In addition, they later collected seven pieces of Giant Beast Scale, equating to 700 divine artifact materials.
And they had 107 drops of Divine Blood.
Additionally, they found 8 pieces of Calamity Divine Gold (Small), and 1 piece of Calamity Divine Gold (Medium): can be decomposed into 50 Calamity Divine Gold pieces.
Altogether, it equates to 130 Calamity Divine Gold pieces!
Han Xing grew increasingly excited.
Looking forward to the harvest after fully searching this gigantic creature!
Time slowly passed.
The repetitive exploration process was tedious.
But due to the continuous discovery of various treasures, it stimulated everyone’s nerves.
Keeping them in a state of high excitement.
Additionally, with the five’s legendary-level constitution, exhaustion was non-existent for them.
Time slowly passed.
A week later.
They finally explored the entire back of the giant beast.
It was the tenth day of exploring the giant beast’s corpse.
At this moment.
An enormous Sky Island was anchored on a giant beast’s scale.
The five looked at each other and smiled.
Satisfaction appeared on their faces.
"This time, we really hit the jackpot!"
"If we don’t mention it, who could imagine we’ve got hundreds of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones and Terrastones in our backpacks?"
"Plus over two thousand Giant Beast Scales, and a few hundred drops of Divine Blood!"
Cheng Jianyong was extremely excited.
Nonetheless, everyone was understanding.
In ten days, their harvest was tremendous!
Incredibly valuable beyond words.
It even directly surpassed the Witch Race’s foundation.
"Getting rich" doesn’t even begin to describe it!
At this moment, Shen Yun asked: "Brother Xing, we’ve almost explored the surface of this giant beast’s body, haven’t we?"
"What’s the next step?"

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 335: Divine Level Venom and "Stinger"!
paragraphs: Han Xing replied with a smile, "It’s still early, we’ve only just finished exploring the back of the giant beast."
"You’ve all seen the size of this giant beast."
"It still has a tail, a head, two giant legs, and a pair of massive pincers!"
"These are all places we can explore."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun had a knowing smile on their faces.
This is about stripping this beast’s corpse bare!
Not leaving anything for future generations.
However.
This aligns with everyone’s thoughts.
Since it’s a rare opportunity, it’s only natural to grasp it all ourselves.
Leaving it for future generations?
That’s not happening!
If the situation allowed.
Han Xing would even want to take the entire corpse of this Divine Giant Beast with him.
After making a brief rest.
They headed towards the beast’s tail.
Due to the tail being in a curved barb-like shape.
From their perspective, it seemed like a curved, dark yellow wall, blocking all sight.
The beast’s tail seemed to pierce into the Void.
They instinctively raised their heads and looked toward the sky.
However, all they could see was nothingness.
Shaking his head.
Han Xing led everyone to continue a thorough search.
Six hours later.
They further explored a large area on the back.
Harvested some Philosopher’s Stones and Terrastones, as well as a small amount of Calamity Divine Gold.
Compared to the back.
The resources in the giant beast’s tail area were noticeably less.
After several hours.
They collectively harvested over 5000 Philosopher’s Stones and Terrastones.
And a piece of Calamity Divine Gold (small).
However, even such a small amount of resources.
Taking it outside would be enough to drive those Legendary Powerhouses crazy!
Just at this moment.
Han Xing suddenly saw a patch of black-purple fog appear on the soil-yellow ground ahead.
That patch of fog stretched for dozens of miles.
The closer to the center.
The thicker the black-purple fog became.
It seemed as if something was continuously emitting this fog.
The sudden appearance of such a spectacle at the giant beast’s tail.
Made Han Xing’s curiosity piqued.
He controlled the Sky Island to gradually approach this black-purple fog.
However, just as they made contact.
System notification appeared.
[You have been eroded by ’Giant Beast Poison Fog’, all attributes reduced by 20%, life value depletes by 1% per second (Divine Power can be used to slow the depletion).]
[Each additional layer of ’Giant Beast Poison’ increases the life loss effect by 1%.]
[Note: This poison is of Divine Level, once the layers stack to 3 or more, no skill can dispel it.]
Upon hearing this notification.
"Damn!"
Everyone’s expression, including Han Xing’s, drastically changed.
The next moment.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate at all and immediately turned to flee!
As he fled.
Han Xing felt extremely shocked internally!
What kind of joke is this!
He was now a Legendary Powerhouse.
Ordinary toxin attacks had no effect on him.
Even if he were to bathe in the venom of those Dominator Level poisons now, Han Xing wouldn’t be harmed in the slightest!
A single drop of that venom couldn’t even break his Divine Power Domain!
But now.
They had only approached this poison fog for less than a second.
And they had already been poisoned by 1 layer, with all attributes drastically plummeting!
Moreover, life value was depleting at a percentage per second.
If, as the system stated, the poison stacked to 3 layers, then even gods couldn’t save them.
Despite being just 1 layer of poison.
Everyone still felt terribly uncomfortable.
Not only were their body attributes drastically lowered.
They could also feel their bodies continuously being eroded.
The poison was rapidly spreading throughout their bodies.
Even when they summoned all their Divine Power, they could only slightly slow down the poison’s invasion.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said with a slightly trembling voice, "Xiaoyunzi, quickly cast a Purification Technique on us! We can’t hold on!"
Shen Yun nodded.
With a grim expression, he raised the Holy Hammer and began chanting a spell.
"Grant me the power of redemption..."
The next moment.
A powerful and sacred Power of Holy Light began to condense between his hammer.
Then.
Five orbs of Holy Light fell into each person’s body!
Han Xing only felt a warm power rapidly spread throughout his body.
The chilling sensation began to alleviate.
However.
After this energy dissipated.
Everyone was horrified to find, on the character information, in the state section.
The Giant Beast Poison was still there!
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Xiaoyunzi, what’s going on?"
Shen Yun’s face was extremely grim.
"We’ve got trouble, the system just indicated that my Spirit Attribute is insufficient."
"The Purification Technique failed..."
Upon hearing this.
"Damn! You’re saying your Spirit Attribute is insufficient?"
"How is that possible!"
Cheng Jianyong was extremely surprised.
You need to understand.
Since Shen Yun equipped the entire Orange Set, and after breaking through to a Legendary Powerhouse.
His Spirit Attribute has already surpassed twenty thousand.
Far exceeding more than half of the Legendary Powerhouses.
Moreover, he was in a hidden profession, the Radiant Knight.
The effect of his Purification Technique was also much better than those of ordinary Knight professions.
Yet now, even Shen Yun had failed.
"Sorry..." Shen Yun apologized.
The terror of this Giant Beast Poison exceeded everyone’s expectation.
However, no one had thoughts of blaming him.
At that moment, Han Xing said, "It’s okay."
"If the Spirit Attribute is insufficient, then let’s boost the attribute a bit and see."
"I have a few bottles of [Spirit Stimulating Elixir] here, which can increase the Spirit Attribute by 25%."
"Give it a try."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun’s eyes immediately lit up.
He didn’t expect Han Xing to have such a precious item on hand.

sentences.text: Han Xing replied with a smile, "It’s still early, we’ve only just finished exploring the back of the giant beast."
"You’ve all seen the size of this giant beast."
"It still has a tail, a head, two giant legs, and a pair of massive pincers!"
"These are all places we can explore."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun had a knowing smile on their faces.
This is about stripping this beast’s corpse bare!
Not leaving anything for future generations.
However.
This aligns with everyone’s thoughts.
Since it’s a rare opportunity, it’s only natural to grasp it all ourselves.
Leaving it for future generations?
That’s not happening!
If the situation allowed.
Han Xing would even want to take the entire corpse of this Divine Giant Beast with him.
After making a brief rest.
They headed towards the beast’s tail.
Due to the tail being in a curved barb-like shape.
From their perspective, it seemed like a curved, dark yellow wall, blocking all sight.
The beast’s tail seemed to pierce into the Void.
They instinctively raised their heads and looked toward the sky.
However, all they could see was nothingness.
Shaking his head.
Han Xing led everyone to continue a thorough search.
Six hours later.
They further explored a large area on the back.
Harvested some Philosopher’s Stones and Terrastones, as well as a small amount of Calamity Divine Gold.
Compared to the back.
The resources in the giant beast’s tail area were noticeably less.
After several hours.
They collectively harvested over 5000 Philosopher’s Stones and Terrastones.
And a piece of Calamity Divine Gold (small).
However, even such a small amount of resources.
Taking it outside would be enough to drive those Legendary Powerhouses crazy!
Just at this moment.
Han Xing suddenly saw a patch of black-purple fog appear on the soil-yellow ground ahead.
That patch of fog stretched for dozens of miles.
The closer to the center.
The thicker the black-purple fog became.
It seemed as if something was continuously emitting this fog.
The sudden appearance of such a spectacle at the giant beast’s tail.
Made Han Xing’s curiosity piqued.
He controlled the Sky Island to gradually approach this black-purple fog.
However, just as they made contact.
System notification appeared.
[You have been eroded by ’Giant Beast Poison Fog’, all attributes reduced by 20%, life value depletes by 1% per second (Divine Power can be used to slow the depletion).]
[Each additional layer of ’Giant Beast Poison’ increases the life loss effect by 1%.]
[Note: This poison is of Divine Level, once the layers stack to 3 or more, no skill can dispel it.]
Upon hearing this notification.
"Damn!"
Everyone’s expression, including Han Xing’s, drastically changed.
The next moment.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate at all and immediately turned to flee!
As he fled.
Han Xing felt extremely shocked internally!
What kind of joke is this!
He was now a Legendary Powerhouse.
Ordinary toxin attacks had no effect on him.
Even if he were to bathe in the venom of those Dominator Level poisons now, Han Xing wouldn’t be harmed in the slightest!
A single drop of that venom couldn’t even break his Divine Power Domain!
But now.
They had only approached this poison fog for less than a second.
And they had already been poisoned by 1 layer, with all attributes drastically plummeting!
Moreover, life value was depleting at a percentage per second.
If, as the system stated, the poison stacked to 3 layers, then even gods couldn’t save them.
Despite being just 1 layer of poison.
Everyone still felt terribly uncomfortable.
Not only were their body attributes drastically lowered.
They could also feel their bodies continuously being eroded.
The poison was rapidly spreading throughout their bodies.
Even when they summoned all their Divine Power, they could only slightly slow down the poison’s invasion.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said with a slightly trembling voice, "Xiaoyunzi, quickly cast a Purification Technique on us!
We can’t hold on!"
Shen Yun nodded.
With a grim expression, he raised the Holy Hammer and began chanting a spell.
"Grant me the power of redemption..."
The next moment.
A powerful and sacred Power of Holy Light began to condense between his hammer.
Then.
Five orbs of Holy Light fell into each person’s body!
Han Xing only felt a warm power rapidly spread throughout his body.
The chilling sensation began to alleviate.
However.
After this energy dissipated.
Everyone was horrified to find, on the character information, in the state section.
